detail.abstract:
CEOs of the largest US corporations in 2019 adopted as their corporate purpose to provide benefits for all their stakeholders. However, they possessed no creditable process to achieve this with shareholders competing with other stakeholders for benefits. Introducing polycentric governance creates a way to solve this problem while transforming corporations into a Common Pool Resource. 

As investors get overpaid in a way accountants cannot report when corporate property rights have no time limits, their static and exclusive rights need replacing with time limited, inclusive, and dynamic rights. These create an endowment corporation that distributes by book entries all the property rights of investors, over the life of a twenty-year patent, to newly created stakeholder shares. Shareholder primacy is maintained while investors are replaced by individual stakeholders residing in the local bioregion. 

Business, investor, and management continuity can be maintained indefinitely from dividend re-investment plans funding offspring enterprises. A self-financing tax incentive for investors who formed self-governing endowment corporations would obtain bigger, quicker, less risky profits with stakeholders obtaining a new channel of benefits. Dividends would privatise the need for welfare and big government. Circular bio-regional economies are created with enriched polycentric self-governing bottom-up stakeholder democracies.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过引入多中心治理和将企业转变为公共池资源，解决美国大公司CEO宣称服务所有利益相关者但缺乏可信流程的问题。通过创建"捐赠公司"，将投资者的财产权在20年专利期内逐步分配给新创建的利益相关者股份，用本地生物区域的个体利益相关者取代投资者，同时保持股东优先原则。
AI.research_question: 如何解决大型公司宣称服务所有利益相关者但缺乏可信治理流程的问题？如何通过制度设计在保持股东优先的同时，将公司转变为真正服务所有利益相关者的公共池资源？
AI.motivation: 2019年美国大公司CEO们宣称要服务所有利益相关者，但缺乏可信的治理流程来实现这一目标，股东与其他利益相关者之间存在利益竞争。当前的静态、排他性财产权制度导致投资者过度获利，而会计师无法报告这种状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共池资源理论、多中心治理理论、利益相关者理论、企业治理理论、财产权理论（从静态排他性权利转向时间有限、包容性、动态权利）
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，提出制度设计解决方案：创建"捐赠公司"，通过簿记方式在20年专利期内将投资者财产权逐步分配给新创建的利益相关者股份，建立多中心自下而上的利益相关者民主治理结构。
AI.findings: 通过将公司转变为公共池资源并采用多中心治理，可以解决利益相关者之间的利益竞争问题。用时间有限、包容性、动态的财产权取代静态排他性权利，创建捐赠公司能够将投资者逐步替换为本地生物区域的个体利益相关者，同时保持股东优先原则。这种设计能够实现商业、投资者和管理的连续性，通过股息再投资计划为后代企业提供资金。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将公共池资源理论应用于公司治理；2) 提出从静态排他性财产权向时间有限、包容性、动态权利的转变框架；3) 发展了多中心治理在利益相关者民主中的应用；4) 扩展了利益相关者理论的制度实现路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为CEO们提供实现服务所有利益相关者承诺的具体治理方案；2) 通过自我融资的税收激励鼓励投资者组建自治捐赠公司；3) 创造循环生物区域经济；4) 通过股息私有化福利需求，减少大政府干预；5) 为投资者提供更大、更快、风险更低的利润机会，同时为利益相关者创造新的利益渠道。

title: Network Motifs and the Rise of Entrepreneurial Ecosystems

detail.title: Network Motifs and the Rise of Entrepreneurial Ecosystems
detail.abstract: Entrepreneurial ecosystem research has focused on macro-level configurations, yet the micro-level network structures underpinning ecosystem emergence remain underexplored. I introduce network motif analysis (the study of small recurring subgraphs) to entrepreneurial finance research, examining how emerging patterns in venture capital co-investment networks predict ecosystem rise. Analyzing 29 U.S. state ecosystems from 2015 to 2024, I identify distinct motif signatures for different trajectories. Booming ecosystems display squares and pentagons, i.e. extended trust chains reflecting "friends of friends of friends" logic. Established ecosystems exhibit triangles and hexagons, which are dense, orchestrated structures. Critically, heterogeneous motifs incorporating investors who differ by type, previous success rate, or vintage predict sustained growth more reliably than homogeneous patterns. These findings bridge micro-level network interdependencies with macro-level regional performance, offering policymakers actionable diagnostic tools for catalyzing entrepreneurial growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究将网络模体分析引入创业金融研究，发现风险投资联合投资网络中的微观网络结构模式能够预测创业生态系统的崛起轨迹。繁荣生态系统呈现"朋友的朋友的朋友"信任链模式，而成熟生态系统则显示密集协调结构。
AI.research_question: 创业生态系统中的微观网络结构（特别是风险投资联合投资网络中的网络模体模式）如何预测生态系统的崛起轨迹？
AI.motivation: 现有创业生态系统研究主要关注宏观配置，而支撑生态系统涌现的微观网络结构尚未得到充分探索。需要理解微观层面的网络互依关系如何影响宏观层面的区域表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络科学理论（特别是网络模体分析）、创业生态系统理论、社会网络理论、风险投资网络理论
AI.method: 网络模体分析（研究小型重复子图），分析2015-2024年美国29个州生态系统的风险投资联合投资网络数据
AI.findings: 1. 繁荣生态系统显示正方形和五边形模体（扩展信任链）；2. 成熟生态系统显示三角形和六边形模体（密集协调结构）；3. 异质性模体（包含不同类型、成功记录或投资阶段的投资者）比同质性模式更能可靠预测持续增长
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将网络模体分析引入创业金融研究；2. 连接微观网络互依关系与宏观区域表现；3. 识别不同生态系统轨迹的独特模体特征
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供可操作的诊断工具，用于催化创业增长，通过分析投资网络模式来评估和干预生态系统发展

title: European Standards Within the Scope of Foreigners Detention

detail.title: European Standards Within the Scope of Foreigners Detention
detail.abstract: The article refers to the standards within the scope of performing an administrative and legal measure depending on placing a foreigner in a guarded detention centre while waiting to return to the country of origin or for the application for international protection to be reviewed. The study focuses on the guarantees that result from Directive 2008/115/EC, which constitutes a basic instrument for harmonising legislation of EU Member States within the scope of detention of third country citizens. The source of inspiration for the EU legislator has been, and still is, the case law of the European Court of Human Rights, which has resulted in significant directives of interpretation in relation to the law of European states − creating a high standard of protection of foreigners’ rights. The guarantees concerning the detention of third country nationals, which have been put forward to date, are currently being verified mainly due to the ongoing migration crisis in the European Union and the related pressure on the pace of implementing the solutions that oblige foreigners to return.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了欧盟成员国在将外国人安置在拘留中心等待遣返或庇护申请审查时的行政法律措施标准，重点关注欧盟第2008/115/EC号指令提供的保障措施，以及欧洲人权法院判例法对欧盟立法的影响，并探讨当前移民危机对这些保障措施的验证压力。
AI.research_question: 欧盟成员国在将第三国公民安置在拘留中心等待遣返或庇护申请审查时，应遵循哪些行政法律标准？欧盟第2008/115/EC号指令和欧洲人权法院判例法如何影响和保障被拘留外国人的权利？
AI.motivation: 欧盟面临持续的移民危机，成员国在实施遣返解决方案时面临压力，这促使对现有外国人拘留保障措施进行验证。需要研究欧盟指令和欧洲人权法院判例法如何为被拘留外国人提供权利保护标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟法律框架（特别是第2008/115/EC号指令）、欧洲人权法院判例法、行政法律措施理论、外国人权利保护标准理论、欧盟成员国法律协调理论。
AI.method: 法律文献分析、欧盟指令文本分析、欧洲人权法院判例法分析、比较法律研究方法、行政法律措施标准分析。
AI.findings: 欧盟第2008/115/EC号指令为成员国拘留第三国公民提供了基本法律框架；欧洲人权法院判例法对欧盟立法产生重要影响，创造了外国人权利保护的高标准；当前移民危机对现有拘留保障措施构成验证压力，可能影响遣返解决方案的实施节奏。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对欧盟法律与欧洲人权法院判例法互动关系的理解；提出了欧盟成员国法律协调在外国人拘留领域的理论框架；分析了行政法律措施标准在移民危机背景下的演变机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟成员国实施外国人拘留措施提供法律标准参考；帮助政策制定者平衡移民危机应对与外国人权利保护；为法律实践者提供欧盟指令和判例法解释的指导；促进欧盟成员国在外国人拘留方面的法律协调。

title: Enhancing Airline Safety Management: Strategic Insights into KPI-driven Oversight
affiliations: and Payame Noor University

detail.title: Enhancing Airline Safety Management: Strategic Insights into KPI-driven Oversight

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently and reflects the authors’ academic and professional analysis of airline safety management systems and KPI-based oversight frameworks. Any affiliations with aviation organizations are purely professional and did not influence the design, analysis, interpretation, or reporting of the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental interventions. The research is based on conceptual modeling, publicly available industry standards (e.g., ICAO Safety Management System frameworks), and organizational performance management principles. Therefore, formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding from public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted as part of the authors’ independent academic research activities in airline management and safety performance governance.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve a clinical trial or medical intervention.

detail.abstract: This study rigorously explores the pivotal role of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in advancing airline safety management, addressing the necessity for a systematic, data-driven approach to enhancing safety measures, compliance, and culture within the airline industry. Through a mixed-methods research design combining quantitative analysis of safety performance data and qualitative insights from industry professionals, the study identifies and evaluates a comprehensive set of safety KPIs integral to operational safety, regulatory adherence, and the promotion of a proactive safety culture. The findings reveal that specific KPIs, notably those related to proactive safety actions and employee safety engagement, significantly contribute to improving safety protocols and outcomes. By integrating these KPIs into their safety management systems, airlines can not only meet but exceed regulatory standards, setting new benchmarks for safety excellence. The research underscores the strategic importance of KPIs in facilitating a proactive, anticipatory approach to safety management, moving beyond compliance to foster continuous improvement and a robust safety culture. This study contributes to both theoretical frameworks and practical applications in airline safety management, offering actionable insights for Chief Safety Officers and delineating future research directions to further enhance airline safety standards.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法研究设计，探索关键绩效指标(KPIs)在提升航空公司安全管理中的关键作用，发现与主动安全行动和员工安全参与相关的KPIs能显著改善安全协议和结果，为航空公司超越合规标准提供实用指导。
AI.research_question: 关键绩效指标(KPIs)在推动航空公司安全管理、提升安全措施、合规性和安全文化方面扮演什么关键角色？
AI.motivation: 航空业需要系统化、数据驱动的方法来提升安全措施、合规性和安全文化，但目前缺乏对KPIs在这一过程中具体作用的深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全管理理论、绩效管理理论、组织安全文化理论、合规管理理论。
AI.method: 混合方法研究设计：结合安全绩效数据的定量分析和行业专业人士的定性见解。
AI.findings: 研究发现特定的KPIs，特别是与主动安全行动和员工安全参与相关的指标，能显著改善安全协议和结果；通过将KPIs整合到安全管理系统中，航空公司不仅能满足还能超越监管标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了安全管理理论，特别是KPIs在促进主动、预期性安全管理方法方面的理论框架；为从合规性管理向持续改进和强大安全文化转变提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为首席安全官提供可操作的见解；帮助航空公司识别和评估全面的安全KPIs；提供超越监管标准的具体方法；为设定新的安全卓越基准提供指导。

title: Elevating Airline Design and Production Excellence: A Strategic KPI Framework for DOA and POA Officers
affiliations: and Aachen University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Elevating Airline Design and Production Excellence: A Strategic KPI Framework for DOA and POA Officers
detail.abstract: This study delves into the development and application of a Key Performance Indicator (KPI)-driven framework tailored for Design Organization Approval (DOA) and Production Organization Approval (POA) officers in the airline industry. It aims to elucidate how strategic alignment of KPIs with organizational objectives can significantly enhance the efficiency, compliance, and innovation in airline design and production processes. Employing a mixed-methods research approach, the study combines quantitative data analysis with qualitative insights from industry surveys, case studies, and direct observations. The findings reveal that a well-structured KPI framework not only optimizes operational processes but also fosters a culture of continuous improvement and strategic decision-making. By systematically analyzing various KPIs related to design and production efficiency, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, project management, innovation, supplier management, sustainability, and financial performance, the research underscores the pivotal role of KPIs in driving industry excellence. The study offers actionable insights for DOA and POA officers, suggesting the integration of KPIs into strategic planning and day-today operations as a means to navigate the complexities of modern aviation and achieve organizational goals. This research contributes to the existing body of knowledge by highlighting the multidimensional impact of KPIs and proposing a dynamic, adaptable framework for continuous operational enhancement in the highly regulated airline industry.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并应用了一个针对航空公司DOA和POA官员的KPI驱动框架，通过战略性地将KPI与组织目标对齐，显著提升航空设计和生产过程的效率、合规性和创新性。
AI.research_question: 如何为航空公司的DOA和POA官员开发和应用KPI驱动框架，以通过战略性的KPI与组织目标对齐来提升设计生产过程的效率、合规性和创新性？
AI.motivation: 航空行业高度监管且复杂，DOA和POA官员需要有效的工具来管理设计生产流程。现有研究缺乏专门针对这一群体的KPI框架，无法充分支持战略决策和持续改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关键绩效指标(KPI)理论、战略对齐理论、组织绩效管理理论、质量管理理论、合规管理理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：结合定量数据分析与行业调查、案例研究、直接观察的定性洞察
AI.findings: 结构良好的KPI框架不仅能优化运营流程，还能培养持续改进和战略决策的文化。KPI在推动行业卓越方面发挥关键作用，涵盖设计生产效率、质量保证、法规合规、项目管理、创新、供应商管理、可持续性和财务绩效等多个维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了KPI的多维影响，提出了一个动态、可适应的框架，丰富了航空行业绩效管理的理论体系，为高度监管行业的运营改进提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DOA和POA官员提供可操作的见解，建议将KPI整合到战略规划和日常运营中，帮助应对现代航空的复杂性并实现组织目标。

title: The Operating Architec
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Operating Architec

contentType.other: my initial framework anbd thinking for the boopk titled the opwerating architect

detail.abstract: How the role of HR is evolving in today's Modern organisation. Every era produces the HR role it requires. Not because HR reinvents itself by choice, but because organisations evolve faster than the assumptions embedded in existing HR models. When the context changes, roles that once created value begin to feel misaligned. This is rarely a capability problem. It is a design problem. HR Champions emerged at a time when organisations were becoming large, complex, and global. Its contribution was not a set of tools. It clarified what HR must become for institutions that had already stabilised.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了HR角色在现代组织中的演变，指出HR角色的变化不是主动选择的结果，而是组织发展超越了现有HR模型假设的必然结果。当环境变化时，曾经创造价值的角色会变得不匹配，这通常不是能力问题而是设计问题。
AI.research_question: HR角色如何随着现代组织的发展而演变？为什么HR角色的变化是组织环境变化的结果而非主动选择？
AI.motivation: 每个时代都会产生其所需的HR角色，因为组织的发展速度超过了现有HR模型中嵌入的假设。当环境变化时，曾经创造价值的角色开始显得不匹配，这通常不是能力问题而是设计问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织演变理论、角色设计理论、HR模型与环境匹配理论
AI.method: 理论分析、历史比较分析、案例研究（基于HR Champion的出现背景）
AI.findings: HR Champion角色出现在组织变得大型、复杂和全球化时期，其贡献不在于提供工具集，而在于为已经稳定的机构明确了HR必须成为什么。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了HR角色演变的环境驱动理论，强调角色不匹配是设计问题而非能力问题，为理解HR职能的适应性变化提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织认识到HR角色需要根据组织发展阶段和环境变化进行重新设计，为HR职能转型提供了实践指导。

title: Communication in the Digital Age: The Impact of Communication Skills and Cultural Restraint on the Use of Social Media Platforms in the Case of Jordan

detail.title: Communication in the Digital Age: The Impact of Communication Skills and Cultural Restraint on the Use of Social Media Platforms in the Case of Jordan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with ethical standards and was approved by the Department of Information and Communication Technology at Jadara University (Protocol code: 10/113-4, approval date: 01 April 2024).
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of social media platforms has fundamentally transformed communication dynamics globally. This study investigates the impact of communication skills on social media usage, emphasizing the moderating role of cultural restraint within the context of Jordan. Employing a quantitative research design, data were collected from 415 young adult social media users through an online survey and analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) via SmartPLS 4 software. The findings suggest that individuals with strong communication skills are more effective at using social media, supporting the ideas of Self-Efficacy Theory and Social Capital Theory, which propose that better communication abilities lead to more proficient social media usage. However, this positive relationship is moderated by cultural restraint, with higher levels of cultural restraint weakening the impact of communication skills on social media engagement. These results highlight the necessity of culturally sensitive approaches when promoting social media engagement, as cultural norms and values significantly influence digital behaviors. This study contributes to the existing literature by providing empirical evidence from a non-Western context and underscores the complex interplay between individual abilities and cultural factors in shaping social media usage. Future research should explore additional moderating variables and consider longitudinal and cross-cultural studies to further elucidate these dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨沟通技巧对社交媒体使用的影响，并检验文化约束在约旦情境下的调节作用。研究发现沟通技巧强的个体社交媒体使用更有效，但文化约束会削弱这种正向关系。
AI.research_question: 沟通技巧如何影响社交媒体使用？文化约束在约旦情境下如何调节这种关系？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体平台在全球范围内的快速普及从根本上改变了沟通动态，但现有研究缺乏对非西方文化背景下个体能力与文化因素交互作用的深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我效能理论（Self-Efficacy Theory）和社会资本理论（Social Capital Theory），强调沟通能力如何影响社交媒体使用效能。
AI.method: 定量研究设计，通过在线调查收集415名约旦年轻成年社交媒体用户数据，使用SmartPLS 4软件进行结构方程模型（SEM）分析。
AI.findings: 沟通技巧强的个体社交媒体使用更有效，支持自我效能和社会资本理论。但文化约束调节这种关系，文化约束水平越高，沟通技巧对社交媒体参与的影响越弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 为沟通技巧与社交媒体使用关系提供了非西方文化背景的实证证据，揭示了文化因素在数字行为中的重要作用，丰富了跨文化社交媒体研究理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调在促进社交媒体参与时需要采取文化敏感的方法，因为文化规范和价值观显著影响数字行为，为社交媒体平台和营销策略提供文化适应建议。

title: The Use of Multimedia in Newspapers: A Study on the Websites of Emirati Newspapers

detail.title: The Use of Multimedia in Newspapers: A Study on the Websites of Emirati Newspapers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Studies in Media and Communication Vol. 12, No. 2; June 2024

detail.abstract: The competition faced by journalistic websites has imposed the necessity of taking advantage of the capabilities offered by the Internet so that it can provide more distinguished journalistic services, to attract the largest number of users, as the strength of a newspaper website is measured by the number of people browsing it on the one hand, and the period that the user spends on it, The research problem is to monitor the use of multimedia websites of Emirati newspapers (Al-Ittihad, Al-Bayan, Al-Khaleej). The study aimed to determine the extent to which Emirati newspapers use multimedia in their websites during the study period (January-March 2023), and the key elements they used to present and publish their news to the audience. This study used the descriptive analytical approach for 14 issues of each newspaper on their websites, and several results were obtained, the most important of which are: The newspapers sampled for the study relied mainly on pictures, using them in 1272 out of 1632 media, with a percentage of 77.9%. The use of audio clips ranked second, with 218 clips out of 1632 media and a percentage of 13.3%. Al-Khaleej newspaper ranked first with 212 clips out of the total clips used, with a large margin of 97.25%, as it distinguished itself by using audio clips in every news story and alongside every video as an additional feature. Al-Ittihad newspaper only used 6 audio blogs, with a percentage of 2.75% out of 218 clips, followed by videos in third place with 100 videos out of the total media used, with a percentage of 6.1%. Infographics came in fourth place in terms of using multimedia, with 42 infographics, accounting for 2.7% of the total multimedia used.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了阿联酋三家报纸网站在2023年1-3月期间对多媒体元素的使用情况，发现图片是最主要的多媒体形式（77.9%），其次是音频（13.3%）、视频（6.1%）和信息图表（2.7%）。Al-Khaleej报纸在音频使用方面表现突出。
AI.research_question: 阿联酋报纸网站如何利用多媒体元素来呈现和发布新闻内容？具体来说，在2023年1-3月期间，Al-Ittihad、Al-Bayan和Al-Khaleej这三家报纸网站在多媒体使用方面有哪些特点和差异？
AI.motivation: 新闻网站面临激烈竞争，需要充分利用互联网功能提供更优质的新闻服务以吸引更多用户。网站的实力通常通过浏览人数和用户停留时间来衡量，因此研究报纸网站如何有效利用多媒体元素具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于数字新闻学理论和多媒体传播理论，探讨新闻网站在数字时代如何通过多媒体元素增强新闻呈现效果和用户体验。
AI.method: 采用描述性分析方法，对三家阿联酋报纸网站（Al-Ittihad、Al-Bayan、Al-Khaleej）在2023年1-3月期间的14期内容进行内容分析，统计各类多媒体元素的使用情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为数字新闻学提供了阿联酋语境下的实证数据；2. 揭示了不同多媒体元素在新闻网站中的使用优先级和分布模式；3. 为理解新闻网站的多媒体策略提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为新闻网站编辑提供多媒体内容策略的参考；2. 帮助报纸网站优化多媒体资源配置；3. 为新闻从业者提供提升网站吸引力和用户参与度的具体建议。

title: Legitimacy Under Constraint: LUC A Pre-Adjudicative Framework for Containing and Terminating Lawful Authority
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Legitimacy Under Constraint: LUC A Pre-Adjudicative Framework for Containing and Terminating Lawful Authority
detail.abstract: This paper introduces Legitimacy Under Constraint (LUC), a pre-adjudicative, nonauthoritative governance framework designed to diagnose, contain, and terminate legitimacy erosion arising from lawful decision-making under real constraints. Across administrative, regulatory, emergency, and security contexts, governments frequently act within legal and procedural bounds while experiencing declining legitimacy, responsibility diffusion, and escalating public risk. Existing mechanisms-judicial review, political accountability, and executive justification-intervene late or incompletely, often after escalation has already occurred.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"约束下的合法性"（LUC）框架，这是一种预裁决、非权威的治理框架，旨在诊断、遏制和终止因现实约束下的合法决策导致的合法性侵蚀。
AI.research_question: 在行政、监管、应急和安全等情境中，政府如何在法律和程序范围内行动的同时，应对合法性下降、责任扩散和公共风险升级的问题？
AI.motivation: 政府经常在法律和程序范围内行动，却面临合法性下降、责任扩散和公共风险升级的问题。现有的司法审查、政治问责和行政解释机制干预过晚或不完全，往往在问题升级后才介入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合法性理论、治理理论、决策理论，特别是关注约束条件下的合法决策与合法性维护之间的关系。
AI.method: 概念框架开发，提出"约束下的合法性"（LUC）作为诊断、遏制和终止合法性侵蚀的治理框架。
AI.findings: 提出了一个预裁决、非权威的治理框架，能够在问题升级前识别和处理合法性侵蚀问题，弥补现有机制的不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了合法性理论，特别是在约束条件下的合法性维护机制；提出了"约束下的合法性"这一新概念框架；丰富了治理理论中的预裁决干预机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府部门提供了早期识别和处理合法性问题的实用工具；有助于预防公共风险升级；改善政府决策的合法性和公众信任。

title: Trust in Social Media: Enhancing Social Relationships

detail.title: Trust in Social Media: Enhancing Social Relationships
detail.abstract: This study aims to explore the moderating effect of trust on the relationship between social media engagement, relationship benefits, and social relationships, utilizing an innovative framework grounded in social exchange theory. Employing a quantitative analysis with structural equation modeling (SEM), using a questionnaire distributed to a sample of 493 Jordanian youth, the results unveil a positive correlation between social media engagement and social relationships, with trust emerging as a crucial moderator in this dynamic. Trust positively moderates the connection between social media engagement and social relationships. This research sheds light on the pivotal role of trust in shaping social relationships on social media platforms. However, the interaction between trust and relationship benefits does not significantly impact social relationships. By expanding on existing knowledge, this study offers a fresh perspective on the interplay between trust, social media engagement, relationship benefits, and social relationships, emphasizing the potential of understanding trust to foster stronger social connections in the digital age. The results suggest that the positive influence of social media engagement on social relationships possibly will be determined by the level of trust present inside online communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于社会交换理论，探讨信任在社交媒体参与、关系利益与社会关系之间的调节作用。通过对493名约旦青年的问卷调查和结构方程模型分析，发现社交媒体参与与社会关系正相关，而信任在这一关系中起关键调节作用。但信任与关系利益的交互作用对社会关系影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 信任如何调节社交媒体参与、关系利益与社会关系之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 在数字时代，理解信任在社交媒体环境中如何影响社会关系至关重要。现有研究对信任在社交媒体参与和社会关系之间的调节作用关注不足，需要探索信任如何塑造在线社交互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会交换理论（Social Exchange Theory）
AI.method: 定量研究方法，采用问卷调查收集493名约旦青年的数据，使用结构方程模型（SEM）进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 社交媒体参与与社会关系呈正相关；2. 信任正向调节社交媒体参与与社会关系之间的关系；3. 信任与关系利益的交互作用对社会关系影响不显著；4. 社交媒体参与对社会关系的积极影响可能取决于在线社区中的信任水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 基于社会交换理论提出了创新的理论框架；2. 揭示了信任在社交媒体环境中的关键调节作用；3. 拓展了对信任、社交媒体参与、关系利益和社会关系之间相互作用的理解；4. 为数字时代的社会关系研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为社交媒体平台设计者提供启示，强调建立信任机制的重要性；2. 帮助在线社区管理者理解如何通过培养信任来增强社会关系；3. 为个人用户提供指导，了解信任在数字社交中的关键作用；4. 为组织在社交媒体上的关系管理提供实践建议。

title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence in Social Media Analysis: Enhancing Public Communication Through Data Science

detail.title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence in Social Media Analysis: Enhancing Public Communication Through Data Science
detail.abstract: This study examines the role of AI tools in improving public communication via social media analysis. It reviews five of the top platforms-Google Cloud Natural Language, IBM Watson NLU, Hootsuite Insights, Talkwalker Analytics, and Sprout Social-to determine their accuracy in detecting sentiment, predicting trends, optimally timing content, and enhancing messaging engagement. Adopting a structured model approach and Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) via SMART PLS, this research uses 500 influencer posts from five Arab countries. The results demonstrate the impactful relationships between AI tool functions and communication outcomes: the utilization of text analysis tools significantly improved public engagement (β = 0.62, p = 0.001), trend forecasting tools improved strategic planning decisions (β = 0.74, p < 0.001), and timing optimization tools enhanced message efficacy (β = 0.59, p = 0.004). Beyond the technical dimensions, the study addresses urgent ethical considerations by outlining a fiveprinciple ethical governance model that encourages transparency, fairness, privacy, human oversee of technologies, and institutional accountability considering data bias, algorithmic opacity, and over-reliance on automated solutions. The research adds a multidimensional framework for propelling AI into digital public communication in culturally sensitive and linguistically diverse environments and provides a blueprint for improving AI integration.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨AI工具如何通过社交媒体分析改善公共传播，评估五大平台在情感分析、趋势预测、内容时机优化和参与度提升方面的准确性，并建立包含伦理考量的多维框架。
AI.research_question: AI工具在社交媒体分析中如何影响公共传播效果？具体来说，文本分析、趋势预测和时机优化功能如何影响公众参与度、战略决策和消息效能？
AI.motivation: 随着AI工具在社交媒体分析中的广泛应用，需要系统评估其对公共传播的实际影响，特别是在文化敏感和语言多样的环境中，同时解决相关的伦理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用结构化模型方法和PLS-SEM分析框架，结合技术功能与传播结果的关系模型，并引入包含透明度、公平性、隐私、人类监督和机构问责的五原则伦理治理模型。
AI.method: 使用SMART PLS进行偏最小二乘结构方程建模(PLS-SEM)，分析来自五个阿拉伯国家的500个影响者帖子，评估Google Cloud Natural Language、IBM Watson NLU、Hootsuite Insights、Talkwalker Analytics和Sprout Social五大平台。
AI.findings: 文本分析工具显著提升公众参与度(β=0.62, p=0.001)；趋势预测工具改善战略规划决策(β=0.74, p<0.001)；时机优化工具增强消息效能(β=0.59, p=0.004)。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个多维框架，将AI技术功能与传播结果联系起来，扩展了数字公共传播理论，特别关注文化敏感和语言多样性环境中的AI应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了AI工具选择和应用指南，建立了五原则伦理治理模型（透明度、公平性、隐私、人类监督、机构问责），帮助解决数据偏见、算法不透明和过度依赖自动化等问题。

title: Full Version Market Pricing Learning And The Discovery Of Option Valuation Frameworks: Evolution Of The Efficient Markets Hypothesis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Full Version Market Pricing Learning And The Discovery Of Option Valuation Frameworks: Evolution Of The Efficient Markets Hypothesis

keywords: market learning JEL Codes: G14 (Information and Market Efficiency)

detail.abstract:
Ocean Tomo documents that intangible assets grew from 17% of S&P 500 market value in 1975 to 68% by 1995, crossing the 50% threshold in the early 1990s. This proportion has continued growing to 90% by 2020. The conventional explanation - that intangible assets "became more important" - is circular and fails to explain the reason, timing, mechanism, or persistence of this shift.

Building on Lo's (2004, 2017) Adaptive Markets Hypothesis, we propose that markets fundamentally changed their valuation methodology. Historically, company values were calculated using discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis alone. Since the mid-1990s, markets have adopted a hybrid valuation framework combining DCF for linear operations with real options valuation for embedded strategic optionality created by intangible assets. The value created by real options requires the existence of the real options, the ability to identify the real options by management, and, critically, the ability to exercise the real options properly.

What researchers call "intangible assets" (brands, R&D, customer relationships, platforms) create embedded real options - growth options, flexibility options, learning options, and platform options. These capabilities existed before 1995, but markets lacked the valuation framework to price the optionality they generated. The crossing of the 50% threshold in the early 1990s created salience that triggered valuation framework discovery. High-visibility exemplars (Microsoft, Amazon, Google) made option value legible, and the hybrid DCF + Options valuation framework diffused across sectors through the mid-to-late 1990s.

This valuation framework extends Lo's Adaptive Markets Hypothesis by specifying the learning mechanism: markets discover novel valuation frameworks when patterns cross salience thresholds. Rather than instantly pricing all available information as EMH assumes, markets require pattern salience before valuation framework discovery occurs. This reinterpretation also provides new perspective on "irrational exuberance", market bubbles, and “ridiculous” PE multiples, suggesting that what appeared as ridiculous valuations may have partly reflected rational options pricing during valuation framework learning, with behavioral overshoot as a smaller component. It also provides a mechanism to explain why companies with a history of losses can support multi-billion valuations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出无形资产占比增长并非因为其变得"更重要"，而是因为市场在1990年代中期发现了新的估值框架：结合传统DCF和实物期权估值法，从而能够合理评估无形资产创造的嵌入式战略期权价值。
AI.research_question: 为什么无形资产在S&P 500市值中的占比从1975年的17%增长到2020年的90%，特别是在1990年代早期跨越50%阈值？
AI.motivation: 传统解释（无形资产"变得更重要"）是循环论证，无法解释这一转变的原因、时机、机制和持续性。需要新的理论框架来解释市场估值方法的根本变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Lo（2004, 2017）的适应性市场假说，提出市场估值框架转变理论：从单纯使用DCF分析转变为DCF+实物期权混合估值框架。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合历史数据分析（Ocean Tomo数据）和概念性论证，通过高可见度案例（微软、亚马逊、谷歌）说明估值框架的扩散过程。
AI.findings: 无形资产创造嵌入式实物期权（增长期权、灵活性期权、学习期权、平台期权）。1990年代早期跨越50%阈值创造了显著性，触发了估值框架的发现。市场通过模式显著性阈值学习新的估值方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了适应性市场假说，具体化了学习机制：当模式跨越显著性阈值时，市场发现新的估值框架。挑战了有效市场假说关于市场能即时定价所有信息的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为"非理性繁荣"、市场泡沫和"荒谬"市盈率倍数提供新解释：部分反映了估值框架学习期间合理的期权定价。解释了亏损公司为何能获得数十亿美元估值。

title: Frameworks for the Talk Shows in the American Al Hurra Channel Dealing with the Issues of Arab Countries

detail.title: Frameworks for the Talk Shows in the American Al Hurra Channel Dealing with the Issues of Arab Countries

publicationDetails.detailsText: Dirasat Human and Social Sciences, Volume 49, Issue 3, pp. 194-210

detail.abstract: This study aims to investigate the frameworks for the talk shows in the American Al-Hurra channel dealing with the issues of Arab countries, and it is considered one of the descriptive and analytical studies, as it relied on analyzing the content of the episodes of the weekly talk show "The Four Bodies" on the (Al-Hurra American) channel during the period between (December 1, 2016-January 1) 2017), which was the first term of the presidency of the forty-fifth US President Donald Trump and was full of political decisions issued by President Trump and had a direct relationship with the Arab countries. Among most prominent results was that Al-Hurra channel deals with issues related to Arab countries, especially political issues, specifically Trump and foreign policy towards Arab countries. It also showed that the direction of dialogue in the Al Hurra channel for topics related to Arab countries issues has a positive trend, and it used the silent video in the background as a supportive material in addressing the issues are based on opinion dialogue with more than one person, the main figure, and relied on researchers who support the issues at hand. American citizens, also demonstrated the channel's reliance on political frameworks and ambitions in dealing with Arab countries 'issues through the method of presenting opinions and ideas, especially the mixed public and political decision-makers in the countries. Case owner.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国Al-Hurra频道谈话节目处理阿拉伯国家议题的框架，发现该频道主要关注特朗普时期政治议题，采用积极对话导向，并依赖政治框架和专家意见。
AI.research_question: 美国Al-Hurra频道谈话节目处理阿拉伯国家议题的框架是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究Al-Hurra频道在特朗普总统第一任期（2016-2017年）期间如何通过谈话节目框架讨论阿拉伯国家议题，特别是特朗普政府相关政策决定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内容分析框架、媒体框架理论、政治传播理论
AI.method: 描述性分析研究，采用内容分析方法分析Al-Hurra频道每周谈话节目"The Four Bodies"在2016年12月1日至2017年1月1日期间的节目内容。
AI.findings: 1. Al-Hurra频道主要处理与阿拉伯国家相关的政治议题，特别是特朗普外交政策；2. 对话方向呈现积极趋势；3. 使用背景静音视频作为支持材料；4. 采用多人意见对话形式；5. 依赖支持议题的研究人员和美国公民；6. 频道依赖政治框架和决策者混合意见处理阿拉伯国家议题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为阿拉伯媒体研究提供了关于美国阿拉伯语频道框架分析的实证案例，丰富了政治传播中媒体框架理论的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解美国官方阿拉伯语媒体如何构建阿拉伯国家议题，为政策制定者、媒体从业者和研究人员提供参考，了解媒体如何影响公众对阿拉伯国家政治议题的认知。

title: Shadow Empress: A Structural Analysis of Media Oligarchy, Capital Concentration, and Narrative Control in the Asian Entertainment Ecosystem
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Shadow Empress: A Structural Analysis of Media Oligarchy, Capital Concentration, and Narrative Control in the Asian Entertainment Ecosystem
detail.abstract: This working paper investigates the "Shadow Empress" phenomenon-a conceptual archetype representing a central sovereign actor within the Asian entertainment industry who leverages oligarchic capital to exercise absolute narrative control. Utilizing a multitheoretical framework-including Goffman's Dramaturgy (1959), Bourdieu's Symbolic Dominance (1989), and Herman & Chomsky's Propaganda Model (1988)-this study reveals a "King Class" operation. In this system, multi-billion dollar media infrastructures are subordinated to private existential agendas. Through a qualitative structural analysis, the research identifies the Elite-Logistical Triad: Financial (Capital Concentration), Strategic (Risk Mitigation), and Communicative (Hyperreality). The research finds that oligarchic capital concentration creates a profound structural dependency, enabling a singular figure to bypass market filters and utilize mass-market content as a personal communication tool. The paper argues that this dominance reverses traditional media logic, effectively turning global production studios into personal "writing tools" for elite figures. The paper concludes by proposing the MCIBR and OZII/OZINomy frameworks as systemic solutions to bridge the Elite Drift and restore institutional accountability in an era of anonymous power.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了亚洲娱乐产业中的"影子女皇"现象——一个利用寡头资本行使绝对叙事控制权的中央主权行为者概念原型。研究发现，数十亿美元的媒体基础设施被私人存在议程所支配，形成了精英-物流三重结构，将全球制作工作室转变为精英人物的个人"写作工具"。
AI.research_question: 亚洲娱乐产业中"影子女皇"现象如何通过寡头资本集中实现绝对叙事控制，以及这种控制如何颠覆传统媒体逻辑？
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于揭示亚洲娱乐产业中匿名权力结构的运作机制，特别是寡头资本如何将大规模媒体基础设施转化为个人叙事工具，以及这种权力集中对文化产业民主化的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用多理论框架：戈夫曼的戏剧理论（1959）、布迪厄的符号支配理论（1989）、赫尔曼和乔姆斯基的宣传模型（1988），共同构建分析"国王阶级"运作的理论基础。
AI.method: 定性结构分析，识别精英-物流三重结构：金融（资本集中）、战略（风险缓解）和传播（超现实）。
AI.findings: 寡头资本集中创造了深刻的结构性依赖，使单一人物能够绕过市场筛选机制，将大众市场内容用作个人传播工具。这种支配颠覆了传统媒体逻辑，将全球制作工作室转变为精英人物的个人"写作工具"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"影子女皇"概念原型，发展了"国王阶级"运作理论，识别了精英-物流三重结构，为理解匿名权力在文化产业中的运作提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了MCIBR和OZII/OZINomy框架作为系统性解决方案，以弥合精英漂移，在匿名权力时代恢复制度问责制，为文化产业治理提供实践指导。

title: Adaptive Energy Field Theory (AEFT) – Facilities Management Model
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Adaptive Energy Field Theory (AEFT) – Facilities Management Model
detail.abstract: Apartment facilities are complex energy systems where residents, staff, and vendors interact across time and space. Resistances arise from structural limitations, operational inefficiencies, and human energy misalignments, reducing harmony and efficiency. This paper applies Adaptive Energy Field Theory (AEFT) to identify these resistances and provide practical interventions in Structural, Operational, and Human energy layers. Solutions include spatial zoning, Tower Executive operation days, staff training, interaction protocols, and digital support via WhatsApp chatbots. AEFT is proposed as a systematic framework for research and application in apartment facility management.

AI.tldr: 该论文应用自适应能量场理论（AEFT）分析公寓设施中的能量阻力，并提出跨结构、运营和人力三个能量层的干预措施，以提高和谐度与效率。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和解决公寓设施中因结构限制、运营低效和人力能量错配而产生的阻力，以提升系统和谐度与效率？
AI.motivation: 公寓设施是复杂的能量系统，居民、员工和供应商在时空维度上互动，但存在结构限制、运营低效和人力能量错配等问题，导致和谐度与效率降低，需要系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应能量场理论（AEFT）作为核心理论框架，用于分析公寓设施中的能量流动和阻力，重点关注结构、运营和人力三个能量层。
AI.method: 应用AEFT框架识别公寓设施中的阻力，并提出具体干预措施，包括空间分区、塔楼执行运营日、员工培训、互动协议和WhatsApp聊天机器人数字支持等。
AI.findings: 通过AEFT分析识别了公寓设施中的多重阻力，并提出了针对结构、运营和人力能量层的具体解决方案，这些干预措施能够提升系统和谐度与效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AEFT理论系统性地应用于公寓设施管理领域，扩展了该理论的应用范围，为复杂社会技术系统的能量分析提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的实践干预措施，包括空间设计优化、运营流程改进、人员培训方案、互动协议制定和数字化支持工具，可直接应用于公寓设施管理实践。

title: An Extension of Adaptive Energy Field Theory (AEFT) – Facilities Management Model - Managing Apartment Site Takeover and Early Operations
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: An Extension of Adaptive Energy Field Theory (AEFT) – Facilities Management Model - Managing Apartment Site Takeover and Early Operations
detail.abstract: Apartment facilities operate as complex socio-technical systems where residents, staff, contractors, and stakeholders interact continuously. Operational instability often arises not from isolated failures, but from misalignment between structural design, operational processes, and human behavior. This paper presents an applied Adaptive Energy Field Theory (AEFT)-Facilities Management Model, using AEFT as a unifying conceptual lens while implementing solutions through operationally grounded facilities management practices. Key interventions include Operational Boundary Integrity (AEFT: Energy Boundary Regulation), workload stabilization, contractor containment strategies, digital communication tools, and structured stakeholder alignment. The model is developed from real operational conditions in apartment sites and is positioned as both a practical FM solution and a research-based framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于自适应能量场理论（AEFT）的设施管理模型，用于解决公寓设施运营中的系统性问题，通过边界管理、工作负荷稳定、承包商控制等干预措施，实现结构设计、运营流程和人员行为的协调一致。
AI.research_question: 如何通过自适应能量场理论（AEFT）与设施管理实践相结合，解决公寓设施运营中因结构设计、运营流程和人员行为不协调导致的系统性不稳定问题？
AI.motivation: 公寓设施作为复杂的社会技术系统，运营不稳定往往源于结构设计、运营流程和人员行为之间的不协调，而非孤立故障。现有设施管理方法缺乏统一的理论框架来应对这种系统性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应能量场理论（AEFT）作为统一的概念框架，强调能量边界调节、系统动态平衡和利益相关者协调。
AI.method: 基于公寓设施实际运营条件开发的应用模型，结合理论框架与实地操作实践，包括边界完整性管理、工作负荷稳定化、承包商控制策略、数字沟通工具和结构化利益相关者协调等干预措施。
AI.findings: 提出的AEFT-设施管理模型能够有效协调公寓设施运营中的结构设计、流程和人员行为，减少系统性不稳定，同时作为实用的设施管理解决方案和研究框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自适应能量场理论（AEFT）应用于设施管理领域，提供了一个统一的概念框架来分析复杂社会技术系统的运营稳定性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可直接应用于公寓设施管理的操作模型，包括具体的干预措施如边界管理、工作负荷稳定、承包商控制等，为设施管理人员提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Northern Paper
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Northern Paper
detail.abstract:
This case provides a straightforward introduction to assessing cash flows, cost of capital, discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis, and the net present value (NPV) associated with a capital-investment decision. The case works well for all audiences who are learning the basics of DCF and investment analysis. The case is a fictional version of an actual investment decision made by a major paper-products company in the 1990s; it is an update and revision of UVA-F-1372.The case has been used successfully at the University of Virginia Darden School of Business with students and executives as an in-class exercise following introductory classes on cash flows, DCF, and cost of capital. The instructor can encourage participants to work in groups of two or three to bring together the concepts of the earlier classes in this simple but comprehensive capital-investment example.

Excerpt

Northern Paper

In May 2022, Blake Prescott, the controller for the Blue Ridge Mill, was considering the addition of a new on-site longwood woodyard. The addition would have two primary benefits: It would eliminate the need to purchase shortwood from an outside supplier, and it would create the opportunity to sell shortwood on the open market as a new market for Northern Paper. The new woodyard would allow the Blue Ridge Mill not only to reduce its operating costs but also to increase its revenues. The proposed woodyard would utilize new technology that allowed tree-length logs, called longwood, to be processed directly, whereas the current process required shortwood, which had to be purchased from the Shenandoah Mill. This nearby mill, owned by a competitor, had excess capacity that allowed it to produce more shortwood than it needed for its own pulp production. The excess was sold to several different mills, including the Blue Ridge Mill. Thus adding the new longwood equipment would mean that Prescott would no longer need to use the Shenandoah Mill as a shortwood supplier and that the Blue Ridge Mill would instead compete with the Shenandoah Mill by selling on the shortwood market. The question for Prescott was whether these expected benefits were enough to justify the $18 million capital outlay plus the incremental investment in working capital over the six-year life of the investment.

Construction would start within a few months, and the investment outlay would be spent over two calendar years: $16 million in 2022 and the remaining $2 million in 2023. When the new woodyard began operating in 2023, it would significantly reduce the operating costs of the mill. These operating savings would come mostly from the difference in the cost of producing shortwood on-site versus buying it on the open market; savings were estimated to be $2.0 million for 2023 and $3.5 million per year thereafter.

Prescott also planned on taking advantage of the excess production capacity afforded by the new facility by selling shortwood on the open market as soon as possible. For 2023, he expected to show revenues of approximately $2 million, as the facility came on line and began to break into the new market. He expected shortwood sales to reach $8 million in 2024 and continue at the $8 million level through 2028. Prescott estimated that the cost of goods sold (before including depreciation expenses) would be 75% of revenues, and selling, general, and administrative (SG&A) expenses would be 10% of revenues.

. . .

AI.tldr: 这是一个关于资本投资决策的教学案例，介绍如何评估现金流、资本成本、贴现现金流分析和净现值。案例基于一家造纸公司在1990年代的实际投资决策，用于教学DCF和投资分析的基础知识。
AI.research_question: Blue Ridge Mill是否应该投资1800万美元建设新的长木木材场？这项投资能否通过节省运营成本和增加销售收入来证明其合理性？
AI.motivation: 教学案例旨在帮助学习DCF和投资分析基础知识的学生和商业人士，通过一个简单但全面的资本投资示例，将现金流、资本成本和净现值等概念整合应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贴现现金流分析、净现值、资本成本、资本投资决策、现金流评估
AI.method: 教学案例分析方法，基于虚构但反映实际决策的情景，包含详细的财务数据（投资支出、运营节省、收入预测、成本结构等），要求进行DCF和NPV计算。
AI.findings: 案例本身不提供具体计算结果，而是设计为教学练习。学生需要基于提供的财务数据（1800万美元投资、运营节省、销售收入预测、成本结构等）计算净现值，以判断投资是否合理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个实用的教学框架，将DCF和NPV理论应用于实际的资本投资决策情境，帮助学生理解如何整合现金流、资本成本和投资评估等概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商学院学生和商业人士提供了一个结构化的资本投资分析练习，可用于课堂讨论和小组作业，培养实际财务决策分析能力。

title: What the History of Extinction Teaches Us: AI in Deep Historical Perspective
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: What the History of Extinction Teaches Us: AI in Deep Historical Perspective
detail.abstract:
Debates on artificial intelligence (AI) often focus on economic disruption, professional upheaval, algorithmic bias, privacy, safety, accountability, and governance. While these concerns are important in their own right, these concerns tend to emphasise narrowly defined technological risks over short timescales, especially when compared with the long history of life’s evolution, species survival, and extinction, including that of human ancestors. This policy brief offers a broader, long-term perspective grounded in deep history, drawing lessons from past episodes of human ancestor extinction. It highlights insights increasingly relevant today, particularly regarding AI’s influence on collective knowledge systems, its long-term effects on human expertise, epistemic concentration, the erosion of epistemic diversity and redundancy, and its role in reshaping collective cognition. It also considers how systemic fragility may develop gradually over time — a dimension largely absent from current AI debates. 

Research on cognition shows that thinking is embedded in everyday practices, tools, artefacts, and material interactions rather than confined to individual minds. Cognition emerges within systems of people, tools, practices, and environments. As AI becomes embedded in these systems, it increasingly shapes how knowledge is generated, interpreted, and applied. This raises a critical but underexplored governance question: how might AI affect the resilience, diversity, and interpretability of the knowledge systems on which societies depend? By linking deep historical insight to contemporary AI policy debates, this paper argues that the central challenge is not only to regulate AI as a powerful technology but also to safeguard the long-term robustness of collective knowledge systems. Ensuring interpretability, epistemic diversity, and institutional capacity is essential for maintaining meaningful human oversight in an increasingly AI-mediated world.

AI.tldr: 本文从深历史视角探讨AI对集体知识系统的影响，强调当前AI辩论过于关注短期技术风险，而忽视了AI可能逐渐侵蚀知识多样性、冗余性和系统韧性，从而威胁人类长期认知能力的风险。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响社会所依赖的知识系统的韧性、多样性和可解释性？如何从深历史视角理解AI对集体知识系统的长期影响？
AI.motivation: 当前AI辩论主要关注经济颠覆、算法偏见、隐私安全等短期技术风险，忽视了AI可能对集体知识系统产生的长期、系统性影响。本文旨在填补这一空白，从深历史视角提供更广阔的治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 深历史视角：借鉴人类祖先灭绝的历史教训；2) 分布式认知理论：认知嵌入于实践、工具、人工物和物质互动中；3) 集体知识系统理论：知识生成、解释和应用的社会系统；4) 系统韧性理论：知识系统的多样性、冗余性和可解释性。
AI.method: 政策简报形式，采用深历史分析框架，结合认知科学理论和历史案例研究，进行概念性分析和政策论证。
AI.findings: 1) AI可能逐渐侵蚀知识多样性、冗余性和系统韧性；2) AI嵌入集体认知系统会重塑知识生成、解释和应用方式；3) 系统脆弱性可能随时间逐渐形成；4) 当前治理框架忽视了知识系统的长期健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将深历史视角引入AI治理研究；2) 提出集体知识系统作为AI影响的核心分析单元；3) 建立AI与认知系统互动的理论框架；4) 强调知识多样性、冗余性和可解释性的理论重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 呼吁政策制定者关注AI对知识系统的长期影响；2) 提出确保可解释性、知识多样性和制度能力的治理原则；3) 强调维持有意义人类监督的重要性；4) 为AI治理提供超越技术监管的框架。

title: CreditSource
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: CreditSource
detail.abstract:
This case tells the true story of Doug Lebda, a Darden student inspired by an entrepreneurship course to start his own business, CreditSource USA. From Lebda's childhood learning sales from his father, to the genesis of his venture idea, to the hard work he put in putting the business plan together and trying to test its viability, the case explores Lebda's entrepreneurial path. Should he move forward with building CreditSource USA despite the disruption it might cause to his life...and the chance that he could fail at the endeavor?

Excerpt

CreditSource

It was almost the end of Doug Lebda's first year at the Darden School of Business (Darden). As he walked out of Jim Collins's class, he was full of excitement and determination. Collins had invited first-year students to sit in on the last day of a one-week entrepreneurship course he taught for second-year students. During this last session, Collins listed on the board every reason students came up with for not starting their dream venture. He then proceeded to cross them all out one by one, telling a story for each one about an entrepreneur who had done it in spite of that reason. Collins ended with the takeaway: “The risk is not that you're not going to succeed or fail, but that you're never gonna start.”

Lebda's heart raced as he thought, “Oh my God, I gotta do this.” Still, as he walked out of class, he knew he would have a tough row to hoe ahead of him. He would have to seek permission from faculty to take a leave of absence from Darden. More immediately, he needed to convince Tara, his wife of less than a year, that this was a good idea. Complicated thoughts and feelings rushed through him as he began tracing out a decision tree to help him decide whether to take the plunge.

Or not.

Doug Lebda, Accountant

After graduating from Bucknell University in 1992, Lebda joined PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) in its Audit and Business Advisory Services group. His experience there included accounting, finance, financial reporting, and project management. He directed several debt and equity offerings, worked with development-stage clients, and gathered experience with derivative financial instruments. Lebda also gained experience in systems development working on a yearlong project for a Fortune 50 company that was developing interactive online manuals for over 100 domestic and international locations. While at PwC, Lebda developed marketing and sales expertise as he continually marketed PwC services to new and existing clients. He became a key member of the Pittsburgh office's marketing initiative and developed innovative marketing strategies and incentive programs for the firm.

. . .

AI.tldr: 这是一个关于Darden商学院学生Doug Lebda在创业课程启发下，决定创办CreditSource USA公司的案例研究，探讨了创业者在面临生活改变和失败风险时的决策过程。
AI.research_question: 创业者在面临生活改变和失败风险时，如何做出是否创业的决策？
AI.motivation: 通过真实案例研究创业者的决策过程，帮助商学院学生理解创业决策的复杂性，特别是当创业可能对个人生活造成重大影响时的权衡考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业决策理论、机会识别理论、风险承担理论、创业动机理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过深度访谈、文档分析和叙事分析，追踪Doug Lebda的创业历程和决策过程。
AI.findings: 创业决策受到多重因素影响：个人背景（如童年经历、专业背景）、外部激励（如创业课程）、家庭支持、风险认知等。创业者需要在激情与现实约束之间找到平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了创业决策过程理论，特别强调了情感因素（如激情、恐惧）在创业决策中的作用，以及创业教育如何激发实际行动。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商学院创业教育提供实际案例，帮助学生理解创业的现实挑战；为潜在创业者提供决策框架，帮助他们系统评估创业机会与风险。

detail.abstract: In early 2025, the author introduced the Intelligence Stack framework and the concept of the GenAI Divide to explain why widespread AI adoption was failing to translate into sustained organizational value. The framework argued that successful Autonomous AI integration requires three interdependent layers: Infrastructure, Intelligence Augmentation, and Institutional Readiness. This companion paper examines how the AI-driven workforce restructuring wave of 2025-2026 validates the framework's core predictions. Drawing on corporate actions by Block, McKinsey & Company, Accenture, Tata Consultancy Services, and others, this paper identifies three distinct phenomena being conflated under the umbrella of "AI layoffs," introduces the concept of "AI arbitrage" to describe how capital markets incentivize premature workforce reduction, and proposes a prescriptive sequencing model that ties headcount restructuring to verified capability rather than projected efficiency. The paper advances an 18-month correction hypothesis, examines the distinctive risks facing regulated industries, and extends the Intelligence Stack to individual career architecture. This analysis provides decision-makers, policymakers, and professionals with a structured lens for navigating the most significant workforce transformation since the Industrial Revolution.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了Intelligence Stack框架的预测，分析了2025-2026年AI驱动的劳动力重组浪潮，区分了三种被混为一谈的"AI裁员"现象，提出了"AI套利"概念，并建立了将人员重组与已验证能力而非预期效率挂钩的规范性排序模型。

title: The Velocity Paradox  How Exponential AI Is Rewriting Power, Security, and Market Behaviour
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Velocity Paradox  How Exponential AI Is Rewriting Power, Security, and Market Behaviour

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with other individuals or organisations that could be perceived to influence the analysis or interpretation presented in this paper. This research was conducted independently as part of the AETHERION research programme.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual and analytical study based on publicly available sources and does not involve human participants, personal data, interviews, surveys, or experiments. Formal ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was independently developed by the author.

detail.abstract:
Acceleration has become a defining condition of contemporary risk environments. Advances in artificial intelligence increasingly compress the time available for institutions to recognise signals, interpret conditions, decide, and act. Under these conditions, risk does not arise primarily from intent, error, or isolated shocks, but from structural mismatches between system velocity and institutional response capacity.

This paper introduces the concept of the velocity paradox: as capabilities accelerate, governance, coordination, and assurance mechanisms often lag, narrowing decision windows and eroding effective control. The analysis reframes acceleration not as speed alone, but as the rate of system change relative to institutional absorptive capacity.

To support this reframing, the paper presents the AETHERION Velocity Index as a diagnostic lens for identifying environments in which acceleration becomes a source of systemic risk. Rather than predicting outcomes, the framework highlights conditions under which margins for error compress, coupling effects intensify, and capacity shock emerges.

The paper applies this lens across geopolitics, compute infrastructure, climate constraint, cyber escalation, markets, and supply chains, showing how instability can arise without surprise, disruption, or hostile intent. The contribution is not prescriptive, but orientational: to support decision-makers in recognising when time itself becomes the binding constraint on governance, stability, and agency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"速度悖论"概念：系统能力加速时，治理机制往往滞后，导致决策窗口缩小和有效控制减弱。作者开发了AETHERION速度指数作为诊断工具，识别加速度成为系统性风险来源的环境。
AI.research_question: 在当代风险环境中，系统加速如何影响制度响应能力？加速度何时成为系统性风险的来源？
AI.motivation: 人工智能等技术的快速发展压缩了机构识别信号、解释条件、决策和行动的时间窗口，导致风险不再主要来自意图、错误或孤立冲击，而是源于系统速度与制度响应能力之间的结构性不匹配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 速度悖论概念：能力加速时，治理、协调和保障机制往往滞后；加速度被重新定义为系统变化速率相对于制度吸收能力的比率。
AI.method: 开发AETHERION速度指数作为诊断框架，分析地缘政治、计算基础设施、气候约束、网络升级、市场和供应链等多个领域，识别加速度成为系统性风险来源的环境条件。
AI.findings: 加速度导致错误容限压缩、耦合效应加剧和能力冲击出现；不稳定性可以在没有意外、破坏或敌对意图的情况下产生；时间本身成为治理、稳定性和能动性的约束因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出速度悖论概念，重新定义加速度为系统变化速率相对于制度吸收能力的比率；开发AETHERION速度指数作为诊断工具，为理解系统性风险提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助决策者识别时间成为约束因素的环境；提供方向性而非规定性的指导，支持决策者在加速度环境中保持治理能力和稳定性。

detail.abstract: Sustainable cloud adoption in developing regions requires policy frameworks that balance technological scalability, institutional capacity, and long-term public value. This paper proposes a policy-oriented framework for sustainable cloud adoption, grounded in a Ghana-based case study, to support resilient and inclusive digital transformation. Drawing on comparative policy analysis and existing cloud governance models, the study synthesizes institutional, regulatory, economic, and infrastructural considerations into an integrated adoption framework. The model emphasizes governance readiness, cost sustainability, data protection, and scalability across public and nonprofit sectors. The paper argues that cloud strategies in developing contexts must move beyond technology acquisition toward policy-driven implementation aligned with national development goals. Implications are discussed for policymakers, regulators, and organizational leaders seeking to design scalable and sustainable cloud adoption strategies in resource-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 本文基于加纳案例研究，提出了一个面向政策的可持续云采用框架，强调治理准备、成本可持续性、数据保护和可扩展性，主张发展中国家云战略应从技术获取转向政策驱动的实施。

title: Re-evaluating Diversification: The Evolving Role of Gaming in Market Turmoil

detail.title: Re-evaluating Diversification: The Evolving Role of Gaming in Market Turmoil
detail.abstract: Given gaming’s remarkable growth and its crucial role in the digital economy, this article examines volatility spillovers among this target sector, key industries (technology, semiconductor manufacturing, e-commerce & digital payments, communication services, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, utilities), and traditional financial assets (global equities, treasury bonds, real estate, gold). The analysis is carried out using the R2 decomposed connectedness approach and spans the period from January 1, 2015, to October 31, 2025. Results show strong interlinkages among markets, with e-commerce & digital payments and global equities being the main drivers of volatility transmission. We further evaluate the efficacy of portfolios integrated with gaming stocks for their hedging and diversification properties under varying market conditions. Our findings indicate that hedging is not an effective strategy during stable market conditions; however, other assets perform as significant diversifiers for gaming-focused portfolios. Nevertheless, during turbulent periods, gaming stocks transform into a potent hedge and safe haven for related industries, though not for conventional assets. This research provides critical insights for portfolio managers and institutional investors, advocating for an updated approach to risk management that accounts for the shifting correlation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文使用R²分解连通性方法，分析了游戏行业与关键产业、传统金融资产之间的波动溢出效应，发现电子商务与数字支付、全球股票是波动传导的主要驱动力，并评估了游戏股票在不同市场条件下的对冲和分散化效果。
AI.research_question: 游戏行业与关键产业（科技、半导体制造、电子商务与数字支付、通信服务、可选消费、必需消费、公用事业）以及传统金融资产（全球股票、国债、房地产、黄金）之间是否存在波动溢出效应？游戏股票在不同市场条件下是否具有对冲和分散化价值？
AI.motivation: 游戏行业在数字经济中快速增长并扮演关键角色，但其与其他产业和传统资产的波动传导关系尚未充分研究。了解这些关联对于投资组合风险管理和资产配置至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动溢出理论、资产定价理论、投资组合理论、对冲策略理论、安全资产理论
AI.method: 使用R²分解连通性方法，分析2015年1月1日至2025年10月31日期间的数据，评估波动溢出效应和投资组合的对冲与分散化效果
AI.findings: 1. 市场间存在强烈的相互关联性；2. 电子商务与数字支付和全球股票是波动传导的主要驱动力；3. 稳定市场条件下对冲策略效果不佳，但其他资产对游戏投资组合有显著分散化作用；4. 动荡时期游戏股票对相关产业成为有效的对冲和安全资产，但对传统资产无效
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了波动溢出理论在游戏行业和数字经济中的应用；2. 揭示了游戏股票在不同市场条件下的动态对冲特性；3. 提供了游戏行业与相关产业波动传导的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资组合经理和机构投资者提供关键见解；2. 倡导考虑相关性动态变化的更新风险管理方法；3. 指导在不同市场条件下如何配置游戏股票以实现对冲和分散化目标

title: The Sticky Floor of Financial Development: Non-Linear Effects of Financial Literacy

detail.title: The Sticky Floor of Financial Development: Non-Linear Effects of Financial Literacy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced the design, execution, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses anonymised, publicly available microdata from the Flash Eurobarometer 525 survey, conducted by the European Commission. No primary data collection involving human participants was undertaken by the author. Accordingly, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study investigates distributional heterogeneity in the relationship between financial literacy and demand-side financial development across Europe. Using microdata from Eurobarometer Flash Survey 525 (N = 24,356), we construct a latent household-level financial development variable via Polychoric Principal Component Analysis and Item Response Theory, then apply conditional quantile regression to estimate how the effect of financial literacy varies across the full distribution of household financial engagement. We document a structural "sticky floor": below the 20th percentile, financial literacy has no statistically discernible effect on financial development, reflecting a non-responsive zone driven by supply-side barriers rather than knowledge deficits. Above this zone, the marginal effect of financial literacy increases monotonically through the upper-middle quantiles before attenuating at the top-consistent with product saturation. A comparative analysis of Eastern and Western European subsamples reveals that this non-responsive zone extends significantly deeper in transition economies, where literacy effects remain statistically dormant until approximately the 40th percentile. These findings challenge the universalist framing of financial education policy and argue for sequenced interventions that prioritize structural access before broad-based literacy campaigns.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用欧洲微观数据发现，金融素养对家庭金融发展的影响存在分布异质性：在金融参与度最低的20%分位数以下，金融素养无显著影响（"粘性地板"效应）；在20%分位数以上，边际效应单调递增；在最高分位数处效应减弱。东欧国家的非响应区域更宽（约40%分位数以下）。
AI.research_question: 金融素养与需求侧金融发展之间的关系在欧洲是否存在分布异质性？这种关系在不同金融参与程度的家庭中如何变化？东欧和西欧之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 现有金融素养研究通常假设其影响是线性和同质的，但现实中可能存在门槛效应和分布异质性。理解金融素养在不同金融参与程度家庭中的差异化影响，对于制定更有效的金融教育政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 金融素养理论；2. 需求侧金融发展理论；3. 分布异质性概念；4. 门槛效应理论；5. 供给约束理论；6. 产品饱和理论。
AI.method: 使用欧洲晴雨表Flash Survey 525的微观数据（N=24,356），通过多分主成分分析和项目反应理论构建潜在的家庭层面金融发展变量，然后应用条件分位数回归估计金融素养效应在整个家庭金融参与分布上的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 发现结构性"粘性地板"：在20%分位数以下，金融素养对金融发展无统计显著影响，反映供给侧障碍而非知识缺陷导致的非响应区域；2. 在此区域以上，金融素养的边际效应单调递增至中高分位数，然后在顶部减弱（产品饱和）；3. 东欧国家的非响应区域显著更宽（约40%分位数以下）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战金融素养效应的普遍主义框架；2. 提出金融素养影响的分布异质性理论；3. 识别供给约束在金融素养有效性中的调节作用；4. 为金融发展理论提供微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议金融教育政策应采取序列化干预：优先解决结构性准入障碍，再进行广泛的金融素养教育；2. 政策制定应考虑地区差异（东欧vs西欧）；3. 针对不同金融参与程度的家庭采取差异化策略；4. 避免在供给约束未解决时浪费资源于金融素养教育。

title: Metric Shear: A Sociophysical Model of How Political Doctrine Warps the Geodesic of Scientific Truth and Fractures the Republic
affiliations: SUNY College at Plattsburgh

detail.title: Metric Shear: A Sociophysical Model of How Political Doctrine Warps the Geodesic of Scientific Truth and Fractures the Republic
detail.abstract:
Contemporary models of political polarization frequently rely on individual psychology or game theory, assuming a neutral environment of communicative exchange. This paper proposes a structural alternative: that the “Backfire Effect” and the collapse of shared reality are not cognitive errors, but predictable geometric consequences of a High-Mass Information Topology that systematically filters out complex scientific discourse. By mapping the electorate onto a Social Manifold governed by principles isomorphic to General Relativity, we demonstrate that the “Stress-Energy” of the Algorithmic Attention Economy ($T_{μν}$) has warped the geometry of discourse beyond the critical limit of stability.

We define the “Orwell Limit,” a thermodynamic boundary condition derived from Landauer’s Principle, where the energy required to verify a fact exceeds the energy required to accept a falsehood. Utilizing Shannon Entropy to define “Informational Mass” and Statistical Mechanics to model the “Phase Transition” of the electorate, we prove that the velocity differential between High-Entropy Scientific Truth ($v \ll c$) and Low-Entropy Fabrication ($v \approx c$) creates a Causality Gap. The fabrication shapes the curvature of the manifold before the truth arrives to inhabit it, rendering objective verification thermodynamically inaccessible along the radicalized geodesic.

We conclude that the republic has entered a state of Metric Shear, fracturing the lattice into disjoint manifolds separated by an infinite cognitive distance. Remediation is no longer possible through persuasion; it requires a structural reconstruction of the topology itself, specifically, the imposition of Constitutional Latency and Informational Federalism to reduce the curvature of the social field and restore the geodesic required for scientific consensus.)

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结构性的政治极化模型，认为"逆火效应"和共享现实的崩溃不是认知错误，而是高信息质量拓扑的几何后果。通过将选民映射到受广义相对论原理支配的社会流形上，作者证明算法注意力经济的"应力-能量"扭曲了话语几何，超过了稳定临界极限。
AI.research_question: 政治极化和共享现实崩溃的根本原因是什么？它们是否不仅仅是认知错误，而是信息拓扑结构变化的几何后果？
AI.motivation: 现有政治极化模型过于依赖个体心理学或博弈论，假设中性的交流环境。作者认为需要从结构角度理解信息环境如何系统性过滤复杂科学话语，导致极化现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 广义相对论原理应用于社会流形；2. 信息论（香农熵定义"信息质量"）；3. 统计力学（建模选民的"相变"）；4. 兰道尔原理（定义"奥威尔极限"）；5. 算法注意力经济的"应力-能量"张量概念。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：将社会话语空间映射为几何流形，应用物理学原理（广义相对论、热力学、信息论）分析信息传播的动态。通过定义"奥威尔极限"、"因果差距"、"度量剪切"等概念，证明信息拓扑的结构性扭曲。
AI.findings: 1. 算法注意力经济扭曲了话语几何，超过了稳定临界极限；2. 高熵科学真理与低熵虚假信息的速度差异创造了"因果差距"；3. 虚假信息在真理到达之前就塑造了流形曲率；4. 社会已进入"度量剪切"状态，形成分离的流形；5. 客观验证在激进测地线上变得热力学不可及。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了政治极化的结构性替代模型；2. 将物理学原理（广义相对论、热力学、信息论）系统应用于社会现象分析；3. 定义了"奥威尔极限"、"因果差距"、"度量剪切"等新概念；4. 建立了信息拓扑与社会极化之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出说服性干预已无效，需要结构性重建；2. 提出"宪法延迟"和"信息联邦主义"作为解决方案；3. 建议通过降低社会场曲率来恢复科学共识所需的测地线；4. 为政策制定者提供了新的干预框架。

declarations.funderStatement: The author’s work on bioprinting regulation was supported by an ARC Discovery Project (2017–2020), ‘Inventing the Future: Intellectual Property and 3D Printing’ (DP170100758).

publicationDetails.detailsText: Handbook in Tissue Reconstruction and Regeneration, Singapore: Springer, 2026, pp 1-50.

detail.abstract: Drawing upon the responsive legal scholarship of Roger Brownsword, this chapter is a comparative study of the regulation of 3D printing in health, medical 3D printing, and bioprinting. It notes that this emerging technology faces a number of regulatory challenges in terms of the legal disciplines of intellectual property, innovation law, and public health. In particular, it surveys the regulatory approaches of the United States, Canada, the European Union, and Australia. It highlights the role of regulatory authorities in the assessment and approval of applications in respect of 3D printing in health, medical 3D printing, and bioprinting. It also considers other regulatory considerations—including intellectual property, product liability and consumer law, privacy, and data protection. This chapter considers whether there is a need for international law to provide further harmonization in respect of the regulation of 3D printing in health, medical 3D printing, and bioprinting. This project seeks to provide a systematic analysis of the regulation of bioprinting and biomanufacturing, highlighting both opportunities and risks for researchers, healthcare providers, and policy-makers.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Roger Brownsword的响应性法律理论，对3D打印在医疗健康领域的监管进行跨国比较研究，分析知识产权、创新法和公共卫生等法律挑战，探讨是否需要国际法协调。
AI.research_question: 在医疗健康领域的3D打印、医疗3D打印和生物打印技术监管中，不同司法管辖区（美国、加拿大、欧盟、澳大利亚）的监管方法有何异同？是否需要国际法提供进一步的协调？
AI.motivation: 3D打印技术在医疗健康领域快速发展，面临知识产权、创新法、公共卫生等多重法律监管挑战，现有各国监管体系存在差异，需要系统分析以平衡技术创新与风险管控。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Roger Brownsword的响应性法律理论，强调法律体系需要灵活适应新兴技术发展，同时考虑技术监管的多学科交叉特性。
AI.method: 比较法研究，系统分析美国、加拿大、欧盟、澳大利亚四个司法管辖区的监管方法，涵盖监管机构评估审批流程、知识产权、产品责任、隐私保护等多个维度。
AI.findings: 不同国家/地区在医疗3D打印监管上存在显著差异，监管机构在技术评估和审批中扮演关键角色，知识产权、产品责任、隐私保护等交叉法律问题需要协调解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 将响应性法律理论应用于新兴医疗技术监管，构建了医疗3D打印监管的多维度分析框架，为技术监管理论研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员、医疗服务提供者和政策制定者提供系统的监管分析，识别技术应用的机会与风险，推动国际监管协调，促进技术创新与公共安全的平衡。

title: The Geoeconomics of the US and China
affiliations: Bruegel

detail.title: The Geoeconomics of the US and China

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Transatlantic Community and China in the Age of Disruption, 2024

detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of slowbalization, but also growing bifurcation between the US and China, this chapter focuses on the economic realm of US–China strategic competition and what it means for the European Union. In the first section, it analyzes the areas where slowbalization—and in some cases deglobalization trends—is largest, from trade to supply chains and investment but with special focus on technology. Financial flows are so far less affected but with worrying signals, except for the COVID period for the latter, but the trend is that of bifurcation. This is also happening with people-to-people exchanges even after COVID. Finally, this chapter ponders the impact of this competition on the EU and offers ideas as to how the EU should react. The EU is obviously squeezed in a world of great power competition without room for multilateralism. It should leverage its economic size and its relatively developed technology to obtain the best terms possible for continuing to support the transatlantic Alliance while keeping markets open elsewhere. This includes China but with a view to reducing dependence on Chinese imports especially in the crucial sector of green tech, instrumental for Europe’s decarbonization. The EU’s continued quest for a stable and fruitful transatlantic Alliance is more realistic than that of strategic autonomy to achieve equidistance between the US and China. While it might be a Solomonic aspiration, it lacks realism in the current area of great power competition as an economic area without a central political power, an army, and with technology dependencies, mostly with the US.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在慢全球化与中美战略竞争背景下，欧盟面临的挑战与应对策略。分析显示全球化在贸易、供应链、投资和技术领域出现倒退，金融和人文交流也呈现分化趋势。欧盟应利用自身经济规模和技术优势，在维持跨大西洋联盟的同时保持其他市场开放，减少对中国绿色技术进口的依赖。
AI.research_question: 在中美战略竞争和慢全球化背景下，欧盟面临哪些经济挑战？欧盟应如何应对这些挑战以维护自身利益？
AI.motivation: 随着全球化进程放缓（慢全球化）和中美战略竞争加剧，世界正面临经济分化的风险。欧盟作为重要的经济体和政治力量，在这一背景下需要重新定位自身战略，平衡与中美两国的关系，维护自身经济利益和安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于慢全球化理论、地缘政治经济学、战略竞争理论和多边主义理论，分析大国竞争对全球经济秩序的影响。
AI.method: 采用政策分析和趋势分析方法，从贸易、供应链、投资、技术、金融流动和人文交流等多个维度分析全球化趋势变化，并评估这些变化对欧盟的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 全球化在贸易、供应链、投资和技术领域出现明显倒退趋势；2. 金融流动虽受影响较小但呈现分化信号；3. 人文交流在疫情后继续呈现分化；4. 欧盟在大国竞争中面临被挤压的局面，多边主义空间有限；5. 欧盟在绿色技术领域对中国存在依赖风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了慢全球化理论在具体领域（贸易、技术、金融等）的应用分析；2. 提出了在大国竞争背景下中等力量行为体的战略选择理论框架；3. 深化了对经济安全与技术依赖关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟政策制定者提供了应对中美竞争的具体策略建议；2. 提出欧盟应利用经济规模和技术优势争取最佳条件；3. 建议在维持跨大西洋联盟的同时保持其他市场开放；4. 强调减少对中国绿色技术进口依赖的重要性；5. 指出追求战略自主不如维持稳定的跨大西洋联盟现实。

title: China-Latin America Trade: Ever-growing Dependency
affiliations: Bruegel and BBVA Hong Kong Branch

detail.title: China-Latin America Trade: Ever-growing Dependency
detail.abstract: Although the relationship between China and Latin America has many dimensions, trade is an area that has garnered considerable attention. Since the early 2000s, China’s double-digit growth rates and thirst for natural resources was behind the increase in trade between Latin America and China. Since 2017 onwards, China’s structural deceleration and, more recently, the collapse in China’s real estate has put a break on the country’s demand for commodities hurting Latin American exports to China. To further evaluate how much Latin American countries depend on commodities and on China for their trade, we develop a commodity dependency index, which enables us to take stock of Latin America’s shifting trade ties with China. We note that a few Latin countries have moved from commodity dependency to more complex integration into global value chains.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建商品依赖指数，分析了拉丁美洲国家对中国贸易的依赖程度，发现部分拉美国家正从商品依赖转向更复杂的全球价值链整合。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲国家在多大程度上依赖商品出口和中国市场？这种依赖关系如何随时间变化？
AI.motivation: 中国与拉丁美洲的贸易关系备受关注，但自2017年以来中国经济增长放缓和房地产危机影响了其对商品的需求，从而影响了拉美对华出口。需要评估拉美国家对商品和中国市场的依赖程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易依赖理论、商品依赖理论、全球价值链整合理论
AI.method: 构建商品依赖指数，分析拉丁美洲与中国贸易数据的时间序列变化
AI.findings: 1. 中国经济增长放缓影响了拉美对华商品出口；2. 部分拉美国家已从单纯商品依赖转向更复杂的全球价值链整合；3. 拉美国家对商品和中国市场的依赖程度存在差异
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了商品依赖指数的量化方法；2. 丰富了贸易依赖关系的动态分析框架；3. 为理解新兴市场贸易结构转型提供了理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为拉美国家制定贸易多元化战略提供参考；2. 帮助政策制定者评估对华贸易风险；3. 为企业投资决策提供市场分析依据
