detail.title: On the Wisdom of Crowds (of Economists)

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 26-14
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the properties of macroeconomic survey forecast response averages as the number of survey respondents grows. Such averages are “portfolios” of forecasts. We characterize the speed and pattern of the gains from diversification as a function of portfolio size (the number of survey respondents) in both (1) the key real-world data-based environment of the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters, and (2) the theoretical model-based environment of equicorrelated forecast errors. We proceed by proposing and comparing various direct and model-based “crowd size signature plots,” which summarize the forecasting performance of k-average forecasts as a function of k, where k is the number of forecasts in the average. We then estimate the equicorrelation model for growth and inflation forecast errors by choosing model parameters to minimize the divergence between direct and model-based signature plots. The results indicate near-perfect equicorrelation model fit for both growth and inflation, which we explicate by showing analytically that, under very weak conditions, the direct and fitted equicorrelation model-based signature plots are identical at a particular model parameter configuration. That parameter configuration immediately suggests an analytic closed-form estimator for the direct signature plot, so that equicorrelation ultimately emerges as a device for convenient calculation of direct signature plots, rather than a separate “model” producing separate signature plots. Finally, we find that the gains from survey diversification are greater for inflation forecasts than for growth forecasts, and that they are largely exhausted with inclusion of 5–10 representative forecasters.

AI.tldr: 研究宏观经济调查预测平均值的性质，分析预测组合规模对预测性能的影响，发现通胀预测的多样化收益大于增长预测，5-10个代表性预测者即可获得大部分收益。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济调查预测平均值（预测组合）的性能如何随预测者数量变化？预测多样化的收益模式和速度是怎样的？
AI.motivation: 理解调查预测平均值的统计特性，量化预测组合规模对预测准确性的影响，为实际预测实践提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测组合理论、等相关系数模型、多样化收益理论、预测误差结构分析。
AI.method: 提出并比较直接和模型基础的"群体规模特征图"，使用美国专业预测者调查数据，估计等相关系数模型参数以最小化直接与模型特征图之间的差异。
AI.findings: 1) 等相关系数模型对增长和通胀预测误差拟合近乎完美；2) 通胀预测的多样化收益大于增长预测；3) 包含5-10个代表性预测者即可获得大部分多样化收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出群体规模特征图作为分析预测组合性能的工具；2) 证明等相关系数模型可作为计算直接特征图的便利工具；3) 提供预测误差结构的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为预测实践提供指导：5-10个代表性预测者即可获得大部分多样化收益；2) 提供简便的计算方法估计预测组合性能；3) 帮助理解不同类型预测（增长vs通胀）的多样化收益差异。

title: Impact of Federal Reserve Interest Rate Changes on Bank Stock Returns

detail.title: Impact of Federal Reserve Interest Rate Changes on Bank Stock Returns

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. The research was conducted independently, and there are no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the results reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial and economic data and does not involve human participants, personal data, or confidential information. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of Federal Reserve interest rate changes on the stock returns of major U.S. banks over the period from 2005 to 2025. The analysis focuses on six large U.S. banks: JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley. Daily stock price data were obtained from Yahoo Finance, and Federal Funds Rate data were collected from the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) database. Stock returns were calculated using logarithmic returns, and Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression analysis was used to estimate the relationship between interest rate changes and bank stock returns, while controlling for overall market performance using S&P 500 returns. The empirical results show that Federal Reserve interest rate changes have a statistically significant negative impact on the stock returns of most banks in the sample. Specifically, interest rate increases are associated with declines in stock returns for Bank of America, Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo. However, no significant relationship was found for Goldman Sachs. In addition, overall market returns were found to have a strong positive effect on bank stock returns. These findings suggest that monetary policy plays a significant role in influencing bank stock performance and financial market behavior. The results provide important implications for investors, policymakers, and financial institutions in understanding the transmission of monetary policy to the banking sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了美联储利率变化对美国主要银行股票回报的影响（2005-2025年），发现利率上调对大多数银行股票回报有显著负面影响，而市场整体回报则有正面影响。
AI.research_question: 美联储利率变化如何影响美国主要银行的股票回报？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策如何传导至银行业，对投资者、政策制定者和金融机构具有重要意义，有助于评估利率政策对银行股价的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导机制理论，特别是利率渠道对银行盈利能力的影响，以及股票定价理论中利率变化对折现率和未来现金流预期的影响。
AI.method: 使用2005-2025年期间六大美国银行（摩根大通、美国银行、富国银行、花旗集团、高盛、摩根士丹利）的每日股价数据，计算对数收益率，采用普通最小二乘法回归分析，控制标普500收益率作为市场整体表现。
AI.findings: 美联储利率变化对大多数银行股票回报有显著负面影响（美国银行、花旗集团、摩根大通、摩根士丹利、富国银行），但高盛未发现显著关系；市场整体回报对银行股票回报有强烈正面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证验证了货币政策通过利率渠道对银行股票回报的影响机制，丰富了货币政策传导至金融市场的理论框架，特别是对不同类型银行的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供利率政策变化时银行股票投资决策的参考；为政策制定者提供货币政策对银行业影响的实证证据；帮助金融机构更好地管理利率风险。

title: End of an Era: The Obsolescence of Nuclear Power as a World Energy Source

detail.title: End of an Era: The Obsolescence of Nuclear Power as a World Energy Source

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This work was conducted independently without institutional affiliation, financial support, or conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This work is a policy analysis based on publicly available literature and does not involve human subjects research, animal research, or primary data collection requiring ethics review.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This work does not report results from a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Nuclear power was once heralded as an inexhaustible, clean, and technologically sophisticated solution to the world's energy demands. Decades of operational history, however, have produced a record of systemic failure, catastrophic risk, and irreversible environmental damage that fundamentally challenges that premise. This paper argues that nuclear power generation has reached the end of its viable lifespan as a global energy source-not because it is impossible to operate safely, but because it is structurally incompatible with the irreducible complexity and unpredictability of the physical world, and because superior alternatives now exist at scale. Drawing on Charles Perrow's Normal Accident Theory, the operational histories of Three Mile Island, Chernobyl, and Fukushima Daiichi, emerging research on long-term ecological contamination, and the economics of renewable energy transition, this paper contends that the case for nuclear power has collapsed on ethical, engineering, economic, and ecological grounds simultaneously. The appropriate policy response is not reform but managed phase-out, with aggressive investment in solar, wind, and grid-scale storage infrastructure. Nuclear energy's moment has passed. Its obsolescence should be recognized, formalized, and acted upon.

AI.tldr: 本文认为核能作为全球能源已走到尽头，因其结构上无法应对物理世界的复杂性和不可预测性，且已有更优替代方案。基于正常事故理论、三大核事故历史、生态污染研究和可再生能源经济分析，作者主张核能在伦理、工程、经济和生态上均已站不住脚，应逐步淘汰并大力投资太阳能、风能和电网级储能。
AI.research_question: 核能是否仍应被视为可行的全球能源解决方案？其结构性缺陷是否使其无法继续作为主要能源来源？
AI.motivation: 核能曾被宣传为取之不尽、清洁且技术先进的能源解决方案，但数十年的运营历史显示出系统性失败、灾难性风险和不可逆环境损害，挑战了这一前提。需要重新评估核能的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要理论框架是查尔斯·佩罗的正常事故理论，该理论认为在高度复杂和紧密耦合的系统中，事故是不可避免的"正常"现象。
AI.method: 采用多学科分析方法：1) 理论分析：应用正常事故理论；2) 历史案例分析：研究三哩岛、切尔诺贝利和福岛第一核电站事故；3) 生态研究：分析长期生态污染证据；4) 经济分析：比较可再生能源转型的经济性。
AI.findings: 核能在伦理、工程、经济和生态四个层面同时崩溃：1) 伦理上无法接受灾难性风险；2) 工程上存在结构性缺陷；3) 经济上不如可再生能源有竞争力；4) 生态上造成不可逆污染。
AI.theory_contributions: 将正常事故理论系统应用于核能领域，提出核能的结构性不兼容性理论，建立多维度评估框架（伦理、工程、经济、生态）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出明确的政策建议：不应改革而应逐步淘汰核能，同时积极投资太阳能、风能和电网级储能基础设施，为能源转型提供具体路径。

title: Implentation of Corporate Criminal Liability Based on Corporate Culture Theory to The Environmental Crime
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Implentation of Corporate Criminal Liability Based on Corporate Culture Theory to The Environmental Crime
detail.abstract: Corporate criminal liability as regulated under Law Number 32 of 2009 on Environmental Protection and Management and Law Number 39 of 2014 on Plantations still tends to adopt a derivative model of liability. This model attributes the fault of corporate executives to the corporation itself. However, such a model poses difficulties in determining the fault of the individual executives, whether acting alone or collectively. An alternative model of corporate criminal liability is one that identifies the fault inherent within the corporation itself-the Corporate Culture Theory.This study examines the concept and application of corporate criminal liability based on the Corporate Culture Theory in environmental crimes, focusing on the court decision Number 349/Pid.B/LH/2019/PN Plw. The research is a normative legal study, analyzing a court decision that has permanent legal force and is relevant to the research issue, and comparing the contributing factors with those found in another country. Based on the findings, the concept of corporate criminal liability under the Corporate Culture Theory posits that a corporation can be held criminally responsible for its own misconduct, as seen through internal policies, rules, or procedures that result from the corporation's decision-making processes. The application of the Corporate Culture Theory in Decision Number 349/Pid.B/LH/2019/PN Plw is reflected in the judge's consideration of the corporation's non-compliance with its own internal culturespecifically, PT SSS's failure to follow proper procedures for the prevention and control of land and forest fires, which did not meet the required regulatory standards.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度尼西亚环境犯罪中企业刑事责任的概念与应用，比较了传统的衍生责任模式与企业文化理论模式，并通过分析第349/Pid.B/LH/2019/PN Plw号法院判决，展示了企业文化理论在实践中的应用。
AI.research_question: 企业文化理论在环境犯罪中如何作为企业刑事责任的替代模式被概念化和应用？
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚现行法律（2009年第32号环境保护与管理法和2014年第39号种植园法）中的企业刑事责任仍采用衍生责任模式，即将高管过错归咎于企业本身。这种模式在确定个人高管（单独或集体）过错时存在困难，需要探索替代模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业文化理论（Corporate Culture Theory）作为企业刑事责任的替代理论框架，主张企业应为其自身的过错承担责任，这种过错体现在企业内部政策、规则或程序中，是企业决策过程的产物。
AI.method: 规范性法律研究，分析具有永久法律效力且与研究问题相关的法院判决（第349/Pid.B/LH/2019/PN Plw号），并将相关因素与其他国家进行比较。
AI.findings:
1. 企业文化理论下的企业刑事责任概念认为，企业可以因其自身的过错（体现在内部政策、规则或程序中）而承担刑事责任。
2. 在第349/Pid.B/LH/2019/PN Plw号判决中，企业文化理论的应用体现在法官考虑了企业不遵守自身内部文化的情况，特别是PT SSS公司未能遵循适当的土地和森林火灾预防和控制程序，未达到规定的监管标准。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了企业文化理论作为印度尼西亚环境犯罪中企业刑事责任的替代理论框架。
2. 丰富了企业刑事责任理论，从传统的衍生责任模式转向关注企业自身组织文化和决策过程的责任模式。
3. 为企业刑事责任的理论发展提供了比较法视角。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为法官在环境犯罪案件中应用企业文化理论提供了具体案例参考。
2. 为企业合规管理提供了指导，强调内部政策和程序的重要性。
3. 为立法者修订相关法律提供了理论依据，建议考虑采用企业文化理论模式。
4. 增强了环境执法的有效性，通过追究企业自身过错而不仅仅是高管个人责任。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Published in Elgar Concise  Encyclopedia of Oil and Gas Law (2024)

detail.abstract: The 2023 report of the Intergovenrment Panel on Climate Change established that if global warming is limited to 2°C, about 50% of gas and 30% of oil reserves cannot be burned and emitted (IPCC, 2023). Similarly, in 2021, the International Energy Agency estimated that in the net-zero emissions scenario there is no need for fossil fuel exploration, new oil and natural gas fields beyond those already been approved for development, or new coal mines or mine extensions (IEA, 2021). Despite this knowledge, the regulatory systems until recently focused on regulating climate impacts of oil and gas consumption rather that its production.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了在气候目标下，石油和天然气生产监管的缺失问题，指出当前监管体系主要关注消费端的气候影响，而忽视了生产端的监管。
AI.research_question: 在实现气候目标的背景下，如何建立有效的石油和天然气生产监管体系？
AI.motivation: IPCC和IEA的研究表明，要实现气候目标，大量化石燃料储量不能开采使用，但当前监管体系主要关注消费端的气候影响，忽视了生产端的监管，存在监管空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变化治理理论、监管理论、化石燃料生产与消费的脱钩理论
AI.method: 文献综述、政策分析、案例研究
AI.findings: 当前监管体系存在生产端监管缺失，需要建立针对石油和天然气生产的气候监管框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了化石燃料生产监管的理论框架，扩展了气候变化治理理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了建立石油和天然气生产监管体系的具体建议，有助于实现气候目标。

detail.title: What Makes Federal Circuit Opinions Influential?

publicationDetails.detailsText: 109 Marq. L. Rev. 717 (2025)

detail.abstract: This Article provides the results of an empirical study assessing the determinants of a patent opinion’s influence at the Federal Circuit. I draw on a novel, largely hand-coded dataset of nearly 2,700 decisions issued by the Federal Circuit over a period of more than seven years. I find that some judges are more likely than others to issue binding opinions favoring patent owners (and others favoring patent challengers). In addition, drawing on case citation counts, I find limited evidence that extremely pro-patentee panels tend to write slightly more influential pro-patentee precedential decisions. Perhaps most striking and surprising, however, is how similarly mixed panels (i.e., panelswith at least one pro-patentee judge and at least one pro-challenger judge) decide cases. The results thus support that there’s a moderating impact from having a diversity of viewpoints on a panel. The results also have implications for both the general literature on citation analysis and for assessing the success of the Federal Circuit experiment, including the costs and benefits of vesting so much power in a single court.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析联邦巡回上诉法院近2700个专利案件判决，发现法官倾向性影响判决结果，混合观点合议庭具有调节作用，对专利制度评估有重要意义。
AI.research_question: 联邦巡回上诉法院专利案件判决中，哪些因素决定专利意见的影响力？法官倾向性如何影响判决结果？混合观点合议庭是否具有调节作用？
AI.motivation: 评估联邦巡回上诉法院专利判决的影响因素，理解法官倾向性对专利制度的影响，为专利法律改革提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法行为理论、合议庭决策理论、专利制度经济学、引证分析理论。
AI.method: 实证研究，手工编码近2700个联邦巡回上诉法院判决数据，时间跨度超过7年，使用引证计数分析判决影响力。
AI.findings: 1. 某些法官更倾向于发布有利于专利权人的约束性意见，而其他法官则倾向于有利于专利挑战者；2. 极端亲专利权人合议庭倾向于撰写更具影响力的先例性决定；3. 混合观点合议庭（至少一名亲专利权人法官和一名亲挑战者法官）表现出显著的调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为司法行为理论提供专利领域的实证支持；2. 发展合议庭多样性对决策调节作用的理论；3. 丰富引证分析在司法决策研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为专利制度改革提供实证依据；2. 帮助评估联邦巡回上诉法院集中管辖专利案件的利弊；3. 为法官任命和合议庭组成提供参考；4. 为专利诉讼策略制定提供指导。

detail.abstract: It is widely believed that human knowledge represents valuable information about the world we live in. Historical studies of Michel Foucault led to the striking conclusion that human knowledge cannot be separated from the power configurations governing society. In this paper, we study how economic theories are shaped by socio-political power.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨经济理论如何被社会政治权力所塑造，挑战了知识独立于权力的传统观念。

AI.motivation: 福柯的历史研究表明人类知识与权力配置密不可分，这引发了对经济理论是否也受社会政治权力影响的思考。

AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明，但可能采用历史分析、话语分析或案例研究方法。
AI.findings: 未在摘要中明确说明，但预期会发现经济理论确实受到社会政治权力的塑造。

title: Maga's Blue State Strategy: How Democrats And University Leaders Helped The Reactionary Right Weaponize Antisemitism Against Higher Education
affiliations: Boston University School of Law and Independent

detail.title: Maga's Blue State Strategy: How Democrats And University Leaders Helped The Reactionary Right Weaponize Antisemitism Against Higher Education
detail.abstract:
The professors are the enemy. Professors are the enemy. Write that on the blackboard 100 times and never forget it."

-President Richard Nixon, 1972 

"If any of us wants to do the things we want to do … We have to honestly and aggressively attack the universities."

-J.D. Vance, 2021 

October 7, 2023 was many things. One of those things was a lucky break for the Heritage Foundation. For decades, Heritage and its allied think tanks, donors, and officials had labored to discredit and, if possible, take over higher education in America. This project accelerated following 2020's racial reckoning. In states like Florida, North Carolina, and Texas, GOP officials intensified strategic campaigns to wrest control of their public universities by censoring curricular content, eroding faculty protections, and transforming university governing boards from non-partisan bodies into an arm of the state's Republican party apparatus.  

By fall 2023, the architects of these campaigns were celebrating significant victories in Republicancontrolled states. But it was never clear how a movement animated by nostalgia for a pre-Civil Rights America could puncture universities in liberal strongholds like New York, Massachusetts, and California. Then October 7th happened. For folks like Christopher Rufo, the right-wing activist who turned critical race theory "toxic," the campus unrest that followed Hamas' attack on Israel was an opportunity to exploit. MAGA found its blue-state strategy. The gift keeps on giving.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了美国保守派智库和政客如何利用2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击以色列后的校园动荡，将原本在共和党州推行的大学控制策略扩展到自由派州，加速对高等教育体系的接管。
AI.research_question: 保守派势力如何利用2023年10月7日事件后的校园动荡，将大学控制策略从共和党主导州扩展到自由派州？
AI.motivation: 研究保守派长期试图接管美国高等教育的历史，特别是2020年种族清算后加速的进程，以及2023年10月7日事件如何为他们在自由派州提供了新的战略机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治权力理论、意识形态控制理论、高等教育政治化理论、保守派运动战略理论
AI.method: 历史分析、案例研究（佛罗里达、北卡罗来纳、德克萨斯等州）、话语分析、政策文件分析
AI.findings: 保守派通过审查课程内容、削弱教师保护、改造大学董事会等方式在共和党州取得显著胜利；2023年10月7日事件后的校园动荡为他们在自由派州提供了新的战略突破口。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"蓝色州战略"概念，揭示了保守派如何利用危机事件将地方性策略全国化，扩展了高等教育政治化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构提供预警，揭示保守派接管大学的策略模式；为学术自由保护提供政策建议；帮助理解当前美国大学面临的政治压力。

title: What determines global sentiment towards China’s Beltand Road Initiative?
affiliations: Bruegel

detail.title: What determines global sentiment towards China’s Beltand Road Initiative?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Economic and Political Studies, volume 13, issue 2, 2025[10.1080/20954816.2024.2379671]

detail.abstract: China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) is one of the most important geopolitical phenomena of this century. It signals China’s increasing clout overseas while focusing on trade links and infrastructure in general. An important question which has not yet been fully answered is how different countries perceive this initiative, whether they are part of it or not. To answer this question, a large media repository, GDELT, is used to assess each country’s perceptions of the BRI and how they evolve over time. The main finding is that global sentiment on the BRI deteriorated significantly in most geographies from 2017 to 2022, although generally still in positive territory. Further, an empirical analysis is conducted to test the relationship between individual countries’ sentiment towards the BRI and three possible determinants, i.e. economic linkages with China, geopolitical closeness with China, and a country’s perceptions and attitudes about some China-related issues. The results suggest that import dependence on China seems to worsen the image of the BRI. Instead, a country’s geopolitical alignment with China, whether by being a member of the BRI or by voting at the United Nations (UN)like China, is positively correlated with its perceptions of the BRI.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用GDELT媒体数据库分析各国对"一带一路"倡议的认知变化，发现2017-2022年间全球对BRI的总体情绪显著恶化但仍保持正面，经济依赖中国会恶化BRI形象，而地缘政治结盟则改善BRI认知。
AI.research_question: 不同国家（无论是否参与）如何认知中国的"一带一路"倡议？这些认知如何随时间演变？哪些因素影响各国对BRI的态度？
AI.motivation: "一带一路"倡议是本世纪最重要的地缘政治现象之一，标志着中国海外影响力的增强，但各国对其认知尚未得到充分研究，需要系统分析全球媒体对BRI的报道态度及其影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际关系理论和媒体分析框架，探讨经济相互依赖、地缘政治结盟和国家认知三个维度如何影响各国对"一带一路"倡议的态度。
AI.method: 使用GDELT大型媒体数据库，通过文本分析和情感分析技术评估各国对BRI的认知及其时间演变；采用实证分析方法检验经济联系、地缘政治亲近度和中国相关问题态度三个决定因素与BRI认知的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 2017-2022年间全球对BRI的总体情绪显著恶化，但仍保持正面；2. 对中国的进口依赖会恶化BRI形象；3. 与中国的政治结盟（如BRI成员国身份、联合国投票一致性）与BRI正面认知正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化全球对"一带一路"倡议的认知演变；2. 揭示了经济依赖与政治结盟对国际倡议认知的不同影响机制；3. 为理解大国倡议的国际接受度提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中国政府调整BRI宣传策略提供数据支持；2. 帮助政策制定者理解影响国际倡议接受度的关键因素；3. 为其他国家评估参与BRI的风险收益提供参考框架。

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-35
title: Efficiency, Insurance, and Redistribution Effects of Government Policies
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis - Department of Economics, University of Oregon - Department of Economics, University of Chicago and New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics, Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Efficiency, Insurance, and Redistribution Effects of Government Policies

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-35
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper decomposes welfare measures of policy reforms into parts attributable to redistribution and parts due to efficiency. We further decompose efficiency into subcomponents such as gains from better insurance against idiosyncratic and aggregate risk. Our decomposition of welfare measures associated with alternative feasible allocations is cast in terms of a coordinate system that uses generalized Pareto-Negishi weights to capture inequality and production and consumption wedges to capture distortions. Our decomposition has several desirable properties. It attributes welfare changes from movements along a Pareto frontier to redistribution; it attributes negative efficiency changes to movements away from the Pareto frontier; and it produces subcomponent shares of welfare changes that are numeraire-invariant and symmetric with respect to the direction of the reform. Our decomposition can be explained in terms of an implicit tax-and-transfer system in which redistribution captures real income changes, efficiency captures deadweight losses, and output costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将政策改革福利效应分解为再分配部分和效率部分的方法，并将效率进一步分解为应对个体风险和总体风险等子成分。该方法使用广义帕累托-内格什权重衡量不平等，用生产和消费楔子衡量扭曲，具有多个理想特性。
AI.research_question: 如何将政策改革的福利效应系统地分解为再分配部分和效率部分，并将效率进一步分解为更细的子成分？
AI.motivation: 现有福利分析往往难以清晰区分政策改革中的再分配效应和效率效应，需要一种系统性的分解框架来更好地理解政策改革的福利影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于帕累托最优和福利经济学理论，使用广义帕累托-内格什权重来衡量不平等，用生产和消费楔子来捕捉经济扭曲。
AI.method: 构建一个坐标系统，将福利变化分解为再分配部分和效率部分，效率部分进一步分解为应对个体风险、总体风险等子成分。
AI.findings: 提出的分解方法具有多个理想特性：将帕累托前沿上的移动归因于再分配；将负效率变化归因于偏离帕累托前沿；分解成分的份额具有计价单位不变性和改革方向对称性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种系统性的福利分解框架，能够清晰区分政策改革中的再分配效应和效率效应，并建立了与隐含税收转移系统的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了分析工具，可以更精确地评估政策改革的福利影响，区分再分配效应和效率损失，有助于设计更有效的政策。

title: Well Worth it: Saturated Thickness, Well Capacity, and the Cost of Aquifer Depletion for Irrigated Agriculture
affiliations: Texas A&M University - College of Agriculture and Life Sciences, Texas A&M University, University of Georgia, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Texas A&M University

detail.title: Well Worth it: Saturated Thickness, Well Capacity, and the Cost of Aquifer Depletion for Irrigated Agriculture
detail.abstract: We estimate the cost of depleting a natural resource whose value depends jointly on both its stock of quantity and its quality. We study this problem in the context of groundwater by estimating the cost of aquifer depletion for irrigated agriculture in the Colorado portion of the High Plains Aquifer. Using a hedonic valuation approach applied to agricultural land markets, we account for both saturated thickness, the vertical column of water above bedrock, and well capacity, which determines the instantaneous rate at which groundwater can be extracted, a measure of water access quality. We show that, because saturated thickness and well capacity are linked through a nonlinear physical relationship, omitting well capacity from the valuation framework leads to an underestimation of the loss of groundwater wealth from aquifer depletion by 6%. Because well capacity data are often sparse or unavailable, our findings highlight the importance of investments in monitoring infrastructure to accurately value groundwater as natural capital and assess the true cost of depletion.

AI.tldr: 该研究估计了地下水枯竭对农业的经济成本，考虑了水量（饱和厚度）和水质（井容量）的共同影响，发现忽略井容量会低估6%的地下水财富损失。
AI.research_question: 如何准确估计同时依赖水量和水质（井容量）的自然资源枯竭成本？特别是高平原含水层地下水枯竭对灌溉农业的经济影响。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常只关注地下水量的减少，而忽略了水质（特别是井容量）对资源价值的影响。井容量决定了瞬时抽水速率，是水资源可及性的重要指标，但相关数据往往缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然资源经济学和资本理论，将地下水视为自然资本，其价值同时取决于存量（饱和厚度）和质量（井容量）。使用享乐定价法分析农业土地市场。
AI.method: 采用享乐定价法，分析科罗拉多州高平原含水层农业土地市场数据，同时纳入饱和厚度（水量指标）和井容量（水质/可及性指标）作为解释变量。
AI.findings: 由于饱和厚度和井容量之间存在非线性物理关系，忽略井容量会导致低估地下水枯竭造成的财富损失约6%。井容量数据缺乏会严重影响估值准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了同时考虑自然资源数量和质量的综合估值框架，强调了水质（可及性）在自然资源资本估值中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了投资监测基础设施的重要性，以准确评估地下水作为自然资本的价值，为水资源管理和政策制定提供更准确的经济依据。

title: A Topological Data Analysis Framework for Automated Equity Trading using Persistent Homology, Betti Numbers, and Laplacian Diffusion
affiliations: Briar Woods High School

detail.title: A Topological Data Analysis Framework for Automated Equity Trading using Persistent Homology, Betti Numbers, and Laplacian Diffusion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Financial markets exhibit highly non-linear, complex dynamics that resist effective characterization by conventional time-series methods. This study introduces and evaluates a fully automated equity trading system grounded in topological data analysis (TDA), a branch of mathematics that quantifies the shape and connectivity of high-dimensional data. The system constructs a sliding-window embedding of S&P 500 price data into point clouds, applies the Vietoris-Rips filtration to produce a nested sequence of simplicial complexes, and computes persistent homology to extract Betti numbers-specifically β 0 (connected components) and β 1 (independent loops)-as proxies for market regime and complexity. A graph Laplacian operator is then applied to the market correlation network to diffuse these topological signals and suppress noise before they are supplied to a Ridge regression model that generates directional trading signals. Backtested on daily equity data spanning January 2021 through early 2026, the Topo + Ridge strategy achieved a cumulative return of approximately 80%, substantially outperforming passive benchmark investment during the same interval. Periods of elevated Betti-0 persistence sum were found to correlate strongly with market stress and high volatility, validating the topological regime-detection hypothesis. These results suggest that persistent homology provides a geometrically meaningful and statistically informative characterization of equity market structure that can be exploited by supervised regression models to generate alpha.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于拓扑数据分析(TDA)的自动化股票交易系统，通过持久同调提取市场拓扑特征，结合岭回归模型生成交易信号，在2021-2026年测试中实现约80%的累计收益，显著跑赢基准。
AI.research_question: 拓扑数据分析能否有效表征股票市场的非线性复杂动态，并用于构建自动化交易系统以生成超额收益？
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列方法难以有效表征金融市场的高度非线性复杂动态，需要新的数学工具来捕捉市场结构和模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拓扑数据分析(TDA)、持久同调理论、图拉普拉斯算子、岭回归模型
AI.method: 1) 将S&P 500价格数据通过滑动窗口嵌入点云；2) 应用Vietoris-Rips过滤生成单纯复形序列；3) 计算持久同调提取Betti数(β0和β1)；4) 在市场相关网络上应用图拉普拉斯算子扩散拓扑信号并降噪；5) 使用岭回归模型生成方向性交易信号；6) 在2021年1月至2026年初的日度数据上进行回测。
AI.findings: 1) Topo + Ridge策略实现约80%的累计收益，显著跑赢被动基准投资；2) 高Betti-0持久性总和与市场压力和波动率高度相关，验证了拓扑机制检测假设；3) 持久同调提供了几何意义明确且统计信息丰富的股票市场结构表征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将拓扑数据分析应用于金融市场建模，提供新的市场结构表征方法；2) 验证了持久同调特征作为市场机制和复杂性代理的有效性；3) 建立了拓扑信号与市场动态之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发了基于TDA的自动化交易系统；2) 提供了可实际应用的交易策略，能生成超额收益；3) 为量化投资提供了新的技术工具和方法论。

title: Externalities of Geothermal Power Plants: Evidence from Land Prices in Japan
affiliations: Kobe University, Nagoya University and Osaka University of Economics

detail.title: Externalities of Geothermal Power Plants: Evidence from Land Prices in Japan
detail.abstract: Renewable energy deployment faces a fundamental challenge. Climate benefits are globally distributed, whereas economic costs are borne locally by host communities. Despite extensive research quantifying wind power externalities, comparable evidence for geothermal energy, which is a critical baseload renewable resource, remains virtually nonexistent. This study provides the first nationwide quantitative assessment of how geothermal power plants affect local land values. Exploiting a panel dataset covering the period from 1983 to 2024 and all 28 large-scale geothermal installations in Japan, a country with the world's third-largest geothermal potential yet persistent deployment challenges, we employ a difference-in-differences design with spatial fixed effects. Land prices within 2 km of geothermal plants decline by 7 to 12% following installation, effects substantially larger than typical wind turbine impacts (1–6%) and robust across alternative specifications. We show that the aggregate land value losses borne by nearby residents are of a similar order of magnitude to the annual global climate benefits from CO₂ emission reductions, particularly in the early years after installation, revealing pronounced distributional tensions inherent in energy transitions. Our findings provide an empirical foundation for policy frameworks that explicitly address localized economic losses, such as compensation schemes and community benefit-sharing mechanisms, thereby enabling socially and politically feasible geothermal and other place-based renewable energy deployment beyond the Japanese context.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次量化评估了日本地热发电厂对周边土地价值的影响，发现地热厂2公里范围内土地价格下降7-12%，影响远大于风电（1-6%），且当地居民承受的土地价值损失与CO₂减排的全球气候效益规模相当，揭示了能源转型中的分配矛盾。
AI.research_question: 地热发电厂如何影响周边土地价值？这种影响与风电等其他可再生能源相比有何差异？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源部署面临根本挑战：气候效益全球共享，但经济成本由当地社区承担。虽然风电外部性已有大量研究，但作为关键基荷可再生能源的地热能源，其影响却缺乏量化证据。日本拥有世界第三大地热潜力但部署面临持续挑战，为研究提供了理想环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外部性理论、环境经济学中的邻避效应（NIMBY）以及能源转型中的分配正义理论，研究关注可再生能源部署中全球效益与局部成本之间的张力。
AI.method: 使用1983-2024年面板数据，涵盖日本所有28个大型地热发电厂，采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）结合空间固定效应，分析地热厂安装前后2公里范围内土地价格变化。
AI.findings: 地热发电厂安装后，2公里范围内土地价格下降7-12%，影响显著大于风电（1-6%）。当地居民承受的总体土地价值损失与CO₂减排的全球气候效益规模相当，特别是在安装后的早期年份。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了地热能源对土地价值影响的全国性量化证据，填补了可再生能源外部性研究的空白；揭示了能源转型中全球效益与局部成本之间的显著分配张力；为理解不同可再生能源技术的外部性差异提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了明确证据，支持建立补偿机制和社区利益共享框架；有助于设计更公平的能源转型政策，促进社会和政治上可行的可再生能源部署；研究结论超越日本背景，对全球地热和其他基于地点的可再生能源部署具有参考价值。

title: Taxing Attention
affiliations: University of North Carolina School of Law

detail.title: Taxing Attention

publicationDetails.journalName: University of North Carolina Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The rise of social media platforms and other digital businesses has transformed the economy. Companies like Meta and Alphabet have developed a booming industry where advertising revenue drives profits and we, the consumers, provide the product. But what, exactly, are we selling?

For the last decade, the legal and broader academic community has resoundingly categorized this new economy as one focused on data. Consumers use digital platforms like Facebook for “free,” but the platform collects data about the consumer in the process, which is then monetized by selling advertisements. In the realm of tax law, a growing body of work grapples with the complex issues created by the rise of big data. To keep up with any meaningful shift in the economy, a tax system must be able to locate, measure, and subject economic transactions to tax. But digital data is hard to pin down in any meaningful way for tax purposes. How much is our data worth? Where is digital data located geographically? These issues have stymied tax experts across the globe for years.

This Article advocates a fundamental shift in the legal analysis surrounding this new digital economy –particularly the tax law analysis. Specifically, it argues that the primary commodity that is sold to digital platforms by users is not their data; it is their attention. In making this claim, the Article draws on a nascent body of work by economists and other scholars who have argued that the modern economy is more appropriately described as an “attention economy,” rather than one centering on data. The Article argues that transactions between social media companies and users should be reframed as the sale by users of their attention in exchange for the platform’s services. Although data collection is important to the platforms’ businesses, the advertisers ultimately pay for people to pay attention to their ads, not to acquire raw data.

Reframing social media transactions as a sale of consumer attention makes the tax consequences of these exchanges significantly less complex, because the transactions do not involve the sale of a novel intangible asset (digital data). The sale of attention is simply the sale of one’s time—a type of transaction that existed long before digitization. After exploring the tax treatment of the sale of user attention to social media platforms, the Article argues that the monetization of user attention by social media companies merits a policy response. To that end, it proposes a Pigouvian tax on platforms to account for the negative externalities that social media imposes.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将社交媒体经济重新定义为"注意力经济"而非"数据经济"，认为用户向平台出售的是注意力而非数据，这一重构能简化税收处理，并建议对平台征收庇古税以应对社交媒体负外部性。
AI.research_question: 在数字经济中，用户向社交媒体平台出售的主要商品是什么？如何从税收法律角度重新定义这种交易关系？
AI.motivation: 当前法律和学术界普遍将数字经济视为数据经济，但数字数据难以确定价值、地理位置等税收要素，导致全球税收专家面临困境。需要重新审视数字经济的本质以解决税收难题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力经济理论：借鉴经济学家和其他学者的观点，认为现代经济更应被描述为"注意力经济"而非数据经济。庇古税理论：用于处理负外部性的税收政策。
AI.method: 法律分析和理论重构：通过重新概念化社交媒体交易的本质，分析其税收后果。政策建议：基于理论分析提出具体的税收政策方案。
AI.findings: 1. 用户向平台出售的主要商品是注意力而非数据；2. 将交易重构为注意力出售能显著简化税收处理，因为注意力出售本质上是时间出售；3. 社交媒体平台通过用户注意力获利应受到政策干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出数字经济应从"数据经济"范式转向"注意力经济"范式；2. 为数字交易提供新的法律分析框架；3. 将注意力作为可税商品进行理论建构。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为税收系统提供处理数字交易的简化方案；2. 提出对社交媒体平台征收庇古税的具体政策建议；3. 为解决数字经济税收难题提供可操作路径。

title: Identification and Estimation in a Time-Varying Endogenous Random Coefficient Panel Data Model
affiliations: National University of Singapore

detail.title: Identification and Estimation in a Time-Varying Endogenous Random Coefficient Panel Data Model
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a correlated random coefficient linear panel data model, where regressors can be correlated with time-varying and individual-specific random coefficients through both a fixed effect and a time-varying random shock. I develop a new panel data-based method to identify the average partial effect and the local average response function. The identification strategy employs a sufficient statistic to control for the fixed effect and a control variable for the random shock. Conditional on these two controls, the residual variation in the regressors is driven solely by the exogenous instrumental variables, and thus can be exploited to identify the parameters of interest. The constructive identification analysis leads to three-step series estimators, for which I establish rates of convergence and asymptotic normality. To illustrate the method, I estimate a heterogeneous Cobb-Douglas production function for manufacturing firms in China, finding substantial variations in output elasticities across firms that can be related to various firm characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种相关的随机系数线性面板数据模型，开发了基于面板数据的新方法来识别平均偏效应和局部平均响应函数，并通过中国制造业企业的异质性柯布-道格拉斯生产函数估计进行了实证应用。
AI.research_question: 如何识别面板数据模型中与时间变化和个体特定随机系数相关的回归变量的平均偏效应和局部平均响应函数？
AI.motivation: 在面板数据模型中，回归变量可能通过固定效应和时间变化的随机冲击与随机系数相关，传统方法难以有效识别这些复杂关系下的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相关的随机系数线性面板数据模型，其中回归变量通过固定效应和时间变化的随机冲击与随机系数相关。
AI.method: 使用充分统计量控制固定效应，控制变量处理随机冲击，利用外生工具变量的残差变化来识别参数，开发了三步序列估计器。
AI.findings: 建立了估计器的收敛速度和渐近正态性，实证应用显示中国制造业企业的产出弹性存在显著异质性，且与企业特征相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的面板数据识别策略，发展了相关的随机系数模型理论，建立了三步序列估计器的渐近性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了估计异质性生产函数的实用方法，有助于理解企业间技术差异，为政策制定和企业决策提供实证依据。

title: Initial-Condition-Robust Inference in Autoregressive Models
affiliations: National University of Singapore, Yale University - Cowles Foundation and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)

detail.title: Initial-Condition-Robust Inference in Autoregressive Models
detail.abstract: This paper considers confidence intervals (CIs) for the autoregressive (AR) parameter in an AR model with an AR parameter that may be close or equal to one. Existing CIs rely on the assumption of a stationary or fixed initial condition to obtain correct asymptotic coverage and good finite sample coverage. When this assumption fails, their coverage can be quite poor. In this paper, we introduce a new CI for the AR parameter whose coverage probability is completely robust to the initial condition, both asymptotically and in finite samples. This CI pays only a small price in terms of its length when the initial condition is stationary or fixed. The new CI also is robust to conditional heteroskedasticity of the errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的自回归参数置信区间，该区间在初始条件（平稳或固定）方面具有完全鲁棒性，无论渐近还是有限样本下都能保持正确的覆盖概率，同时对条件异方差也具有鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个对初始条件完全鲁棒的自回归参数置信区间，使其在初始条件假设失效时仍能保持正确的覆盖概率？
AI.motivation: 现有自回归参数置信区间依赖于平稳或固定初始条件的假设，当这一假设不成立时，其覆盖概率会变得很差。需要一种对初始条件完全鲁棒的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自回归模型理论、置信区间构建理论、渐近理论、有限样本性质分析、条件异方差鲁棒性理论
AI.method: 提出一种新的置信区间构建方法，该方法不依赖于初始条件假设，在渐近和有限样本下都能保持鲁棒性，同时对条件异方差具有鲁棒性
AI.findings: 新提出的置信区间在初始条件方面具有完全鲁棒性，当初始条件为平稳或固定时，其长度仅略有增加，同时该区间对条件异方差也具有鲁棒性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了第一个对初始条件完全鲁棒的自回归参数置信区间理论框架；2. 建立了在渐近和有限样本下都能保持正确覆盖的理论保证；3. 扩展了条件异方差鲁棒性理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实证研究者提供了更可靠的推断工具；2. 在初始条件不确定的情况下仍能获得有效的置信区间；3. 适用于更广泛的实际应用场景，包括金融时间序列等存在条件异方差的领域

title: How Close Is China’s Medium-Term Outlook to That of Japan? An Economic-Historical Perspective
affiliations: Bruegel

detail.title: How Close Is China’s Medium-Term Outlook to That of Japan? An Economic-Historical Perspective

publicationDetails.detailsText: Financial and Economic Review, volume 24, issue 3, 2025[10.33893/FER.24.3.23]

detail.abstract: After decades of strong growth, China’s economy began a steady slowdown around 2012. Current GDP growth is less than half of previous levels, and the trend is expected to continue. Since its real estate bubble burst in mid-2021, deflationary pressures have raised concerns that China may follow Japan’s trajectory from the early 1990s. Both countries show similar structural traits: low private consumption, high savings and significant economic imbalances – China’s even more so. Their policy responses have also mirrored each other: slow monetary and fiscal easing, focus on manufacturing and reliance on trade surpluses, prompting US protectionist reactions. Like Japan, China is offshoring production to counteract trade barriers. However, China differs in key ways: it is still a developing economy with more room for growth and is a far stronger geopolitical force than Japan was. This power both motivates US technological restrictions and gives China broader global leverage, especially in the Global South. Whether China will repeat Japan’s path remains a crucial, open question.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨中国是否会重蹈日本"失去的十年"覆辙，通过对比两国经济结构、政策反应及地缘政治差异，分析中国面临的经济放缓、房地产泡沫破裂和通缩压力等问题。
AI.research_question: 中国是否会重蹈日本"失去的十年"的覆辙？中国与日本在经济结构、政策反应和地缘政治地位上的异同如何影响其经济前景？
AI.motivation: 自2012年以来中国经济持续放缓，2021年房地产泡沫破裂后通缩压力加剧，引发对中国可能重演日本1990年代经济停滞的担忧。两国在经济结构、政策反应上存在惊人相似性，但中国的地缘政治地位和发展阶段又有所不同，这一对比分析对理解中国经济未来走向至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于比较经济分析框架，借鉴日本"失去的十年"经验，结合经济结构转型理论、房地产泡沫理论、通缩螺旋理论以及地缘政治经济学视角，构建分析中国经济发展路径的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用比较案例研究方法，系统对比中国与日本在经济结构（消费、储蓄、失衡）、政策反应（货币财政政策、产业政策、贸易政策）以及地缘政治地位等方面的异同，结合历史分析和趋势预测。
AI.findings: 中国与日本在经济结构上高度相似：低私人消费、高储蓄、严重经济失衡（中国更甚）；政策反应也类似：缓慢的货币财政宽松、侧重制造业、依赖贸易顺差。但关键差异在于：中国仍是发展中经济体，增长空间更大；中国的地缘政治影响力远超日本，这既招致美国技术限制，也赋予中国在"全球南方"更广泛的影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文拓展了比较经济分析理论，将地缘政治维度纳入经济发展路径分析框架，挑战了单纯基于经济结构相似性的预测模型，强调发展阶段和地缘政治地位对经济轨迹的决定性作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：避免重蹈日本政策迟缓的覆辙；为企业提供战略参考：理解中美贸易摩擦背景下的产业布局；为投资者提供分析框架：评估中国经济增长前景和风险。

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Elgar Companion to International Business and the Sustainable Development Goals, pp. 12-40

detail.abstract:
This chapter takes stock of some of the main arguments and lines of research that I pursued over the past eight years– alone or together with co-authors – with the aim to increase the societal relevance and legitimacy of International Business scholarship. These works extended on earlier insights on the role of MNEs in sustainable development (cf. e.g. Van Tulder with Van der Zwart, 2005; Kolk and Van Tulder, 2012). Now the focus can become more specific on the way the global SDG agenda can live up to their potential as a paradigm change in dealing with sustainable development as a multi-stakeholder, multi-level, multi-dimensional (etc.) challenge. The paradigm change of the SDG-agenda implies in particular that public and private sectors have to work together not only to withstand the present poly-crisis, adopt risk-management strategies, but also seize the opportunities that an adequate management of sustainable transition processes might create.

The next sections navigate the ambition to fill many intellectual gaps along three lines of argument: (1) why the SDG-agenda is now more relevant than ever for MNE strategist and IB scholars (section 2); (2) what analytical and practical gaps need to be filled to accelerate change in support of the Global Goals (section 3); and (3) what intellectual questions and concrete frameworks need further (action) research to implement those insights (section 4)?

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了作者过去八年关于提升国际商务研究社会相关性与合法性的研究成果，聚焦SDG议程作为范式变革如何促进公共与私营部门合作应对可持续发展挑战。

title: Investors' Sentiment and Stock Returns: Insight from Literature and Bibliometric Trends
affiliations: and Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering

detail.title: Investors' Sentiment and Stock Returns: Insight from Literature and Bibliometric Trends
detail.abstract:
Purpose: This study aims to critically examine and evaluate the existing literature on the role of investor sentiment in stock market behaviour.

Design/methodology/approach: A bibliometric methodology was utilized to analyze advancements in this area of research and identify gaps in current empirical methods. The study involved examining 203 scholarly articles sourced from Dimensions. Biblioshiny, and VOS Viewer packages were used, focusing on aspects such as keyword co-occurrence, citation patterns, co-citation links between documents, citations involving different countries, and the geographical distribution of publications.

Findings: The findings suggest that i) most of the articles focused on equity markets where as comparatively less research is done on other financial market instruments like cryptocurrency,
derivatives and commodities markets ii) There is no standard method to measure investors' sentiments iii) Not much research has been done on institutional investors sentiments iv) Most
of the study is done on developed markets. There is a need for study on emerging markets. v)
Not much research has been done in the area of ESG investing.

Originality/Value: This study not only explores investors' sentiments but also their financial behaviour. The study has considered both traditional as well as machine- learning methods. The paper also highlights the gaps in existing literature and suggests further study to overcome them.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过文献计量学方法系统回顾了投资者情绪对股市行为影响的研究现状，识别了现有文献的五个主要研究空白领域。
AI.research_question: 投资者情绪在股票市场行为中扮演什么角色？现有研究存在哪些方法学和研究领域的空白？
AI.motivation: 投资者情绪是影响金融市场行为的重要因素，但现有研究存在碎片化、方法不统一、研究范围有限等问题，需要进行系统性评估和整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论、投资者情绪理论、市场效率理论
AI.method: 文献计量学方法，使用Dimensions数据库收集203篇学术文章，运用Biblioshiny和VOS Viewer软件包进行关键词共现分析、引文模式分析、文献共被引分析、国家间引文分析和出版物地理分布分析
AI.findings: 研究发现五个主要空白：1) 研究过度集中于股票市场，对其他金融工具（加密货币、衍生品、大宗商品）关注不足；2) 缺乏衡量投资者情绪的标准方法；3) 对机构投资者情绪研究不足；4) 研究主要集中在发达市场，新兴市场研究匮乏；5) ESG投资领域研究不足
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：系统整合了投资者情绪研究文献，识别了理论发展的关键空白，为行为金融学理论的发展提供了方向性指导
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：为投资者、监管机构和市场参与者提供了研究现状的全面图景，指出了未来研究重点，有助于改进投资决策和市场监管

title: A Bibliometric Analysis of Sustainable Finance Instruments for Small and Medium Size Enterprises
affiliations: and

detail.title: A Bibliometric Analysis of Sustainable Finance Instruments for Small and Medium Size Enterprises
detail.abstract: Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) are playing a key role in offering job creation, market expansion, enhancing innovation, and economic growth. Though the contribution of SMEs is huge in developing nations, they are responsible for emitting 40% of commercial waste, greenhouse gas emissions, and industrial pollution. Sustainable finance instruments are a solution to meet the challenges of socio-economic and environmental issues created by SMEs. Sustainable finance instruments offer funds to accomplish environmentally sustainable projects, to conserve natural resources, combat climate change, protect biodiversity, promote social inclusion, reduce pollution, and promote sustainable development. There are numerous instruments, such as green bonds, green investment funds, sustainability-linked loans, and channel capital towards initiatives, green investment, and ESG-compliant corporate operations available in the market. Among these, sustainable funds are offering financial resources to developing nations. Nowadays, SMEs are encountering numerous challenges like misconceptions about green finance, limited knowledge and expertise in understanding financial resources, and the complexity of securing green finance instruments. All these challenges ruin even when they wish to use green finance to expand operations. SMEs should have an open mindset to embrace the greening process in their operations to make use of the sustainable financial instruments. Previous studies have proved that sustainable finance is being accessed by SMEs in the developing countries, yet the application of sustainable financial instruments on SMEs remains notably underexplored. This underscores the need to fully understand sustainable finance instruments and their application, especially to SMEs in this context. The objective of the study is to adopt bibliometric analysis to assess sustainable financial instruments and SMEs from the Scopus database between 2020 and 2025. This study will highlight the most prolific journals, highly productive authors, and countries that made contributions in the field.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用文献计量分析方法，评估2020-2025年间可持续金融工具与中小企业的研究现状，识别核心期刊、高产作者和国家贡献。
AI.research_question: 可持续金融工具在发展中国家中小企业中的应用现状和研究趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 中小企业在创造就业、市场扩张和创新方面发挥关键作用，但同时产生大量商业废物、温室气体排放和工业污染。虽然可持续金融工具为解决中小企业带来的社会经济和环境问题提供了解决方案，但相关研究仍显不足，特别是在发展中国家的应用方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续金融理论、绿色金融理论、中小企业可持续发展理论、环境社会治理（ESG）框架
AI.method: 采用文献计量分析方法，基于Scopus数据库2020-2025年的文献数据，分析可持续金融工具与中小企业的研究现状。
AI.findings: 研究将识别该领域最活跃的期刊、高产作者和国家贡献，揭示可持续金融工具在中小企业应用的研究趋势和知识结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补可持续金融工具在发展中国家中小企业应用研究的理论空白，为可持续金融与中小企业交叉领域提供系统的文献计量分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、金融机构和中小企业提供实践指导，帮助中小企业克服绿色金融获取障碍，促进可持续金融工具在中小企业中的有效应用。

title: Inclusive Leadership Steers Institutional Excellence through Talent Retention and Employee Wellbeing
affiliations: and

detail.title: Inclusive Leadership Steers Institutional Excellence through Talent Retention and Employee Wellbeing
detail.abstract:
Inclusive and responsible leadership has transpired as an essential criterion in moulding a sound institutional culture, precisely in educational scenarios where human resources steer long-term excellence. The rationale of this analysis is rooted in the ever-demanding need for schools to develop leadership practices that value diversity, equality, inclusive decision-making, and ethical stewardship practices that influence talent retention and employee engagement. Inclusive leadership strengthens trust and nurtures loyalty where teachers are not mere employees but the heartbeat of an institution, and their talent chooses to stay, grow and retain.

The purpose of this study is to provide an empirical understanding of how inclusive and responsible leadership moulds talent retention and employee engagement in private schools. Precisely, the study aims to examine the influence of inclusive leadership on teachers’ intention to remain in the institution, to analyse the impact of responsible leadership on employee engagement, to explore the mediating role of job satisfaction and organisational commitment and to provide empirical feedback for strengthening leadership frameworks within the private school system.

A quantitative, descriptive analytical research design will be employed with a structured questionnaire covering the various dimensions of inclusive leadership and talent outcomes. Data will be collected from private school teachers through stratified random sampling. Statistical analysis will provide evidence for the study’s hypotheses.

The originality of this study lies in its holistic and inspiring approach. Presenting leadership not only as a managerial performance but also as a catalyst for emotional connection, institutional excellence, and professional satisfaction, this study contributes a meaningful framework for private schools where teachers feel valued, empowered, and committed to the vision of gaining institutional excellence through inclusive leadership.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨包容性和负责任领导如何影响私立学校教师留任和员工敬业度，通过实证分析揭示领导风格对人才保留的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 包容性和负责任领导如何塑造私立学校的人才保留和员工敬业度？具体研究包容领导对教师留任意愿的影响、负责任领导对员工敬业度的影响，以及工作满意度和组织承诺的中介作用。
AI.motivation: 学校需要发展重视多样性、平等、包容决策和道德管理的领导实践，这些实践影响人才保留和员工敬业度。包容领导能增强信任、培养忠诚度，使教师成为机构的核心而非普通员工。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包容性领导理论、负责任领导理论、人才保留理论、员工敬业度理论、工作满意度理论、组织承诺理论。
AI.method: 采用定量描述性分析研究设计，使用结构化问卷测量包容领导各维度与人才结果。通过分层随机抽样从私立学校教师收集数据，进行统计分析验证假设。
AI.findings: 研究尚未完成，但预期将提供包容领导对教师留任意愿、负责任领导对员工敬业度的实证证据，以及工作满意度和组织承诺的中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将领导力不仅视为管理绩效，更视为情感连接、机构卓越和专业满意的催化剂，为私立学校提供有意义框架，使教师感到被重视、赋权并致力于通过包容领导实现机构卓越。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私立学校系统加强领导框架提供实证反馈，帮助学校发展重视多样性、平等、包容决策和道德管理的领导实践，从而提高人才保留和员工敬业度。

title: Pedagogical Innovations in Sustainability Education: A Systematic Literature Review and Bibliometric Analysis
affiliations: and

detail.title: Pedagogical Innovations in Sustainability Education: A Systematic Literature Review and Bibliometric Analysis
detail.abstract: The growing need for graduates who will be able to deal with complex socio-ecological issues, Sustainability Education has become a prominent mandate of higher education systems. While Education for Sustainable Development and Sustainable Development Goals are now embedded within formal curricula globally, dominant transmissive pedagogies continue to support awareness-based learning at the expense of transformative, competency-based learning. This paper provides a systematic synthesis of innovative pedagogical practices in sustainability education, focusing on their alignment with perspectives of sustainability competencies and transformative learning outcomes. A systematic review of the 601 peerreviewed articles indexed in Scopus from 1974 to 2026 was conducted using the PRISMA guidelines and was also supported through bibliometric, thematic and conceptual analyses. The findings indicate that the field is currently in a period of consolidation, as evidenced by a reduction in the growth of publications over time, thematic saturation, and an increasing focus on the application of experiential, problem-based, and transdisciplinary learning pedagogies. However, the data also demonstrate a continuing fragmentation in the field, particularly with respect to the misalignment between pedagogical methods, competency frameworks, assessment practices, and institutional policy integration. There remains a geographical concentration of research in the Global North, with relatively limited empirical validation of long-term learning outcomes and very little integration of digital, socio-cultural, and governance dimensions into sustainability education. The review states that pedagogical innovation is at a turning point, emphasising that further developments in this area require working together across disciplines, using evidence-based approaches, to translate sustainability competencies into large-scale solutions through educational practices and policies; in doing so, higher education institutions will be able to play an important role in facilitating systemic transitions toward sustainability.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过系统综述1974-2026年601篇文献，分析了可持续发展教育的创新教学实践，发现该领域正处于整合期但存在碎片化问题，教学法、能力框架、评估实践和制度政策之间缺乏协调，研究集中在全球北方，缺乏长期学习成果的实证验证。
AI.research_question: 可持续发展教育中的创新教学实践如何与可持续发展能力和变革性学习成果相协调？
AI.motivation: 高等教育需要培养能够应对复杂社会生态问题的毕业生，但当前主流的传授式教学法仍以意识培养为主，缺乏变革性、能力本位的学习。可持续发展教育需要从意识培养转向能力培养。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展能力框架、变革性学习理论、教育创新理论、系统思维
AI.method: 采用PRISMA指南对Scopus数据库中1974-2026年的601篇同行评审文章进行系统综述，辅以文献计量分析、主题分析和概念分析
AI.findings: 1. 该领域正处于整合期，出版物增长放缓，主题趋于饱和；2. 体验式、问题导向和跨学科学习教学法应用增加；3. 教学法、能力框架、评估实践和制度政策之间存在碎片化；4. 研究地理分布不均，集中在全球北方；5. 缺乏长期学习成果的实证验证；6. 数字、社会文化和治理维度整合不足
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了可持续发展教育创新教学实践的系统性知识图谱；2. 识别了教学法、能力框架和评估之间的协调问题；3. 提出了该领域从碎片化向系统性整合的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育工作者提供了创新教学实践的参考；2. 指出了跨学科合作和证据导向方法的重要性；3. 为高等教育机构将可持续发展能力转化为大规模解决方案提供了实践指导；4. 强调了制度政策整合的必要性

title: Imapct of GST Slab Cuts on Affordability and Sustainability of Large-Cap Petrol Cars and Large SUVs
affiliations: , ,  and

detail.title: Imapct of GST Slab Cuts on Affordability and Sustainability of Large-Cap Petrol Cars and Large SUVs
detail.abstract:
This paper investigates the price structure, buying behavior, and sales performance of large cap cars and SUVs in India following the reduction of the GST slab. While GST reforms were implemented with the aim of boosting growth in the automobile sector, there has been very limited empirical evidence on the impact of such tax changes on high-engine-capacity automobiles above 1500 cc. In such a backdrop, the study will examine the quantum of price reduction that has ensued from the reduction of GST rates, assess the changes in consumer behavior that have resulted due to the said intervention, and study the sales trends for this segment before and after the reform.

In the conceptual framework, the cut in the GST slab is the independent variable, while price reduction, consumer buying behavior, and sales volume are dependent variables. Engine capacity is the moderating variable that determines the strength of these associations. A mixed method approach was used with primary data from structured consumer surveys and secondary data from industry databases, GST policy documents, and official reports on sales. Statistical tools were used to determine whether GST cuts have significantly boosted demand for high capacity petrol vehicles.

The results show that there was a measurable decline in on-road prices following the reduction of the GST rate, which improved the affordability of large SUVs and large-cap petrol cars, thereby increasing interest among consumers. Sales data collected provided evidence of an upwards shift in market demand after this reform, which is especially true for models with over 1500 cc. The hypothesis that a reduction in GST would have positively impacted sales in this category (H1) is therefore proved, providing useful implications for policymakers and automobile manufacturers. Overall, the study contributes to an understanding of how fiscal policy decisions shape consumer behavior, pricing dynamics, and market sustainability in the Indian automobile industry.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度GST税率降低对1500cc以上大排量汽车和SUV的价格结构、购买行为和销售表现的影响，发现税率降低显著降低了终端价格，提高了消费者兴趣，并推动了该细分市场的销售增长。
AI.research_question: GST税率降低对印度1500cc以上大排量汽车和SUV的价格结构、消费者购买行为和销售表现有何影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然GST改革旨在促进汽车行业增长，但关于此类税收变化对1500cc以上高排量汽车影响的实证证据非常有限，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念框架中，GST税率降低是自变量，价格降低、消费者购买行为和销售量为因变量，发动机排量是调节变量，决定这些关联的强度。
AI.method: 采用混合方法，包括结构化消费者调查的原始数据和行业数据库、GST政策文件、官方销售报告等二手数据，使用统计工具分析GST削减是否显著提升了高排量汽油车的需求。
AI.findings: 结果显示，GST税率降低后终端价格显著下降，提高了大型SUV和大排量汽油车的可负担性，增加了消费者兴趣。销售数据显示改革后市场需求向上转移，特别是1500cc以上车型。假设H1（GST降低对该类别销售有积极影响）得到证实。
AI.theory_contributions: 研究增进了对财政政策决策如何塑造消费者行为、定价动态和市场可持续性的理解，为税收政策与消费行为关系的理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了GST改革效果的直接证据，帮助评估税收政策对特定行业的影响；为汽车制造商提供了市场洞察，指导产品定价和营销策略；为行业参与者理解税收变化对高排量汽车市场的影响提供了实用参考。

title: Exploring the Green HRM as Catalyst for Sustainable Business Model: An Integrated Study of Bibliometric and Systematic Literature Review
affiliations: Rani Channamma University and Rani Channamma University, Belagavi

detail.title: Exploring the Green HRM as Catalyst for Sustainable Business Model: An Integrated Study of Bibliometric and Systematic Literature Review
detail.abstract: This study reviews the development of Green Human Resource Management as a driver of sustainable business models by composing an integrated study via Bibliometric and Systematic Literature Review (SLR) for the study published during 2014-2025. Based on 237 records in Scopus, the analysis portrays publication patterns, prominent journals, globally most cited authors, and new research directions to help explain the role played by Green HRM in the sustainability of organizations. The result analysis indicates a significant increase in research momentum, which is caused by the pressure on the global environment and the interest of organizations to incorporate sustainability into HR frameworks, leadership functions, and innovation. The thematic clustering unveils six prevailing sustainable business model directions such as technology-driven, circular economy-oriented, capability-based, governance aligned, behavioural and sector-specific models. These models show the impacts of Green HRM on environmental performance through the creation of green culture, the development of pro-environmental behaviours, the incorporation of digital technologies, and the facilitation of strategic alignment with the sustainability objectives. Another aspect introduced in the study is a synthesis of TCCM, which outlines theoretical, contextual, and methodological trends of the field. Overall, the results are valuable in the context of comprehending the role of HR-related interventions in facilitating business model change providing insights to the researchers and practitioners interested in enhancing environmental sustainability through organization design.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过文献计量和系统性文献综述方法，分析了2014-2025年间绿色人力资源管理作为可持续商业模式驱动因素的发展，揭示了六个主流可持续商业模式方向及其对组织环境绩效的影响。
AI.research_question: 绿色人力资源管理如何作为可持续商业模式的驱动因素？它在组织可持续发展中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 全球环境压力和组织将可持续性纳入人力资源框架的需求推动了绿色人力资源管理研究的发展，需要系统梳理该领域的研究现状和发展方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色人力资源管理理论、可持续商业模式理论、组织可持续发展理论，以及TCCM（理论、情境、方法）分析框架。
AI.method: 采用文献计量分析和系统性文献综述方法，基于Scopus数据库中的237篇文献（2014-2025年）进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 研究势头显著增长；2. 识别出六个主流可持续商业模式方向：技术驱动型、循环经济导向型、能力基础型、治理对齐型、行为型和行业特定型；3. 绿色人力资源管理通过创建绿色文化、培养亲环境行为、整合数字技术等方式影响环境绩效；4. 提供了TCCM综合分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理了绿色人力资源管理领域的研究脉络；2. 提出了六个可持续商业模式分类框架；3. 建立了TCCM分析框架来理解该领域的理论、情境和方法趋势；4. 深化了绿色人力资源管理对组织可持续发展作用机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织提供了实施绿色人力资源管理的具体方向；2. 帮助管理者理解如何通过人力资源干预促进商业模式转型；3. 为政策制定者提供了促进组织环境可持续性的参考；4. 为研究人员指出了未来研究方向。

title: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Finance: Industry Perspectives on the Adoption and Future of Robo-Advisory in India
affiliations: and

detail.title: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Finance: Industry Perspectives on the Adoption and Future of Robo-Advisory in India
detail.abstract:
A robo advisory service is an online platform that utilises algorithms and automation to provide investment advice and manage portfolios with minimal or no human intervention. It typically collects basic information about an investor's goals and risk tolerance through a questionnaire and then automatically builds, monitors, and rebalances their investments, usually at a lower cost than human advisors. This study aims to analyse the current state, challenges, and prospects of robo-advisory services, creating sustainable financial systems aligned with SDG 10, which seeks to reduce inequality through expanded access to affordable wealth management.

Questionnaire schedules from semi-structured interviews with fintech leaders reveal that hybrid models, which blend AI analytics with human oversight, are the primary approach. These models offer scalable personalization at a lower cost compared to traditional wealth management, which typically relies on high commissions. Adoption targets urban professionals aged between 30 to 50 in multinationals who are interested in convenience and digital access, yet are hindered by low trust in automation, poor performance records, and a preference for human advisors. Minimal regulatory or technological barriers exist; however, growth demands AI-enhanced personalisation, transparent and straightforward cost communication, and trust building through clear performance tracking dashboards. Fintechs must position robo-advisory services as a more affordable option than traditional advisors, integrate them into their overall investment platforms, and utilize them to offer high-quality wealth management to a broader audience, thereby helping to reduce inequality through increased digital access.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了机器人投顾服务的现状、挑战和前景，重点关注如何通过混合模式（AI分析+人工监督）提供可扩展的个性化财富管理，以更低的成本服务更广泛的用户群体，从而减少不平等并支持SDG 10目标。
AI.research_question: 机器人投顾服务的现状、挑战和前景是什么？如何通过机器人投顾服务创建可持续的金融系统，减少不平等并支持SDG 10目标？
AI.motivation: 机器人投顾服务通过算法和自动化提供投资建议和投资组合管理，成本低于人工顾问，有潜力扩大财富管理的可及性。研究旨在探索如何利用这种技术减少不平等，支持联合国可持续发展目标10（减少不平等）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融科技采纳理论、信任理论和服务设计理论，研究探讨了混合模式（AI+人工监督）在财富管理中的应用，以及如何通过技术扩大金融服务可及性来减少不平等。
AI.method: 采用半结构化访谈法，对金融科技领导者进行问卷调查，收集定性数据来分析机器人投顾服务的现状、挑战和前景。
AI.findings: 1. 混合模式（AI分析+人工监督）是主要方法，提供可扩展的个性化服务且成本更低；2. 主要目标用户是30-50岁的跨国公司专业人士，他们重视便利性和数字访问，但对自动化信任度低、偏好人工顾问；3. 监管和技术障碍较少，但增长需要AI增强个性化、透明的成本沟通和信任建立；4. 需要将机器人投顾定位为比传统顾问更实惠的选择，并整合到整体投资平台中。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了机器人投顾服务采纳的混合模式理论框架；2. 扩展了金融科技服务设计理论，强调信任建立和透明沟通的重要性；3. 将机器人投顾与可持续发展目标（SDG 10）联系起来，为技术驱动的金融包容性研究提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融科技公司提供实施混合机器人投顾服务的具体策略；2. 建议通过AI增强个性化、透明成本沟通和绩效跟踪仪表板来建立信任；3. 指导如何将机器人投顾定位为更实惠的选择并整合到现有平台；4. 展示了如何通过扩大数字访问来减少不平等，为政策制定者提供参考。

title: Mapping the Intellectual Landscape of Impact Investing: A Bibliometric Study
affiliations: and

detail.title: Mapping the Intellectual Landscape of Impact Investing: A Bibliometric Study
detail.abstract: Impact investing has emerged as a critical pillar in sustainable finance. It directs capital toward initiatives that generate measurable social and environmental benefits along with financial returns. Even though it emerged as a buzz word in academic research, the intellectual structure and evolving knowledge base of impact investing research remain fragmented. This study presents a comprehensive bibliometric analysis to map global research trends, influential contributors, conceptual foundations, and emerging themes in the field. Using data extracted from Scopus database for a time span of 2010-2026, the study examines the conceptual and intellectual structure of the impact investing research using Vosviewer and Biblioshiny. The findings reveal there is a significant growth in scholarly output with a strong conceptual foundation in sustainability. The bibliometric coupling network indicates a mature domain The thematic analysis highlights evolving research fronts such as impact measurement frameworks and behavioural finance. The study offers a structured overview of the field and identifies various themes under the domain. The results also identify critical gaps and propose future research avenues, thereby contributing to strengthening the theoretical and empirical foundations of impact investing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量分析，系统梳理了2010-2026年间影响力投资研究的知识结构、发展趋势和新兴主题，揭示了该领域的成熟度、概念基础和研究前沿。
AI.research_question: 影响力投资研究的知识结构和演化趋势是什么？该领域的主要贡献者、概念基础和新兴主题有哪些？
AI.motivation: 影响力投资已成为可持续金融的重要支柱，但现有研究的知识结构和演化基础仍然分散，需要系统梳理以加强理论和实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续金融理论、影响力投资理论、文献计量学理论、知识结构理论
AI.method: 文献计量分析，使用Scopus数据库（2010-2026年数据），借助Vosviewer和Biblioshiny软件进行概念和知识结构分析
AI.findings: 1. 学术产出显著增长，具有坚实的可持续性概念基础；2. 文献耦合网络显示该领域已相对成熟；3. 主题分析揭示了影响力测量框架和行为金融等新兴研究前沿
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统描绘了影响力投资研究的知识图谱；2. 识别了该领域的理论发展脉络；3. 为加强影响力投资的理论基础提供了结构化框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究者和实践者提供了该领域的结构化概览；2. 识别了关键研究空白和未来研究方向；3. 有助于指导影响力投资实践和政策制定

title: Performance Analysis of ESG Mutual Fund in India: Trends, Return and Investor Adoption
affiliations: Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) - Department of Commerce, ,  and

detail.title: Performance Analysis of ESG Mutual Fund in India: Trends, Return and Investor Adoption
detail.abstract:
Sustainable finance has rapidly evolved within the Indian financial market as investors increasingly integrate Environmental, Social, and Governance also known as ESG considerations into their investment decisions. With rising climate risk awareness and regulatory encouragement from SEBI followed by global responsible investment trends, ESG mutual funds have emerged as an important investment category. However the question of whether ESG focused funds provide competitive financial returns compared to traditional equity mutual funds remain under studied in the Indian context particularly using publicly available datasets.

This study focuses to understand the financial performance and risk characteristics of ESG mutual funds in India. The analysis is based on secondary data collected from publicly accessible platform including the Association of Mutual Funds in India AMFI, National Stock Exchange NSE, Value Research Online and Moneycontrol. Monthly Net Asset Values NAV, Assets Under Management AUM, category classification and performance indicators will be extracted for ESG mutual funds for a minimum three-year period subject to availability.

The theoretical foundation of the study is grounded in the Stakeholder Theory and Modern Portfolio Theory which is popularly known as MPT together posit that incorporating ESG criteria may reduce long term risk exposure while potentially influencing financial returns.
The methodology include descriptive statistics and Sharpe ratio analysis. This finding is expected to provide insight into whether sustainable investment offers financial value in addition to ethical benefits. The study contributes to the growing demand on sustainable finance in emerging economies and offer interventions for policymakers and fund managers for investors pursuing responsible investment strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析印度ESG共同基金的财务表现和风险特征，探讨可持续投资在提供伦理效益之外是否具有财务价值。
AI.research_question: 印度ESG共同基金与传统股票共同基金相比，是否提供有竞争力的财务回报？
AI.motivation: 随着投资者日益将ESG因素纳入投资决策，印度ESG共同基金已成为重要投资类别，但其财务表现与风险特征在印度背景下研究不足，特别是使用公开数据集的研究较少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论和现代投资组合理论（MPT），认为纳入ESG标准可能降低长期风险敞口并影响财务回报。
AI.method: 基于公开平台的二手数据收集（AMFI、NSE、Value Research Online、Moneycontrol），提取ESG共同基金的月度净资产值、资产管理规模、分类和绩效指标，使用描述性统计和夏普比率分析。
AI.findings: 预期研究结果将揭示ESG共同基金的财务表现和风险特征，为可持续投资是否提供财务价值提供见解。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴经济体可持续金融研究提供实证证据，验证利益相关者理论和现代投资组合理论在ESG投资背景下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为追求负责任投资策略的投资者提供决策依据，为政策制定者和基金经理提供干预建议，促进印度可持续金融发展。
