detail.abstract:
תקציר בעברית: דמוקרטיות ליברליות מתמודדות עם אתגר מבני במדיניות הגירה ואינטגרציה: נאמנות חוקתית - המחויבות היסודית לנורמות משפטיות, לגיטימיות המדינה ושלטון החוק - אינה ניתנת להעברה באמצעות קורסי אוריינטציה בלבד. מאמר זה טוען שנאמנות כזו מוטמעת במערכות מוסדיות שהתפתחו במהלך מאות שנים של אבולוציה תלוית-מסלול, הנושאות משקל נורמטיבי הנגזר הן מניסיון היסטורי עמוק והן מטראומה קולקטיבית ספציפית.

עולים חדשים ואוכלוסיות פנימיות לא-משולבות עשויים ללמוד את הכללים מבלי לגשת להקשר שהופך את הכללים למחייבים נורמטיבית. יתרה מזאת, האתגר חורג מעבר לפרטים ומגיע ל”חיקוי מוסדי,” שבו קולקטיבים לא-ליברליים מאמצים את הצורות החיצוניות של החברה האזרחית כדי להסוות סדרים נורמטיביים מקבילים.

מדיניות אינטגרציה נוכחית נעה בין שתי טעויות: אוניברסליזם עיוור-הקשר מניח שמחויבויות ליברליות נגישות באופן מובן מאליו ללא תיווך, ומייצר ציפיות אופטימיות מדי וחוסר השקעה מוסדית; רטוריקה הדרתית מתייחסת לאתגרי האינטגרציה כעדות ליכולת מולדת בלתי-מספיקה, וסוגרת את האפשרות לשילוב אמיתי.

לבחינה אמפירית של דינמיקות אלה, המאמר מתמקד במקרה המזרחי כמקרה בוחן מרכזי: בין 1948 ל-1956, כ-700,000 יהודים ממדינות ערב וצפון אפריקה הגיעו לישראל הצעירה. הם נתקלו במערכת מוסדית שיצרה ״הדרה לא מכוונת״ ודרשה מהם מחיקה תרבותית תוך מניעת השתתפות אמיתית בכוח המוסדי.
מסגרת ניתוח ייחודית: כדי להבין את כישלון האינטגרציה המזרחי, המאמר מציע ארבע עדשות ניתוח מבניות שפועלות במקביל: (1) חוסר התאמה בהון חברתי (Social Capital Mismatch) - המוסדות נבנו עבור “הון חברתי מגשר” בעוד שליהודי המזרח היה “הון חברתי קושר” עשיר שנתפס כשבטי; (2) ביטחוניזציה של תרבות (Securitization of Culture) - הערביות של המזרחים שיקפה את זהות האויב הקיומי, ויצרה “מחיקה הגנתית”; (3) גירעון באוריינות מוסדית (Institutional Literacy Deficit) - יהודי המזרח הגיעו ללא הידע השבשתיקה של איך דמוקרטיה פועלת; (4) מורשת אוריינטליסטית (Orientalist Inheritance) - האשכנזים הפנימו את הדעות הקדומות האירופאיות על העולם הערבי.

למרות זאת, המאמר מדגיש: זה לא היה קולוניאליזם במובן הקלאסי. האשכנזים לא פעלו מתוך כוונה זדונית לדכא או לנצל. הם פעלו מתוך אידיאולוגיה אמיתית של בניית אומה דמוקרטית, ויתרו על שפותיהם שלהם (יידיש) למען העברית הלאומית, ומנהיגים כמו בן-גוריון עברו לפריפריה למרות חוסר הנוחות האישית. הבעיה הייתה Dismissal מבני, לא זדון.

השלכות: כישלונות האינטגרציה לא הניבו משבר מיידי. הם יצרו אוכלוסיות שהיחסים שלהן למדינה היו מעוותים - מועברים לילדים ונכדים, ומתפרצים כמשבר חוקתי 70 שנה מאוחר יותר. המקרה המזרחי התפרץ כמשבר לגיטימציה סביב כוח שיפוטי במשבר הרפורמה השיפוטית של 2023.

הלקח המרכזי: אינטגרציה אינה ניתנת לקיצור דרך הכללה הצהרתית. קיבולת קליטה היא סופית ויש לכבד אותה. החלופה לאינטגרציה אמיתית, תובענית, מדודה-דורית אינה יציבות אלא קרע חוקתי דחוי. ההחלטות על אינטגרציה שמתקבלות היום יניבו את תוצאותיהן לא ב-2030 אלא ב-2090.

English Abstract:  Liberal democracies face a structural challenge in migration and integration policy: constitutional loyalty—the foundational commitment to legal norms, state legitimacy, and the rule of law—cannot be transmitted through orientation courses alone. This article argues that such loyalty is embedded in institutional systems that developed over centuries of path-dependent evolution, carrying normative weight derived from deep historical experience and specific collective trauma. New immigrants and unintegrated internal populations may learn the rules without accessing the context that makes those rules normatively binding. Furthermore, the challenge extends beyond individuals to "institutional mimicry," whereby illiberal collectives adopt the external forms of civil society to mask parallel normative orders. Current integration policy oscillates between two errors: context-blind universalism assumes that liberal commitments are self-evidently accessible without mediation, producing overly optimistic expectations and insufficient institutional investment; exclusionary rhetoric treats integration challenges as evidence of inherent incapacity, foreclosing the possibility of genuine inclusion. For empirical examination, this article focuses on the Mizrahi case as a central test case: between 1948 and 1956, approximately 700,000 Jews from Arab and North African countries arrived in young Israel, encountering an institutional system that created "unintentional exclusion"—demanding cultural erasure while preventing genuine participation in institutional power. The article proposes four analytical lenses: (1) Social capital mismatch: Institutions were designed for "bridging capital" (weak ties, generalized trust), while Mizrahi Jews possessed rich "bonding capital" (familial networks, particularized trust) that was pathologized as "tribal"; (2) Securitization of culture: The Arabic language and cultural attributes of Mizrahi Jews mirrored the existential enemy, creating "defensive erasure"—forced de-Arabization driven not by racism but by genuine fear; (3) Institutional literacy deficit: Mizrahi Jews arrived without the tacit knowledge of how democracy functions, having been excluded from political participation under the Ottoman millet system and authoritarian monarchies for generations; (4) Orientalist legacy: Ashkenazi elites internalized European prejudices about the Arab world despite themselves being victims of those same European prejudices against Jews. Despite this, the article emphasizes: this was not colonialism in the classical sense. Ashkenazim did not act from malicious intent to oppress or exploit. They acted from genuine ideology of nation-building, sacrificed their own languages (Yiddish) for national Hebrew, and leaders like Ben-Gurion moved to the periphery despite personal discomfort. The problem was structural dismissal—not malice. Implications: Integration failures did not produce immediate crisis. They created populations whose relationship to the state was distorted—transmitted to children and grandchildren, erupting as constitutional crisis 70 years later. The Mizrahi case erupted as a legitimacy crisis around judicial power in the 2023 judicial reform crisis. The central lesson: Integration cannot be shortcut through declarative inclusion. Absorption capacity is finite and must be respected. The alternative to genuine, demanding, generationally-measured integration is not stability but deferred constitutional rupture. Decisions made today on integration will yield results not in 2030 but in 2090.

AI.tldr: 本文认为自由民主国家在移民融合政策上面临结构性挑战：宪法忠诚（对法律规范、国家合法性和法治的基本承诺）无法仅通过导向课程传授。这种忠诚嵌入在历经数百年路径依赖演化形成的制度体系中，承载着深厚历史经验和特定集体创伤的规范权重。文章以以色列的东方犹太人（Mizrahi）案例为实证检验，分析了制度性排斥的四种结构性机制，并指出融合失败不会立即引发危机，但会在70年后以宪法危机形式爆发。
AI.research_question: 自由民主国家如何有效实现移民和内部未融合群体的宪法忠诚传递？为什么制度性融合会失败，其长期后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 当前移民融合政策在两个极端之间摇摆：一是忽视具体语境的普遍主义，认为自由主义承诺无需中介即可自我显现；二是排斥性修辞，将融合挑战视为内在能力不足的证据。这两种方法都无法解决宪法忠诚传递的结构性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 路径依赖制度演化理论：宪法忠诚嵌入在历经数百年演化形成的制度体系中
2. 社会资本理论：区分"桥梁资本"（弱联系、普遍信任）和"纽带资本"（家庭网络、特殊信任）
3. 安全化理论：文化被安全化，导致"防御性抹除"
4. 制度素养理论：理解民主运作的默会知识
5. 东方主义遗产理论：欧洲对阿拉伯世界的偏见内化
AI.method: 案例研究法：以1948-1956年间约70万来自阿拉伯和北非国家的东方犹太人移民以色列为关键案例，分析其遭遇的"非故意排斥"现象。采用四重分析框架进行深入分析。
AI.findings:
1. 东方犹太人遭遇了结构性排斥而非恶意压迫
2. 融合失败源于四种结构性机制：社会资本错配、文化安全化、制度素养赤字、东方主义遗产
3. 这种排斥不是经典殖民主义，而是源于真诚的国家建设意识形态
4. 融合失败不会立即引发危机，但会在70年后以宪法合法性危机形式爆发（如2023年司法改革危机）
5. 吸收能力是有限的，必须得到尊重
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了宪法忠诚传递的结构性挑战理论
2. 发展了"制度模仿"概念：非自由主义集体采用公民社会外部形式掩盖平行规范秩序
3. 构建了分析融合失败的四重分析框架
4. 挑战了传统殖民主义分析框架，提出了"结构性忽视"概念
5. 提出了融合政策的代际时间框架理论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 警示政策制定者：融合不能通过宣言式包容走捷径
2. 强调必须尊重有限的吸收能力
3. 指出融合决策的后果不会在短期内显现，而是在70-80年后爆发
4. 为移民融合政策提供了更现实的时间框架
5. 强调需要实质性、要求高的、代际衡量的融合过程

title: Financial Fragility Indexes for Latin American Countries using the Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition Filtering Method
affiliations: Banco de la Republica, Tilburg University and Tilburg University

detail.title: Financial Fragility Indexes for Latin American Countries using the Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition Filtering Method
detail.abstract: This paper studies the financial fragility of seven Latin American countries, in a period in which two global episodes hit financial markets and economies worldwide: the great financial crisis (2007-2009) and the COVID-19 shock (2020-2021). Given the relatively short time spans of financial data available for developing economies, the traditional smoothing methods, which require use of long-time series to obtain reliable results, are not expected to deliver satisfactory results. Instead, we propose a new methodological approach for this type of analysis, i.e., the Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) filtering method. We demonstrate its superior performance on individual financial indicators and then aggregate these indicators at the country level and by type of indicator. Our results show that the financial fragility of these countries was increasing before and during the first episode, while for the other episode it started to increase during the lockdown period but suddenly fell in response to the measures taken by the economic authorities. The policy implications of this study point to the need for a proper assessment of financial fragility levels, as this will allow central banks to be better equipped to implement macroprudential measures to mitigate the effects of financial instability in crisis periods as well as to achieve a rapid recovery from its negative effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了七个拉丁美洲国家在2007-2009年全球金融危机和2020-2021年COVID-19冲击期间的金融脆弱性，提出使用集成经验模态分解(EEMD)过滤方法来分析短期金融数据，发现这两个时期金融脆弱性呈现不同变化模式。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲国家在全球金融危机和COVID-19冲击期间的金融脆弱性如何变化？如何有效分析发展中国家短期金融数据的金融脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家金融数据时间序列较短，传统平滑方法需要长期数据才能获得可靠结果，因此需要开发适合短期数据分析的新方法来评估金融脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融脆弱性理论、宏观审慎政策框架、时间序列分解方法理论
AI.method: 集成经验模态分解(EEMD)过滤方法，对七个拉丁美洲国家的金融指标进行分析，首先在单个指标层面验证方法优越性，然后在国家层面和指标类型层面进行聚合分析
AI.findings: 1. 全球金融危机期间，这些国家的金融脆弱性在危机前和危机期间持续增加；2. COVID-19冲击期间，金融脆弱性在封锁期开始增加，但随后因经济当局采取措施而突然下降；3. EEMD方法在短期金融数据分析中表现优越
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了适用于发展中国家短期金融数据分析的EEMD方法；2. 扩展了金融脆弱性分析在短期数据条件下的方法论；3. 为发展中国家金融脆弱性动态变化提供了新的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行和政策制定者提供了评估金融脆弱性的有效工具；2. 帮助决策者更好地实施宏观审慎措施以缓解金融不稳定影响；3. 促进危机后的快速经济恢复；4. 为发展中国家金融监管提供了实证依据

title: Federal Surveys Undercount People with Disabilities as Defined by the Amendments to the Americans with Disabilities Act
affiliations: U.S. Office of Research, Social Security Administration

detail.title: Federal Surveys Undercount People with Disabilities as Defined by the Amendments to the Americans with Disabilities Act
detail.abstract: Disability measurement in federal surveys aligns with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (ADA) by focusing on major life activity limitations but has not evolved to align with the ADA Amendments Act of 2008, which expands the definition of major life activities to include major bodily functions. I find that people who ever had a major bodily function limitation were at least 30 percentage points less likely to be identified as having a disability, compared with people with major life activity limitations as defined before the amendments. The finding shows a disparity in disability identification in federal surveys. This disparity can be eliminated by expanding the scope of disability measurement to include major bodily function limitations. I quantify this expansion would increase the disability prevalence estimate among people aged 18–64 in the 2023 American Community Survey from 11 percent to roughly 27 percent, equivalent to 33 million additional people identified as having a disability.

AI.tldr: 联邦调查中的残疾测量仍沿用1990年ADA标准，未更新至2008年ADA修正案，导致主要身体功能受限人群被低估。研究发现这类人群被识别为残疾的可能性低至少30个百分点。扩展测量范围可将18-64岁人群的残疾率从11%提升至27%，增加3300万人。
AI.research_question: 联邦调查中的残疾测量如何与2008年ADA修正案保持一致？将主要身体功能受限纳入测量范围会对残疾识别率产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 联邦调查的残疾测量仍基于1990年ADA标准，未反映2008年ADA修正案对"主要生活活动"定义的扩展（包括主要身体功能）。这导致大量有主要身体功能受限的人群未被识别为残疾，造成测量偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美国残疾人法案(ADA)及其2008年修正案的法律框架，关注残疾定义从"主要生活活动"限制扩展到包括"主要身体功能"限制的理论演变。
AI.method: 比较分析：对比主要身体功能受限人群与主要生活活动受限人群在联邦调查中被识别为残疾的概率差异。使用2023年美国社区调查数据进行量化估计。
AI.findings:
1. 主要身体功能受限人群被识别为残疾的可能性比主要生活活动受限人群低至少30个百分点
2. 扩展测量范围可将18-64岁人群的残疾率从11%提升至27%
3. 相当于增加3300万人被识别为残疾
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了联邦调查残疾测量与现行法律框架之间的脱节
2. 量化了定义偏差对残疾识别率的影响
3. 为残疾测量的理论框架更新提供了实证依据
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为联邦调查机构提供具体的测量改进建议
2. 帮助政策制定者更准确地了解残疾人口规模
3. 确保残疾相关政策和资源分配的公平性
4. 为3300万未被识别的残疾人提供法律保护依据

title: Liquidity, Volatility, and Price Discovery in Indian Mid-Cap Stocks: Evidence from NSE using Daily and Intraday Indicators
affiliations: and

detail.title: Liquidity, Volatility, and Price Discovery in Indian Mid-Cap Stocks: Evidence from NSE using Daily and Intraday Indicators
detail.abstract:
The functioning of financial markets is profoundly influenced by the relationship between liquidity, volatility, and price discovery efficiency. Understanding how these factors interact is crucial for assessing the overall quality and informational efficiency of equity markets. This study investigates these dynamics within India’s mid-cap equity segment, emphasizing how liquidity and trading activity affect volatility and the efficiency of price adjustment processes. Using daily data for a sample of NSE Mid-Cap and Large-Cap stocks over a six-month period from January 2025 to June 2025, the study employs descriptive, correlation and regression analyses to evaluate differences in market quality. Liquidity is measured using trading volume and turnover ratio, while volatility is derived from daily stock returns. Price discovery efficiency is assessed through the correlation between individual stock returns and their respective index movements.

The research aims to reveal how variations in liquidity and trading activity influence volatility patterns and the speed at which information is incorporated into prices. It is expected that mid-cap stocks will demonstrate relatively higher volatility and lower liquidity than large-cap counter parts, reflecting greater sensitivity to information shocks and trading imbalances. Furthermore, higher trading activity is anticipated to enhance price stability and improve the overall efficiency of price discovery.

This study contributes to the growing body of literature on market microstructure in emerging economies by focusing on an underexplored segment of the Indian equity market. Its insights will be valuable to investors, regulators, and policymakers seeking to strengthen liquidity mechanisms and promote efficient and transparent market structures. These findings also hold significance for the cost and management accounting community, as efficient liquidity conditions and stable price discovery directly support more accurate valuation, better capital allocation, and informed managerial financial decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨印度中盘股市场中流动性、波动性与价格发现效率之间的关系，发现中盘股相比大盘股具有更高波动性和更低流动性，但交易活动增加能提升价格稳定性和价格发现效率。
AI.research_question: 印度中盘股市场中，流动性和交易活动如何影响波动性模式和价格发现效率？
AI.motivation: 理解流动性、波动性和价格发现效率之间的相互作用对评估股票市场质量和信息效率至关重要，特别是在新兴经济体的中盘股这一研究不足的细分市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论，关注流动性、波动性和价格发现效率之间的关系，以及信息不对称和交易活动对市场质量的影响。
AI.method: 使用2025年1月至6月NSE中盘股和大盘股的日度数据，进行描述性统计、相关性和回归分析。流动性通过交易量和换手率衡量，波动性通过日度股票收益率计算，价格发现效率通过个股收益率与相应指数变动的相关性评估。
AI.findings: 中盘股相比大盘股表现出更高的波动性和更低的流动性，反映了对信息冲击和交易不平衡的更大敏感性。更高的交易活动能增强价格稳定性并提高价格发现效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴经济体市场微观结构文献做出贡献，特别关注印度股市中研究不足的中盘股细分市场，深化了对流动性、波动性和价格发现效率之间关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管者和政策制定者提供洞察，帮助他们加强流动性机制，促进高效透明的市场结构。对成本和管理会计社区也有重要意义，因为高效的流动性条件和稳定的价格发现支持更准确的估值、更好的资本配置和明智的管理财务决策。

title: Estimating the Likely Harms from Global Warming: A Fresh Look at Accounting for Adaptation and Resilience, and Recommendations for a Bottom-Up Approach

detail.title: Estimating the Likely Harms from Global Warming: A Fresh Look at Accounting for Adaptation and Resilience, and Recommendations for a Bottom-Up Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No relationship to other organizations.
declarations.funderStatement: No outside funding.

detail.abstract:
We urgently need to determine a reasonable ballpark estimate for the likely harms from global warming before we commit to a set of mitigation policies, because aggressive mitigation of global warming by forcing a quick transition to low-emissions technologies could be very costly and disruptive to human society, while slow action could leave us vulnerable to serious harms from climate change.  I attempt here to improve our understanding of the likely harms if we do nothing to reduce global warming.  This paper does three things: (1) evaluates the literature on the harms from global warming, and finds it lacking; (2) introduces an alternative framework for analyzing the harms, that incorporates adaptation and resilience, and is based on a bottom-up approach with multiple metrics and types of harms; and (3) provides a very preliminary assessment of the likely harms under a business-as-usual scenario.  I provide some new perspectives on the debate, namely that human society has developed a tremendous resilience and ability to adapt to known weather events, and yet global warming will generate new kinds of weather events that could cause significant harm because of their surprise factor.  This paper is primarily about the methodology of estimating harms – it does not provide firm conclusions or numerical estimates of the likely harms, especially in the long run where there is great uncertainty about possible climate changes and harms. It also points out certain issues that need to be addressed, and key questions to be answered, for those who assert that the harms will be high, or that the harms will be low.  

In the literature, there is major disagreement on the size of likely harms from global warming, with scientists and activists warning that global warming is an existential threat requiring an immediate transition to non-carbon emissions technologies, while economists and modelers’ Integrated Assessment Models (IAMs) predicting much smaller harms, about 0-4% of GDP income reduction for a global temperature increase of 2-4°C.  I argue that neither side provides a reasonable forward-looking methodology for measuring the likely harms to human society from climate change.  In particular we should account for how human resilience and adaptation can significantly reduce the impact of most foreseeable climate events and changes, but we should be aware that surprise and extreme events and major climate changes could cause large harms. 

I recommend that an alternative methodology be used, that builds a bottom-up approach with a more granular analysis based on likely mechanisms of harm.  The analysis should be performed for each type of climate event of concern, such as storms, heat and cold waves, floods, droughts, wildfires, and sea level rise.  Rather than relying on a single metric of harm, I recommend using multiple metrics for measuring harms, including deaths, damages, subpopulation harms, disruption, discomfort, and biodiversity, with the emphasis on deaths and the impact on human social welfare.  Key factors that affect the likely size of harms include the resilience of human society to various likely climate events; the likelihood of adaptation to observed changes; the ability of climate change to surprise us with new and unexpected events; and the presence of certain human co-factors: poverty and the level of development, the impact of war, and government mismanagement. 

The paper provides some tentative conclusions that global warming will increasingly generate significant harms to our way of life, but is unlikely to cause huge casualties in the short run, especially in the developed world.  Our improved ability to adapt and handle most adverse climate events is evidenced by the decline of peacetime famines in the last 200 years.  Unless a new catastrophic scenario becomes apparent, this is not an existential threat, but we may end up miserable with a significant loss of life, income and quality of life.  However, since we are entering uncharted territory, there is a significant level of uncertainty concerning the likely harms we face in the long run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估全球变暖危害的新方法论框架，强调需要考虑人类适应性和韧性，采用自下而上的多指标分析方法，指出当前文献对危害评估存在不足，认为全球变暖虽非生存威胁但会造成显著生活质量下降。
AI.research_question: 如何合理评估全球变暖对人类社会的潜在危害？
AI.motivation: 在制定减缓政策前需要合理估算全球变暖的危害范围，因为过于激进的减缓措施可能成本高昂且破坏社会，而行动过慢又可能使社会面临严重的气候变化危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于适应性和韧性的分析框架，强调人类社会的适应能力可以显著减少可预见气候事件的影响，但意外和极端事件可能造成重大危害。
AI.method: 自下而上的多指标分析方法，针对不同类型气候事件（风暴、热浪、洪水、干旱、野火、海平面上升等）进行细粒度分析，使用多种危害指标（死亡、损害、亚群体危害、破坏、不适、生物多样性等）。
AI.findings: 全球变暖将日益对生活方式产生显著危害，但短期内不太可能造成大规模伤亡（特别是在发达国家）；人类适应能力增强的证据是过去200年和平时期饥荒减少；除非出现新的灾难性情景，否则这不是生存威胁，但可能导致生活质量显著下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估气候危害的新方法论框架，强调适应性和韧性的作用，挑战了现有文献中过于简单化的危害评估方法，为更全面的危害分析提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更合理的危害评估方法，指出了需要关注的关键因素（社会韧性、适应能力、意外事件、贫困、战争、政府管理不善等），帮助平衡减缓政策的成本与效益。

title: Reconciling Risk and Workers’ Rights: The EU’s Risk-Based Approach to Algorithmic Management and Its Implications for Labour Law
affiliations: Universita degli Studi di Torino

detail.title: Reconciling Risk and Workers’ Rights: The EU’s Risk-Based Approach to Algorithmic Management and Its Implications for Labour Law

contentType.other: Final unformatted version of a paper forthcoming in the European Labour Law Journal (after peer review)

detail.abstract: This paper examines the expansion of the EU's risk-based approach to the governance of algorithmic management and its implications for labour law. Risk-based regulation - as embodied in the GDPR, the AI Act, and the Platform Work Directive - relies on anticipatory and context-sensitive mechanisms, most notably impact assessments, to identify and manage risks before harm occurs. These techniques remain largely unfamiliar to labour law, which has traditionally relied on a rightsbased approach based on prescriptive norms generally aimed at the outright prevention of harm. As a result, scholars have expressed concern that importing a logic of risk tolerance into the domain of workers' rights may erode established protections and trigger deregulatory drift. After analysing the core features of the EU's risk-based approach and its interaction with labour law, the paper argues that these tensions can be generally reconciled through interpretation. When impact assessments concern workers' rights, they should be read as requiring risk elimination rather than mere mitigation, thereby aligning risk-based regulation with the protective core of labour law. Although enforcement challenges remain and are primarily a matter for policy intervention, the paper contends that risk-based regulation - if properly framed and interpreted - does not necessarily undermine labour law's foundational logic, but can enhance its anticipatory and preventive capacity in the governance of algorithmic management.

AI.tldr: 欧盟将基于风险的监管方法扩展到算法管理治理，与传统劳动法的权利本位方法存在张力，但通过将风险评估解释为要求消除风险而非仅仅减轻风险，两者可以协调，从而增强劳动法在算法管理中的预防能力。
AI.research_question: 欧盟基于风险的监管方法扩展到算法管理治理对劳动法有何影响？如何协调基于风险的监管与劳动法保护核心之间的张力？
AI.motivation: 欧盟在GDPR、AI法案和平台工作指令中采用了基于风险的监管方法，这种方法主要依赖前瞻性和情境敏感的机制（如影响评估）来识别和管理风险。然而，劳动法传统上采用基于权利的方法，依赖规范性规则来预防伤害。学者担心将风险容忍逻辑引入工人权利领域可能侵蚀既有保护并引发去监管化趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 基于风险的监管理论（risk-based regulation）
2. 劳动法的权利本位方法（rights-based approach）
3. 算法治理理论
4. 监管协调与解释理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架，分析欧盟基于风险监管方法的核心特征及其与劳动法的互动关系，通过解释学方法探讨协调可能性。
AI.findings:
1. 欧盟基于风险的监管方法与传统劳动法确实存在张力
2. 通过适当的解释，这些张力可以协调：当影响评估涉及工人权利时，应被解释为要求消除风险而非仅仅减轻风险
3. 这种解释使基于风险的监管与劳动法的保护核心保持一致
4. 虽然执行挑战仍然存在，但适当框架和解释下的基于风险监管不会削弱劳动法的基本逻辑，反而能增强其在算法管理治理中的前瞻性和预防能力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了协调基于风险监管与劳动法保护核心的理论框架
2. 发展了风险消除（而非仅仅减轻）的解释原则
3. 为算法管理治理提供了整合监管方法的新视角
4. 丰富了劳动法在数字时代的适应性理论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了协调欧盟监管框架与劳动法保护的实际指导
2. 为企业实施算法管理影响评估提供了明确标准（要求风险消除）
3. 为劳动法执法机构提供了处理算法管理风险的新工具
4. 增强了劳动法在应对新兴技术挑战时的预防能力

title: Fiscal News and the Macroeconomy: Evidence from UK Budget Announcements
affiliations: European University Institute and University of Glasgow - Adam Smith Business School

detail.title: Fiscal News and the Macroeconomy: Evidence from UK Budget Announcements
detail.abstract: This paper studies how fiscal news affects the macroeconomy. We use a novel identification strategy to isolate fiscal policy news shocks using high-frequency responses of financial markets to periodic and comprehensive fiscal announcements covering spending, taxation and debt issuance in the United Kingdom. Inside a local projections framework, we track the transmission of fiscal news shocks to yields on government debt, and then to output, prices, broader financial markets, households and firms. A negative fiscal news shock leads to sell-offs in both Gilts and Sterling, leading to tighter financial conditions, imported inflation, and depressed economic activity. The negative news leads to higher deficits through reduced tax collection without offsetting spending reductions. The Bank of England is on average slow to offset tighter financial conditions, however monetary offset appears to be stronger in the era of central bank independence and inflation targeting. We find meaningful heterogeneity in macro responses depending on the state of the business cycle and sign of the shock.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用高频金融市场数据识别英国财政政策新闻冲击，发现负面财政新闻会导致国债和英镑抛售、金融条件收紧、输入性通胀和经济活动抑制，且财政赤字会因税收减少而扩大。货币政策抵消作用在央行独立和通胀目标制时期更强，宏观响应存在显著的商业周期状态和冲击符号异质性。
AI.research_question: 财政政策新闻如何影响宏观经济？负面财政新闻冲击通过什么渠道传导，以及货币政策如何响应？
AI.motivation: 理解财政政策新闻对经济的影响机制，特别是通过金融市场传导的渠道，以及货币政策在其中的作用，对于政策制定和宏观经济稳定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政政策传导理论、金融市场反应理论和货币政策响应理论，构建财政新闻冲击对宏观经济影响的综合分析框架。
AI.method: 采用新颖的识别策略，利用高频金融市场对英国定期全面财政公告（支出、税收和债务发行）的反应来识别财政政策新闻冲击，并在局部投影框架内追踪冲击传导路径。
AI.findings: 负面财政新闻冲击导致国债和英镑抛售，金融条件收紧，输入性通胀，经济活动抑制；财政赤字因税收减少而扩大；英格兰银行平均响应较慢，但在央行独立和通胀目标制时期货币政策抵消作用更强；宏观响应存在显著的商业周期状态和冲击符号异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于高频金融市场反应的财政新闻冲击识别方法；揭示了财政新闻通过金融市场传导到实体经济的完整渠道；发现了货币政策响应的时间异质性和制度依赖性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了财政公告管理的参考；帮助理解财政与货币政策协调的重要性；为投资者提供了财政新闻冲击下资产价格变动的预测框架。

title: Public and expert preferences for biodiversity metrics and the implications for shadow pricing
affiliations: , University of Exeter, University of Trento and University of Exeter

detail.title: Public and expert preferences for biodiversity metrics and the implications for shadow pricing
detail.abstract: Biodiversity metrics are critical across a myriad of policy arenas, from Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) disclosures to international agreements and biodiversity offsetting schemes. However, the welfare implications of biodiversity metric selection remain poorly understood. We use a choice experiment to elicit preferences over key terrestrial biodiversity attributes from the British public, ecologists, and practitioners in the financial sector, avoiding problematic money-biodiversity trade-offs. Instead, elicited preferences are used to construct a welfare-based biodiversity metric that could underpin shadow pricing in pursuit of biodiversity policy targets, analogous to cost-based approaches in climate policies. All three groups prioritise enhancing species richness, preserving genetic distinctiveness, and preventing extinctions. In contrast, they show practical indifference to intactness measures, despite their widespread use in biodiversity policy, crediting, and ESG reporting. A case study of restoration site selection across Great Britain highlights the potential for substantial welfare and cost differences depending on which biodiversity metric guides policy decisions, and the large gains that a utility-based metric offers.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过选择实验方法，收集英国公众、生态学家和金融从业者对陆地生物多样性属性的偏好，构建基于福利的生物多样性度量指标，用于支持生物多样性政策的影子定价。研究发现所有群体都优先考虑增加物种丰富度、保护遗传独特性和防止灭绝，但对完整性指标表现出实际上的漠不关心。案例研究表明，不同生物多样性度量指标的选择会导致显著的福利和成本差异。
AI.research_question: 如何构建基于福利的生物多样性度量指标来支持生物多样性政策的影子定价？不同利益相关群体对生物多样性属性的偏好有何差异？不同生物多样性度量指标的选择对政策决策的福利和成本影响如何？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性度量指标在ESG披露、国际协议和生物多样性补偿计划等多种政策领域中至关重要，但生物多样性指标选择的福利影响仍然知之甚少。当前缺乏对生物多样性属性偏好的理解，特别是在避免有问题的金钱-生物多样性权衡的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于福利的经济学理论，选择实验方法，影子定价理论，类比气候政策中的成本基础方法，生物多样性属性偏好理论。
AI.method: 采用选择实验方法，从英国公众、生态学家和金融从业者三个群体中收集对关键陆地生物多样性属性的偏好数据。避免直接进行金钱-生物多样性权衡，而是使用偏好数据构建福利基础的生物多样性度量指标。通过英国恢复地点选择的案例研究来比较不同度量指标的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 所有三个群体（公众、生态学家、金融从业者）都优先考虑增强物种丰富度、保护遗传独特性和防止灭绝。
2. 所有群体对完整性指标表现出实际上的漠不关心，尽管这些指标在生物多样性政策、信用和ESG报告中广泛使用。
3. 案例研究表明，根据指导政策决策的生物多样性度量指标不同，会产生显著的福利和成本差异。
4. 基于效用的度量指标相比传统指标能带来更大的收益。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 开发了基于福利的生物多样性度量指标构建方法，为生物多样性影子定价提供理论基础。
2. 揭示了不同利益相关群体对生物多样性属性的一致性和差异性偏好模式。
3. 提出了避免金钱-生物多样性直接权衡的偏好获取方法。
4. 将气候政策中的成本基础方法类比应用于生物多样性政策领域。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了基于福利的生物多样性度量工具，支持更有效的政策决策。
2. 揭示了当前广泛使用的完整性指标与公众偏好之间的脱节，建议政策调整。
3. 为ESG披露、生物多样性补偿和国际协议提供了改进的度量框架。
4. 通过案例研究展示了不同度量指标选择对实际政策结果的重要影响。

title: The Impact of Ozone Pollution on Hospitalizations
affiliations: Peking University, Peking University, Institute for Economic and Social Research, Jinan University and Peking University - National School of Development

detail.title: The Impact of Ozone Pollution on Hospitalizations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: MISSING
declarations.funderStatement: MISSING

detail.abstract: This paper estimates the impacts of ozone pollution on hospitalizations, medical expenditure, and in-hospital mortality using inpatient admission records from 1,087 hospitals in China between 2017 and 2021. Leveraging an instrumental variable based on ozone concentrations in nearby upwind cities, we find that ozone significantly increases all-cause hospitalizations and medical expenditure. Ozone elevates hospital admissions across a broader range of diseases than previously documented, and the hospitalization cost of 1-standard deviation increase in ozone is larger than that of PM2.5. Ozone reduces the average number of doctors per inpatient and increases the all-cause in-hospital mortality rate in emergency departments, suggesting that ozone-induced surges in healthcare demand generate hospital crowding, which lowers the quality of care and worsens patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国1087家医院2017-2021年的住院记录，评估臭氧污染对住院率、医疗支出和院内死亡率的影响。研究发现臭氧显著增加全因住院和医疗支出，影响疾病范围比先前认知更广，且医疗成本影响大于PM2.5。臭氧还导致医院拥挤，降低医疗质量，增加急诊死亡率。
AI.research_question: 臭氧污染如何影响中国的住院率、医疗支出和院内死亡率？
AI.motivation: 臭氧污染对健康的影响日益受到关注，但现有研究主要关注特定疾病，缺乏对整体医疗系统影响的全面评估，特别是对医疗资源分配和患者结局的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和健康经济学理论，研究臭氧污染通过影响健康需求进而影响医疗资源分配和医疗质量的机制。
AI.method: 使用中国1087家医院2017-2021年的住院记录数据，采用基于上风向城市臭氧浓度的工具变量法，控制内生性问题。
AI.findings: 1) 臭氧显著增加全因住院和医疗支出；2) 影响疾病范围比先前认知更广；3) 臭氧的医疗成本影响大于PM2.5；4) 臭氧导致医院拥挤，降低医生-患者比例，增加急诊死亡率。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了空气污染健康影响的理论框架，揭示了臭氧通过医疗系统拥挤效应影响患者结局的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供臭氧污染医疗成本的具体证据，强调需要综合考虑医疗系统容量和资源配置，优化空气污染治理策略。

title: Documentation Gap Analysis: Independent Audit of TGA COVID-19 Vaccine Safety Monitoring Plan

detail.title: Documentation Gap Analysis: Independent Audit of TGA COVID-19 Vaccine Safety Monitoring Plan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I do not have any personal or financial relationship with other parties related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This is self funded research.

detail.abstract:
This independent audit systematically evaluates the TGA COVID-19 Vaccine Safety Monitoring Plan (February 2021), which operationalised National Cabinet's commitment to enhanced pharmacovigilance under provisional approval across 68.4 million doses (91.2% of Australia's rollout) — addressing regulatory governance's core accountability problem: enhanced monitoring claims cannot be independently verified when underlying processes remain undocumented.

Findings reveal systematic documentation failures without precedent in Australian provisional medicine regulation. Only 3 of 20 Plan-specified outputs (15%) are fully documented; 17 (85%) are partially or not documented — despite TGA organising 2,218+ pages by Plan objectives for the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) in September 2024. TGA reports 148 signals investigated and 57 regulatory actions taken, yet no audit trail links signals to actions or accounts for 91 unresolved signals. The OAIC confirmed the absence of implementation records.

Senior TGA officials testified before the Senate (9 October 2025) that monitoring occurred through "day-to-day processes" without systematic Plan tracking. TGA cannot demonstrate documented compliance with its own Safety Monitoring Plan — a regulatory accountability failure of serious consequence for the largest provisional medicine rollout in Australia's history.

The open-source methodology applies ISO 19011:2018, ANAO guidance, and OSINT principles to public records and FOI responses, published under CC BY 4.0 — fully open access and independently replicable.

AI.tldr: 该独立审计系统评估了TGA COVID-19疫苗安全监测计划（2021年2月），发现该计划存在系统性文件记录失败，仅有15%的计划产出有完整记录，监管机构无法证明其遵守了自己的安全监测计划，这在澳大利亚临时药品监管史上无先例。
AI.research_question: TGA COVID-19疫苗安全监测计划（2021年2月）的执行情况如何？该计划是否实现了其声称的增强药物警戒目标？
AI.motivation: 解决监管治理的核心问责问题：当底层流程未记录时，增强监测的声明无法独立验证。这是澳大利亚历史上最大的临时药品推广计划，涉及6840万剂疫苗（占澳大利亚推广量的91.2%）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管问责理论、药物警戒框架、ISO 19011:2018审计标准、澳大利亚国家审计办公室（ANAO）指南、开源情报（OSINT）原则
AI.method: 采用ISO 19011:2018、ANAO指南和OSINT原则的开源方法，分析公共记录和信息自由法（FOI）回应，完全开放获取且可独立复制
AI.findings:
1. 系统性文件记录失败：20项计划产出中仅3项（15%）有完整记录，17项（85%）部分或未记录
2. TGA报告调查了148个信号并采取了57项监管行动，但无审计追踪链接信号与行动，91个未解决信号未说明
3. 澳大利亚信息专员办公室确认缺乏实施记录
4. TGA高级官员承认监测通过"日常流程"进行，无系统性计划跟踪
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了监管问责在临时药品批准中的系统性失效
2. 提供了评估监管机构合规性的开源审计方法框架
3. 强调了增强监测声明需要可验证的文档支持的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 暴露了澳大利亚最大临时药品推广计划的监管问责失败
2. 为未来公共卫生紧急情况下的监管监测提供了改进建议
3. 建立了可复制的独立审计方法，可供其他监管机构借鉴
4. 强调了透明度和文档记录在监管治理中的关键作用

title: Modeling Disease Comorbidity Among Medicare Beneficiaries Through Social Determinants of Health: Advances in Multi-Target Machine Learning
affiliations: University of Rhode Island, Independent, University of Rhode Island and University of Rhode Island

detail.title: Modeling Disease Comorbidity Among Medicare Beneficiaries Through Social Determinants of Health: Advances in Multi-Target Machine Learning

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Amid proposed 2025 U.S. federal budget cuts targeting physician payments, vaccines, and capital equipment, ensuring accurate and equitable diagnoses for Medicare beneficiaries has become increasingly critical. This study addresses that need by developing a model that integrates altruistic values and social determinants of health (SDOH) to predict five common comorbidities among beneficiaries-high blood pressure, stroke, depression, emphysema, and diabetes-across three COVID-era Medicare cohorts (Spring 2020, Fall 2020, Winter 2021). Utilizing survey data from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, we implement an optimized multi-target Radial Basis Function Neural Network (K4-MRBFN) and apply Shapley values from explainable AI (XAI) to assess feature importance and model transparency. K4-MRBFN consistently performed well with at least 89% accuracy across all cohorts. Income and rent payment ability emerged as the strongest predictors, highlighting financial stress as a key risk factor during the pandemic. Age, sex, and social connectedness were also influential, while access to food, home supplies, and medication had less impact. Depression was closely linked to unmet basic needs (excluding medication), underscoring persistent social support gaps. The current study findings highlight the importance of incorporating SDOH and ethical frameworks in evaluating disease states using novel advances in AI-driven healthcare tools.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个整合利他价值观和社会健康决定因素（SDOH）的模型，用于预测Medicare受益人中的五种常见共病（高血压、中风、抑郁、肺气肿和糖尿病）。使用优化的多目标径向基函数神经网络（K4-MRBFN）在三个COVID时期Medicare队列中实现了至少89%的准确率，并通过可解释AI的Shapley值分析发现收入和租金支付能力是最强预测因子。
AI.research_question: 如何整合利他价值观和社会健康决定因素（SDOH）来准确预测Medicare受益人中的五种常见共病（高血压、中风、抑郁、肺气肿和糖尿病）？
AI.motivation: 在2025年美国联邦预算削减针对医生支付、疫苗和资本设备的背景下，确保Medicare受益人获得准确和公平的诊断变得日益重要。COVID-19大流行期间，医疗保健系统面临额外压力，需要开发能够考虑社会因素和伦理框架的预测模型。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 社会健康决定因素（SDOH）理论：强调社会经济条件、环境因素和社会支持对健康结果的影响
2. 利他价值观框架：将伦理考虑融入医疗预测模型
3. 可解释人工智能（XAI）理论：通过Shapley值等方法提高模型透明度和可解释性
AI.method:
1. 数据来源：使用Medicare和Medicaid服务中心的调查数据
2. 研究设计：横断面研究，分析三个COVID时期Medicare队列（2020年春季、2020年秋季、2021年冬季）
3. 预测目标：五种常见共病（高血压、中风、抑郁、肺气肿、糖尿病）
4. 分析方法：优化的多目标径向基函数神经网络（K4-MRBFN）
5. 可解释性分析：应用Shapley值评估特征重要性和模型透明度
AI.findings:
1. K4-MRBFN模型在所有队列中表现一致良好，准确率至少达到89%
2. 收入和租金支付能力是最强的预测因子，凸显了疫情期间财务压力作为关键风险因素的重要性
3. 年龄、性别和社会联系也具有显著影响
4. 食物、家庭用品和药物获取的影响较小
5. 抑郁与未满足的基本需求（除药物外）密切相关，表明社会支持缺口持续存在
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 开发了一个整合SDOH和利他价值观的理论框架，用于医疗预测建模
2. 展示了如何将伦理考虑系统地融入AI驱动的医疗工具
3. 扩展了可解释AI在医疗健康领域的应用，提高了模型透明度和可信度
4. 为多目标医疗预测问题提供了新的方法论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了一个准确预测Medicare受益人常见共病的实用工具
2. 识别了财务压力作为关键风险因素，为政策制定者提供了干预重点
3. 强调了社会支持系统在心理健康（特别是抑郁）中的重要性
4. 为医疗资源分配和预算决策提供了数据支持
5. 展示了AI工具如何帮助在预算限制下优化医疗服务质量

title: Critically Evaluate the Legislative and Regulatory Steps Taken in Response to White Collar Crimes After the Financial Crisis in the UK and US

detail.title: Critically Evaluate the Legislative and Regulatory Steps Taken in Response to White Collar Crimes After the Financial Crisis in the UK and US
detail.abstract: The impacts of the financial crisis which was at its peak between 2007-2008 are still visible in the financial markets across the globe. It has brought about the most prevalent change in the world’s economic and financial landscape. The economies of United Kingdom and United States has been deemed to have suffered from the hardest hit of the global financial crisis. It has essentially originated from credit markets in economically dominant countries such as UK and US, and the wrath of the crisis has then travelled across Europe. The causes behind the crisis has appeared to be manifold. This thesis considers one of the causes behind the financial crisis, closely albeit the author acknowledges that it is not the sole cause of the financial crisis but it is one of the significant causes behind the crisis. The focus of the thesis is thus white collar crimes associated with the financial crisis in both UK and US markets. The research follows on to critically assess the regulatory and legislative approaches taken towards white collar crimes in both the jurisdiction. Although, in both countries many strong provisions have been made followed by the financial crisis to tackle white collar crimes but amongst other failures, they have failed to ensure prosecution against the high profile perpetrators who committed the white collar crimes associated with the financial crisis. The research criticises the shortcomings of the responses taken in both countries to the extent to which they were ineffective whilst acknowledging the successful responses which brought about effective results like recovery of funds in the form of fines.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究2007-2008年全球金融危机中白领犯罪问题，分析英美两国对此的监管和立法应对措施，批评其未能有效起诉高知名度犯罪者，同时承认罚款追回等成功之处。
AI.research_question: 英美两国针对金融危机相关白领犯罪的监管和立法应对措施存在哪些有效性和不足之处？
AI.motivation: 2007-2008年全球金融危机对世界经济格局造成深远影响，英美作为危机起源地受冲击最严重。白领犯罪是导致危机的重要原因之一，需要研究两国对此的应对措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 白领犯罪理论、金融监管理论、法律执行理论、金融危机成因理论
AI.method: 比较分析法、批判性评估法、文献分析法，对英美两国的监管和立法措施进行对比分析
AI.findings:
1. 英美两国在危机后制定了强有力的白领犯罪应对条款
2. 两国措施在追回罚款资金方面取得一定成效
3. 但未能有效起诉与金融危机相关的高知名度白领犯罪者
4. 整体应对措施存在明显不足和无效之处
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 深化了金融危机与白领犯罪关系的理论理解
2. 拓展了跨国金融监管比较研究的理论框架
3. 为金融犯罪法律执行有效性理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者改进白领犯罪监管提供参考
2. 指出当前法律执行体系在起诉高知名度犯罪者方面的缺陷
3. 为国际金融监管合作提供经验教训
4. 帮助理解金融危机后监管改革的实际效果

title: Vaccination Hesitancy And Its Impact On Peadiatric Public Health

detail.title: Vaccination Hesitancy And Its Impact On Peadiatric Public Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The research was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding from public, commercial, or not-for-profit organizations.

detail.abstract: Vaccination hesitancy has become a worldwide public health issue that is jeopardizing routine immunization programs and causing vaccine-preventable diseases to reappear. For several socioeconomic and cultural settings, this has become a public health challenge. These documents combine evidence concerning the prevalence, the factors influencing, and the impact, on hesitancy related to vaccines among parent and guardians of children. This analysis merges peer-reviewed narratives, policy documents, and surveys between 2015 and 2025 and integrates qualitative and quantitative analysis to map out certain aspects and contextual elements. There exists evidence that indicates a significant positive correlation between hesitancy regarding pediatric vaccines and a reduction in overall vaccination rates, with a particular emphasis on the rate of vaccination for measles and other multi-dose childhood vaccines. (Elawad et al.). Element of hesitancy involves absence of accurate and contextualized risk analysis, lack of health knowledge, socioeconomic disadvantage, culturally and religiously grounded beliefs, and inequitable distribution of healthcare services and professional trust.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2015-2025年间关于儿童疫苗接种犹豫的文献，发现疫苗犹豫与整体疫苗接种率下降显著相关，特别是麻疹等多剂量儿童疫苗。影响因素包括缺乏准确的风险分析、健康知识不足、社会经济劣势、文化宗教信念以及医疗资源分配不均等。
AI.research_question: 儿童家长和监护人的疫苗犹豫的普遍程度、影响因素及其对疫苗接种率的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 疫苗犹豫已成为全球公共卫生问题，威胁常规免疫计划并导致疫苗可预防疾病的重新出现，这对不同社会经济和文化背景的公共卫生构成挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共卫生、行为科学和社会决定因素理论，分析疫苗犹豫的多维度影响因素框架。
AI.method: 整合2015-2025年间的同行评议文献、政策文件和调查数据，采用定性和定量分析相结合的方法，绘制疫苗犹豫的各个方面和背景因素。
AI.findings: 1. 儿科疫苗犹豫与整体疫苗接种率下降存在显著正相关，特别是麻疹等多剂量儿童疫苗；2. 疫苗犹豫的主要因素包括：缺乏准确和情境化的风险分析、健康知识不足、社会经济劣势、文化和宗教信念、医疗资源分配不均和专业信任缺失。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了疫苗犹豫的多因素综合分析框架，整合了认知、社会经济、文化和系统层面的影响因素，为理解疫苗犹豫的复杂性提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定者提供了针对性的干预方向：改善风险沟通、加强健康教育、解决社会经济不平等、尊重文化多样性、优化医疗资源分配和建立专业信任。

detail.abstract: This study investigates diabetes risk factors among women using the Pima Indian Diabetes dataset, publicly available from the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK). Principal Component Analysis (PCA) was applied to identify the key clinical and physiological features, including blood sugar level, Body Mass Index (BMI), number of pregnancies, and diabetes pedigree function, that are responsible for increasing the risk of diabetes. Logistic regression was then used to model and predict diabetes risk based on these features. The model was well fitted with an accuracy of 78.26%, with moderate sensitivity (58.21%) and high specificity (89%). Applying PCA for feature selection improved model performance, and increased the prediction accuracy to 82.47%. These findings highlight the importance of dimensional reduction and feature selection in improving the model interpretability and predictive performance. The study recommends the use of PCA in combination with logistic regression to improve the accuracy in identifying significant factors and predict diabetes risk in women.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用Pima印第安人糖尿病数据集，通过主成分分析(PCA)识别关键糖尿病风险因素，结合逻辑回归预测糖尿病风险，发现PCA特征选择可将预测准确率从78.26%提升至82.47%。
AI.research_question: 如何识别女性糖尿病的关键风险因素，并提高糖尿病风险预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 糖尿病是全球重大公共卫生问题，需要准确识别风险因素和预测方法，特别是针对高风险人群如Pima印第安女性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主成分分析(PCA)的降维理论和逻辑回归的统计建模理论，结合特征选择方法提高模型性能。
AI.method: 使用Pima印第安人糖尿病数据集，应用PCA进行特征选择和降维，然后使用逻辑回归建模预测糖尿病风险。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出血糖水平、BMI、怀孕次数和糖尿病谱系函数为关键风险因素；2. 基础逻辑回归模型准确率78.26%，敏感性58.21%，特异性89%；3. PCA特征选择后准确率提升至82.47%。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了PCA在特征选择和降维中的有效性，为糖尿病风险预测提供了理论支持，展示了降维技术如何提高模型解释性和预测性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗实践提供了有效的糖尿病风险评估工具，推荐PCA结合逻辑回归的方法，帮助临床医生更准确地识别高风险女性并采取预防措施。

title: Reducing Waste through Anti-Fraud Enforcement: Evidence from Hospital Admission Cases
affiliations: Emory University - Department of Health Policy and Management and Boston University

detail.title: Reducing Waste through Anti-Fraud Enforcement: Evidence from Hospital Admission Cases
detail.abstract: The use of federal anti-fraud laws to address unnecessary medical care is controversial. Targeted providers frequently argue that, in their judgment, the treatment in question was appropriate. We examine the effects of anti-fraud litigation against hospitals for over-admitting patients from the emergency department, using 100% Medicare claims for 2005-2019 and a design based on the staggered rollout of these lawsuits. We find that anti-fraud lawsuits reduced admission rates by 3.6 percentage points without increasing mortality rates. We estimate five-year savings to Medicare of $1.3 billion. Our results suggest that anti-fraud enforcement can be successful in reducing costly, unnecessary care.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了联邦反欺诈诉讼对医院过度收治急诊患者的影响，发现诉讼使入院率降低3.6个百分点，未增加死亡率，五年为Medicare节省13亿美元，表明反欺诈执法能有效减少不必要的医疗成本。
AI.research_question: 联邦反欺诈诉讼对医院过度收治急诊患者的行为有何影响？这些诉讼是否能有效减少不必要的医疗护理，同时不损害患者健康？
AI.motivation: 使用联邦反欺诈法律解决不必要的医疗服务存在争议，被指控的医疗机构经常辩称其治疗决策是合理的。需要实证证据来评估反欺诈诉讼的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗欺诈理论、医院行为经济学和监管威慑理论，探讨法律干预如何影响医疗机构的决策行为。
AI.method: 使用2005-2019年100%的Medicare索赔数据，采用交错推出设计的准实验方法分析反欺诈诉讼的因果效应。
AI.findings: 反欺诈诉讼使入院率降低3.6个百分点，未增加死亡率，五年为Medicare节省13亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 为医疗欺诈监管的有效性提供了实证证据，支持法律威慑能改变医疗机构行为的理论，丰富了医疗法律经济学的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了反欺诈执法有效性的证据，有助于优化医疗监管策略，为Medicare节省大量资金，同时保障患者安全。

title: Racial Preferences at a Texas Medical School

detail.title: Racial Preferences at a Texas Medical School
detail.abstract: Whether and how race is used in selective admissions remains a central question in higher education and civil rights law. In Students for Fair Admissions v. Harvard (2023), the Supreme Court held that race-based aﬃrmative action in college admissions violates the Equal Protection Clause, purportedly ending the practice. This report examines admissions at a public medical school in the pre-SFFA period. Using applicant-level data on over 11,000 applications to Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center Medical School for the 2021 and 2022 cycles, I relate admission decisions to academic merit (MCAT, GPA, science GPA), race, gender, and situational judgment (Casper) scores. Summary statistics, academic-index decompositions, and logistic regression models provide strong evidence of racial preferences: African American and Hispanic applicants are preferred relative to academically similar White and Asian applicants. Counterfactual and preference-removal analyses quantify the magnitude of these disparities. The findings document the kind of race-based preferences that SFF A was meant to address and establish a baseline for assessing whether admissions practice changed after the decision.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2021-2022年德州理工大学健康科学中心医学院的招生数据，发现在最高法院禁止种族平权行动之前，该医学院存在明显的种族偏好：非裔和拉丁裔申请者相对于学术成绩相似的白人和亚裔申请者更受青睐。
AI.research_question: 在最高法院禁止种族平权行动之前，医学院招生中是否存在基于种族的偏好？这些偏好的程度如何？
AI.motivation: 最高法院在2023年裁定大学招生中的种族平权行动违宪，但在此之前医学院招生实践中种族因素的实际作用缺乏实证研究。本研究旨在为评估SFFA裁决后的招生实践变化建立基准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平等保护条款、平权行动理论、高等教育公平理论、招生决策中的种族因素分析框架
AI.method: 使用德州理工大学健康科学中心医学院2021-2022年超过11,000份申请数据，结合学术成绩（MCAT、GPA、科学GPA）、种族、性别和情境判断（Casper）分数，通过描述性统计、学术指数分解和逻辑回归模型进行分析，并进行反事实和偏好消除分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现存在明显的种族偏好：非裔和拉丁裔申请者相对于学术成绩相似的白人和亚裔申请者更受青睐。反事实分析量化了这些差异的程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为高等教育招生中的种族偏好提供了实证证据，建立了评估平权行动政策变化影响的基准框架，丰富了关于招生决策中种族因素作用的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了SFFA裁决前医学院招生实践中的种族偏好模式，为评估裁决后招生实践是否改变提供了基准，为政策制定者和教育机构提供了实证参考。

title: OnlyFans, More Than Taxpayers: Toward a Compliance Aesthetic in the Gig Economy
affiliations: Pace University - School of Law

detail.title: OnlyFans, More Than Taxpayers: Toward a Compliance Aesthetic in the Gig Economy
detail.abstract:
This Article examines how creators on the subscription-based platform OnlyFans understand and navigate their federal tax obligations, with particular attention to peer-to-peer advice shared in publicly accessible online forums. As independent contractors, OnlyFans creators must track income, manage expenses, and comply with complex self-employment tax rules. Yet little scholarly attention has been paid to how these creators talk about taxation or how tax compliance figures into their understanding of their work. This Article argues that tax discourse among OnlyFans creators reflects a distinctive rhetorical and cultural orientation that frames compliance not as a burdensome imposition, but as a meaningful component of professional identity. I call this phenomenon the compliance aesthetic: a self-conscious performance of legitimacy in which adherence to tax and legal norms operates as a claim to moral credibility and economic seriousness in a stigmatized line of work.

Drawing on qualitative analysis of posts from Reddit and the TurboTax Community, the Article shows that creators overwhelmingly seek to comply with tax law. Their discourse is procedural and entrepreneurial rather than resistant, centering on forms, deductions, recordkeeping, and long-term planning. Legitimacy is rarely asserted directly; instead, it is enacted through routine compliance talk that treats taxation as an ordinary feature of running a business. Although stigma and disclosure concerns arise—particularly in relation to family members, financial institutions, and software interfaces—creators navigate these risks strategically rather than retreating from compliance. Across both platforms, creators themselves, not tax professionals, perform the primary interpretive labor, sharing heuristics and normalizing compliance as part of adult economic participation.

The Article proceeds in five parts. Part I provides background on OnlyFans and its economic model. Part II situates the study within literature on gig workers, whose tax discourse often emphasizes confusion or resistance. Part III describes the research design and methodology. Part IV presents the findings through the lens of labor identity and legitimacy. Part V offers normative recommendations for the Internal Revenue Service and tax professionals, arguing that platform-aware guidance should recognize creators as proactive legal actors. In doing so, the Article repositions tax reporting as a site of identity formation, economic self-assertion, and cultural meaning-making among nontraditional workers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究OnlyFans创作者如何理解和应对联邦税务义务，特别关注他们在公开在线论坛中分享的同行建议。研究发现这些创作者通过"合规美学"将税务合规视为职业身份的重要组成部分，而非负担。
AI.research_question: OnlyFans创作者如何理解和应对联邦税务义务？他们在公开在线论坛中如何讨论税务合规问题？
AI.motivation: 作为独立承包商，OnlyFans创作者需要追踪收入、管理支出并遵守复杂的自雇税规则，但学术界很少关注这些创作者如何谈论税收或税务合规如何影响他们对工作的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合规美学（compliance aesthetic）理论：将税务合规视为一种自我意识的合法性表演，在这种表演中，遵守税收和法律规范成为在受污名化行业中主张道德可信度和经济严肃性的方式。
AI.method: 对Reddit和TurboTax Community论坛帖子的定性分析，研究创作者在公开在线论坛中的税务讨论。
AI.findings: 创作者普遍寻求遵守税法，他们的讨论是程序性和创业导向的，而非抵制性的。他们关注表格、扣除、记录保存和长期规划。合法性很少被直接主张，而是通过将税收视为经营业务的常规特征的日常合规讨论来体现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"合规美学"概念，将税务报告重新定位为非传统工作者身份形成、经济自我主张和文化意义创造的场所。挑战了零工工作者税务讨论通常强调困惑或抵制的现有文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国国税局和税务专业人士提供规范性建议，主张平台感知的指导应承认创作者是积极主动的法律行动者，并为他们提供更好的支持。

title: Transparency Features in Robo-Advice: Evidence, Mechanisms, and EU Policy Implications for Trust, Reliance, and Financial Inclusion
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Department of Management

detail.title: Transparency Features in Robo-Advice: Evidence, Mechanisms, and EU Policy Implications for Trust, Reliance, and Financial Inclusion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: Funded by the European Union – NextGenerationEU. This project is funded by the European Union's NextGenerationEU plan under the Italian Ministry of Universities and Research (MUR) "Young Researchers – Seal of Excellence" grant (Project SOE_0000193; CUP H73C22001440001). Views and opinions expressed are however those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Commission. Neither the European Union nor the European Commission can be held responsible for them. Host institution: Ca' Foscari University of Venice.

detail.abstract:
Digital investment advice increasingly combines automated recommendations with varying degrees of human support. Policy and design debates often assume that “more transparency”—explanations, disclosures, uncertainty communication, performance information, or human oversight cues—will unambiguously raise trust and improve consumer outcomes. This position/review paper maps the mechanisms through which transparency features can help or harm retail users, and synthesizes experimental and quasi-experimental evidence with a focus on outcomes relevant to trust/legitimacy, behavioral reliance, and access-to-human-support implications.

Methodologically, we implement a Scopus-based scoping-and-extraction protocol (1,000 candidate records retrieved; 101 machine-extracted records after user-defined screening), and then restrict substantive claims to a full-text verified subset of studies for which PDFs were obtained (N=7). The verified evidence suggests systematic trade-offs: (i) providing performance information can increase perceived trustworthiness but may backfire when presented in cognitively demanding formats that reduce advice-taking; (ii) human-in-the-loop designs can increase uptake, yet may reduce decision accuracy and shift responsibility perceptions; and (iii) trust is highly sensitive to experienced accuracy, with “bad advice” producing discrete drops in trusting intentions relative to near-perfect advice, consistent with asymmetric trust updates.

We integrate these findings with EU sectoral and cross-cutting governance constraints to derive testable propositions and research design implications for future survey and experimental research. The paper’s core design recommendation is calibrated transparency: layered, low-burden disclosure that improves understanding and accountability while preserving user agency and access to meaningful human support.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文探讨了数字投资建议中透明度特征对零售用户的影响机制，通过系统性文献回顾发现透明度存在权衡：绩效信息可能提高信任但降低建议采纳，人机协作设计可能增加使用但降低决策准确性，信任对准确性高度敏感。论文提出"校准透明度"的设计建议。
AI.research_question: 数字投资建议中的透明度特征（如解释、披露、不确定性沟通、绩效信息、人工监督线索）如何影响零售用户的信任、行为依赖和获取人工支持的意愿？
AI.motivation: 政策和设计辩论通常假设"更多透明度"会明确提高信任并改善消费者结果，但这种假设缺乏实证支持。需要系统理解透明度特征如何通过不同机制帮助或损害零售用户。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任理论、行为决策理论、透明度与披露理论、人机交互理论、不对称信任更新理论
AI.method: 采用Scopus范围界定和提取协议：检索1000条候选记录，经过用户定义筛选后机器提取101条记录，最终获取PDF全文验证7项研究。结合欧盟部门性和跨部门治理约束进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 提供绩效信息可提高感知可信度，但以认知要求高的格式呈现时可能适得其反，降低建议采纳；2. 人机协作设计可增加使用率，但可能降低决策准确性并改变责任感知；3. 信任对准确性高度敏感，"坏建议"相对于近乎完美的建议会导致信任意图的离散下降，符合不对称信任更新模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统识别透明度特征的帮助和损害机制；2. 提出透明度权衡框架；3. 验证不对称信任更新理论在数字投资建议中的适用性；4. 整合治理约束提出可检验命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出"校准透明度"核心设计建议：分层、低负担的披露，提高理解和问责，同时保护用户自主权和获取有意义人工支持；2. 为未来调查和实验研究提供研究设计启示；3. 为政策制定者提供基于证据的透明度设计指导。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning Classifiers for Short-Term Gold Price Direction: Statistical and Economic Evidence

detail.title: Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning Classifiers for Short-Term Gold Price Direction: Statistical and Economic Evidence
detail.abstract: This research aims to compare machine learning classifiers regarding their ability to predict short-term movements in gold prices. The study uses daily XAU/USD data spanning 2000 to 2025 and analyses the one-day-ahead price movement from a binary classification perspective. Technical indicators are used in conjunction with Machine Learning models Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Support Vector Machine to carry out a time-series out-of-sample evaluation. While some of the models report accuracy levels just above 50%, statistical inferences indicate that the predictive performance achieved by any of the models is not statistically significantly different from random classification. A review of confidence intervals and the use of McNemar’s test demonstrates that each of the models provides no statistically significant improvement over a naive benchmark. Further, an economic back-test of a model prediction-based trading strategy does not perform as well as a buy-and-hold benchmark and yields negative risk-adjusted returns. Overall results show that there is limited exploitable predictability for daily short-term movements in gold prices when only technical indicators are used, consistent with weak-form market efficiency and reinforcing that both statistical and economic evaluations need to be conducted when assessing financial forecasting models.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了多种机器学习分类器预测黄金短期价格走势的能力，发现所有模型在统计上都没有显著优于随机分类，基于模型预测的交易策略表现也不如买入持有策略，表明仅使用技术指标时黄金日度短期走势的可预测性有限。
AI.research_question: 机器学习分类器在预测黄金短期价格走势方面的表现如何？不同模型之间是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 黄金作为重要的避险资产和投资工具，其价格预测对投资者和交易者具有重要意义。虽然机器学习在金融预测中应用广泛，但对其在黄金价格预测中的实际效果需要更严谨的评估，特别是从统计和经济两个维度进行验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弱式市场效率理论、技术分析理论、机器学习预测理论、统计显著性检验理论
AI.method: 使用2000-2025年XAU/USD日度数据，将一日前价格走势预测作为二分类问题。采用逻辑回归、决策树、随机森林、梯度提升和支持向量机等机器学习模型，结合技术指标进行时间序列样本外评估。使用统计推断方法（包括置信区间和McNemar检验）评估模型性能，并进行经济回测分析交易策略表现。
AI.findings: 1. 所有机器学习模型的准确率仅略高于50%；2. 统计推断表明，任何模型的预测性能在统计上都与随机分类无显著差异；3. 基于模型预测的交易策略表现不如买入持有基准策略，产生负的风险调整后收益；4. 仅使用技术指标时，黄金日度短期走势的可预测性有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为弱式市场效率理论提供了实证支持，表明黄金市场在技术分析层面具有效率；2. 强调了在评估金融预测模型时同时进行统计和经济评估的重要性；3. 揭示了机器学习模型在金融时间序列预测中的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒投资者和交易者，仅依赖技术指标和机器学习模型可能无法获得持续的超额收益；2. 为金融预测模型评估提供了方法论参考，强调需要结合统计显著性和经济价值双重标准；3. 对量化交易策略开发具有警示意义，表明简单的技术指标组合可能不足以捕捉市场可预测性。

title: Fragility of Losers' Consent: Political Institutions and Polarization
affiliations: Musashi University - Economics and Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: Fragility of Losers' Consent: Political Institutions and Polarization
detail.abstract: Losers' consent, defined as the willingness of electoral losers to accept election outcomes, is central to democratic legitimacy, yet it is fragile. This paper explores how political institutions shape losers' consent and policy polarization by modeling losers' consent as a choice of belief distortion by the electoral loser. We develop a two-period model of electoral competition with partially policy-motivated parties, where the implemented policy is a convex combination of the winner's and loser's platforms. The weight placed on the winner captures the degree of institutional disproportionality. While electoral outcomes provide information about voter preferences, losers may strategically reject this information to preserve anticipatory utility. We show that institutional disproportionality has a non-monotonic effect on electoral denial. As long as losers' consent is interior, greater disproportionality increases denial. However, once institutions become sufficiently proportional, denial discontinuously jumps to full rejection. This denial, in turn, fuels policy polarization. Consequently, although disproportional institutions have a direct moderating effect on platforms, they may indirectly increase polarization by encouraging denial. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for psychological biases when evaluating the design of political institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨政治制度如何通过影响选举失败者对选举结果的接受度（"失败者同意"）来影响政策极化。研究发现，制度的不比例性对选举否认有非单调影响：适度不比例性增加否认，但足够比例时否认会突然跳升至完全拒绝。这种否认进而加剧政策极化。
AI.research_question: 政治制度如何塑造选举失败者的同意（losers' consent）和政策极化？制度的不比例性如何影响失败者对选举结果的接受度？
AI.motivation: 选举失败者接受选举结果（失败者同意）对民主合法性至关重要，但这一同意很脆弱。现有研究需要更好地理解政治制度如何影响失败者同意及其对政策极化的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 失败者同意理论：选举失败者接受选举结果的意愿；2. 信念扭曲模型：失败者可能战略性地拒绝选举信息以保持预期效用；3. 制度不比例性理论：政策实施中获胜者和失败者平台的权重分配。
AI.method: 建立两期选举竞争模型，政党部分受政策动机驱动。实施政策是获胜者和失败者平台的凸组合，权重反映制度不比例性程度。分析失败者如何战略性地接受或拒绝选举信息。
AI.findings: 1. 制度不比例性对选举否认有非单调影响：适度不比例性增加否认，但足够比例时否认突然跳升至完全拒绝；2. 这种否认加剧政策极化；3. 不比例制度虽直接缓和政策平台，但通过鼓励否认间接增加极化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将失败者同意建模为信念扭曲选择；2. 揭示制度不比例性与选举否认的非单调关系；3. 连接制度设计、心理偏见和政策极化；4. 强调在评估政治制度设计时考虑心理偏见的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为制度设计者提供启示：过度比例的制度可能导致失败者完全拒绝选举结果；2. 帮助理解当代民主中政策极化的制度根源；3. 强调在民主制度设计中平衡比例性与失败者接受度的重要性。

title: Grants Pass v. Johnson and Extrajudicial Punishment
affiliations: Loyola University of Chicago

detail.title: Grants Pass v. Johnson and Extrajudicial Punishment
detail.abstract:
Grants Pass v. Johnson is a prime example of the shortcomings of legal formalism. In its reasoning, the Supreme Court ignores the obvious – that criminal law is being misused to target people experiencing homelessness. However, in ruling that Eighth Amendment scrutiny is limited to codified criminal punishments, the Court’s formalism ignores not only its Robinson doctrine but precedents on civil asset forfeiture and prison conditions among others.

This article seeks to build off the foundational research of Chris Herring, Dilara Yarbrough, Lisa Marie Alatorre, and Sara Rankin to argue that the Supreme Court’s focus on codified criminal punishments ignores the “pervasive penality” and “invisible persecution” of sweeps – the state practice of banishing unhoused people and destroying their property under threat of arrest or citation. It posits that sweeps are extrajudicial punishment characterized by banishment, isolation, property destruction, and premature death. It explains that these practices are not only profoundly punishing but that the Court recognizes them as such in analogous forms throughout its jurisprudence even when they are not prescribed by law. Describing sweeps as extrajudicial punishment hopefully allows for a more holistic analysis of the misuse of criminal law to target people experiencing homelessness in future constitutional challenges. At minimum, however, it seeks to help unhoused people and their advocates expose the blindfold of the Grants Pass decision’s formalism.

AI.tldr: 本文批判最高法院在Grants Pass案中的形式主义立场，认为法院忽视了对无家可归者的"普遍惩罚性"和"隐形迫害"，主张将扫荡行动定性为法外惩罚，为未来的宪法挑战提供更全面的分析框架。
AI.research_question: 如何通过将针对无家可归者的扫荡行动定性为法外惩罚，来挑战最高法院在Grants Pass案中的形式主义立场，并为未来的宪法诉讼提供更全面的分析框架？
AI.motivation: 最高法院在Grants Pass v. Johnson案中采用形式主义推理，将第八修正案的审查仅限于成文刑法惩罚，忽视了刑事法律被滥用来针对无家可归者的现实问题，特别是扫荡行动对无家可归者的"普遍惩罚性"和"隐形迫害"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 法律形式主义批判理论；2. Chris Herring等人的"普遍惩罚性"和"隐形迫害"概念；3. 法外惩罚理论；4. 第八修正案法理（包括Robinson原则、民事资产没收和监狱条件判例）。
AI.method: 本文采用法律分析和理论构建方法，基于现有研究（Herring, Yarbrough, Alatorre, Rankin）和最高法院判例，通过类比推理和概念分析，论证扫荡行动应被定性为法外惩罚。
AI.findings: 扫荡行动具有法外惩罚的特征：驱逐、隔离、财产破坏和过早死亡。最高法院在其法理中已承认类似形式的惩罚性，即使这些惩罚没有法律规定。将扫荡定性为法外惩罚可以更全面地分析刑事法律被滥用来针对无家可归者的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"法外惩罚"作为分析扫荡行动的理论框架；2. 挑战法律形式主义在宪法分析中的局限性；3. 扩展第八修正案审查的范围，包括非成文惩罚形式；4. 连接刑事司法系统与对无家可归者的系统性压迫。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为无家可归者及其倡导者提供揭露Grants Pass判决形式主义盲点的工具；2. 为未来的宪法挑战建立更全面的分析框架；3. 推动对扫荡行动宪法合法性的重新评估；4. 增强对无家可归者权利的法律保护。

title: Cognitive Nemesis: Reinforcement Loops, Confirmation Bias, Echo Chambers, Cognitive Dissonance, Metacognition and the Dunning-Kruger Effect in the Context of Digital Media
affiliations: SRH Hochschule Heidelberg

detail.title: Cognitive Nemesis: Reinforcement Loops, Confirmation Bias, Echo Chambers, Cognitive Dissonance, Metacognition and the Dunning-Kruger Effect in the Context of Digital Media
detail.abstract: This work explores the intricate relationships among reinforcement loops, confirmation bias, echo chambers, cognitive dissonance, metacognition, and the Dunning-Kruger effect within the context of modern digital media. It synthesizes these established cognitive and behavioral concepts and integrates an array of scientific literature to provide original insights into how digital environments and their dynamics impact human cognition and behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了强化循环、确认偏误、回音室效应、认知失调、元认知和邓宁-克鲁格效应在数字媒体环境中的复杂关系，整合了认知行为概念和科学文献，揭示了数字环境如何影响人类认知和行为。
AI.research_question: 数字媒体环境中的强化循环、确认偏误、回音室效应、认知失调、元认知和邓宁-克鲁格效应之间存在怎样的复杂关系？这些认知和行为机制如何共同影响数字环境中的人类认知和行为？
AI.motivation: 现代数字媒体环境对人类认知和行为产生了深远影响，但现有研究对这些认知机制之间的相互作用缺乏系统性整合。理解这些机制如何共同作用对于应对数字时代的认知挑战至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强化循环理论、确认偏误理论、回音室效应理论、认知失调理论、元认知理论和邓宁-克鲁格效应理论，这些认知和行为科学理论构成了本文的理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论整合方法，通过综合现有科学文献和认知行为理论，构建理论框架并分析这些概念之间的相互关系。
AI.findings: 数字媒体环境通过强化循环放大确认偏误，促进回音室效应形成；认知失调在信息冲突时被触发；元认知能力不足与邓宁-克鲁格效应相互作用，共同影响数字环境中的认知和行为模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统整合了六个关键认知行为概念在数字媒体环境中的相互作用框架，提出了数字认知生态系统的理论模型，为理解数字时代的认知复杂性提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台设计者、教育工作者和政策制定者提供了改善数字环境认知健康的实践建议，帮助识别和缓解有害的认知行为模式，促进更健康的数字信息消费习惯。

title: Households' Macroeconomic Expectations in Japan -Preliminary results
affiliations: Chiba University

detail.title: Households' Macroeconomic Expectations in Japan -Preliminary results

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study conducted an online survey of 1,671 individuals. The survey items included expectations regarding the macroeconomy, perspectives on various matters, and economic literacy, and contained no ethically problematic questions. Furthermore, respondents were informed that the collected data would be used solely for academic and educational purposes, and the survey was administered only to those who provided their consent.

detail.abstract: This paper examines why households form a positive correlation between inflation and unemployment expectations, a pattern that challenges standard macroeconomic theory. We conduct an original online survey of 1,671 Japanese households in February 2026 and elicit 12-month-ahead expectations for inflation and unemployment. Consistent with previous findings, we observe a strong positive correlation between the two expectations. We evaluate four possible explanations: emphasis on supply-side factors, reliance on a "good-bad" heuristic (believing all macro variables move together), general pessimism, and low economic literacy. When controling for supply-side factors-particularly expected changes in energy price-the correlation weakens, indicating that stagflationary view partly drive the relationship. By contrast, measures of good-bad heuristic thinking, general pessimism, and economic literacy do not significantly reduce the correlation. Overall, supply-side considerations play a meaningful but limited role, and much of the positive correlation remains unexplained, highlighting the need for further research on households' subjective macroeconomic models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过日本家庭调查发现通胀与失业预期呈正相关，这与标准宏观理论相悖。研究发现供给侧因素（特别是能源价格预期）部分解释了这一关系，但大部分相关性仍无法解释。
AI.research_question: 为什么家庭会形成通胀与失业预期之间的正相关关系？这种与标准宏观理论相悖的模式如何解释？
AI.motivation: 家庭对通胀和失业的预期呈正相关，这与标准宏观理论中的菲利普斯曲线（负相关关系）相矛盾，需要探究这一现象背后的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准宏观经济理论（菲利普斯曲线）、行为经济学（启发式思维）、认知偏差理论、经济素养理论
AI.method: 2026年2月对1,671个日本家庭进行原创在线调查，收集12个月后的通胀和失业预期数据，评估四种可能解释：供给侧因素、"好坏"启发式思维、普遍悲观情绪、经济素养水平。
AI.findings: 1. 观察到通胀与失业预期之间存在强正相关；2. 控制供给侧因素（特别是能源价格预期）后相关性减弱；3. "好坏"启发式思维、普遍悲观情绪和经济素养水平对相关性无显著影响；4. 大部分正相关性仍无法解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了家庭主观宏观经济模型与标准理论的差异；2. 识别了供给侧因素在解释这一异常关系中的作用；3. 排除了几种可能的认知偏差解释；4. 为理解家庭预期形成机制提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对政策制定者理解公众预期形成有启示；2. 强调了在沟通经济政策时需要考虑供给侧因素；3. 为未来研究家庭预期提供了方法论基础；4. 对中央银行预期管理策略有参考价值。

title: Breaking the CEO's Echo Chamber: Internal Checks and Balances in Environmental Disclosure
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Breaking the CEO's Echo Chamber: Internal Checks and Balances in Environmental Disclosure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is based exclusively on publicly available, anonymized secondary data and does not involve any direct interaction with human participants. Consequently, the study is exempt from ethical review approval, and no informed consent was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Does corporate greenwashing stem from CEO agency problems? We argue that greenwashing also reflects failures in internal political constraints within the top management team. Viewing the Top Management Team (TMT) as a political entity, we find that non-CEO executives act as a "shadow cabinet" curbing CEO opportunism. Using a composite index of non-CEO political capital (pay) and horizon (age), we show stronger internal constraints significantly enhance environmental disclosure quality (EIDQ). Using causal identification strategiesincluding an IPO-stage instrumental variable (IV), PDS-Lasso, and Random Forest-we confirm robustness to endogeneity and model misspecification.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：企业漂绿行为不仅源于CEO代理问题，还反映了高管团队内部政治约束的失效。非CEO高管作为"影子内阁"能够制约CEO机会主义，其政治资本（薪酬）和任期（年龄）越强，环境信息披露质量越高。
AI.research_question: 企业漂绿行为是否源于CEO代理问题？高管团队内部政治约束如何影响环境信息披露质量？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要从CEO代理问题解释企业漂绿，但忽略了高管团队内部政治动态的作用。需要探究非CEO高管如何作为内部约束机制影响环境信息披露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高管团队政治视角理论：将高管团队视为政治实体，非CEO高管作为"影子内阁"制约CEO机会主义；代理理论；企业漂绿理论。
AI.method: 构建非CEO高管政治资本（薪酬）和任期（年龄）的复合指数；使用IPO阶段工具变量法、PDS-Lasso和随机森林等因果识别策略处理内生性和模型误设问题。
AI.findings: 更强的内部政治约束显著提高环境信息披露质量；非CEO高管确实起到"影子内阁"作用，有效制约CEO漂绿行为；结果对多种内生性检验稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 将高管团队政治视角引入漂绿研究；提出"影子内阁"理论框架；扩展了企业漂绿成因的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业改善环境信息披露提供内部治理建议；强调非CEO高管在制约CEO机会主义中的重要作用；为监管机构制定政策提供参考。

title: FinTech Adoption and Consumer Financial Decision-Making: A Behavioral Economics Narrative Review
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Department of Management

detail.title: FinTech Adoption and Consumer Financial Decision-Making: A Behavioral Economics Narrative Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the European Union – Next Generation EU, under the Italian National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR), PRIN 2022 PNRR – Project I.COPE.BEST (Improving Consumer Protection and Education in a world of Boundedly-Rational, Emotionally-driven, Socially-embedded and Technologically-assisted financial decision-making), Grant No. P2022E57WP (CUP: C53D23009130001), assigned to Ca' Foscari University of Venice.

detail.abstract: This structured narrative review synthesizes evidence on FinTech adoption and consumer financial decision-making through a behavioral economics lens, with emphasis on EU-relevant settings and the post-COVID-19 period. Across digital payments, mobile banking, and robo-advisory services, adoption, continued use, and advice-following are shaped by (i) shocks and habit formation, (ii) trust, privacy concerns, and perceived risk, and (iii) capability constraints (financial and digital literacy) interacting with demographic and socioeconomic heterogeneity. We consolidate convergent findings, delineate contested areas-especially when and why consumers rely on algorithmic advice-and highlight measurement priorities for research on financial inclusion. The paper concludes with a survey-ready construct map linking behavioral mechanisms (e.g., trust, perceived complexity, privacy concern, perceived recourse, and confidence calibration) to adoption outcomes and inclusion risks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过行为经济学视角，系统回顾了金融科技采纳与消费者金融决策的文献，重点关注欧盟背景和疫情后时期。研究发现采纳、持续使用和遵循建议受冲击与习惯形成、信任与隐私担忧、能力约束等因素影响，并提出了面向金融包容性研究的测量框架。
AI.research_question: 金融科技采纳如何影响消费者金融决策？哪些行为经济学因素（如冲击、习惯、信任、能力约束）塑造了金融科技服务的采纳、持续使用和建议遵循？
AI.motivation: 金融科技快速发展对消费者金融行为产生深远影响，但缺乏从行为经济学角度系统理解采纳机制的研究，特别是在欧盟背景和疫情后时期。需要整合现有证据，识别关键行为机制，为金融包容性政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论，包括习惯形成理论、信任理论、风险感知理论、能力约束理论（金融素养和数字素养），以及人口和社会经济异质性理论。
AI.method: 结构化叙事综述方法，系统综合金融科技采纳和消费者金融决策的实证证据，特别关注欧盟相关背景和COVID-19后时期。
AI.findings: 1. 金融科技采纳、持续使用和建议遵循受三大因素影响：(i)冲击与习惯形成；(ii)信任、隐私担忧和风险感知；(iii)能力约束（金融和数字素养）与人口社会经济异质性的交互作用。2. 算法建议的依赖时机和原因存在争议。3. 提出了金融包容性研究的测量优先级。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合行为经济学视角理解金融科技采纳机制。2. 构建连接行为机制（信任、感知复杂性、隐私担忧、感知追索权、信心校准）与采纳结果和包容性风险的理论框架。3. 识别算法建议依赖的理论争议点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供面向金融包容性政策的实证依据。2. 开发可直接用于调查的构念映射工具。3. 为金融科技产品设计和监管提供行为洞察。4. 指导金融素养和数字素养教育项目。

title: Non-Exclusive Notifications for Ride-Hailing at Lyft II: Simulations and Marketplace Analysis
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, , Lyft, Inc., Lyft, Inc., Lyft, Inc., Lyft, Inc., Lyft, Inc., Lyft, Inc., Lyft, Inc., , Lyft, Inc., Lyft, Inc. and Lyft, Inc.

detail.title: Non-Exclusive Notifications for Ride-Hailing at Lyft II: Simulations and Marketplace Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The work is done when the second author was partly a faculty advisor at Lyft inc.

detail.abstract:
Ride-hailing platforms increasingly face uncertain driver acceptance, which makes traditional one-to-one exclusive dispatch (ED) less efficient: rejections and timeouts force sequential retries and lengthen rider wait times. Non-exclusive dispatch (NED) mitigates this friction by broadcasting a request to multiple drivers in parallel. While NED can reduce latency, it introduces new design challenges---most notably, how to choose notification sets and how to resolve driver contention.

In this paper---the second in a two-part collaboration with Lyft---we develop a theoretically grounded framework to evaluate the long-run performance and marketplace effects of transitioning from ED to NED. We bridge theory and practice by combining (i) an optimization model that formulates NED as a constrained welfare maximization problem with (ii) large-scale discrete-event simulations on proprietary Lyft traces and (iii) a stylized macroscopic equilibrium model. Across simulation and equilibrium analysis, we find that NED improves key fulfillment metrics relative to ED: it reduces match time (and hence rider reneging) while increasing both the number and the average quality of completed matches. We also quantify the speed--quality trade-off between two common contention rules, First-Accept and Best-Accept: First-Accept maximizes speed and throughput, whereas Best-Accept is required to maximize per-match quality. Finally, we show that slightly conservative notification heuristics can improve long-run efficiency by avoiding excessive locking of high-value drivers and preserving future availability.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了网约车平台从一对一专属派单转向非专属派单（广播给多个司机）的长期绩效和市场影响。研究发现NED能减少匹配时间、增加完成匹配数量和平均质量，并分析了两种竞争解决规则（先接单优先vs最优接单优先）的速度-质量权衡。
AI.research_question: 从专属派单转向非专属派单如何影响网约车平台的长期绩效和市场效率？具体包括：如何选择通知集、如何解决司机竞争、以及不同竞争解决规则的速度-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 网约车平台面临司机接受率不确定的问题，传统一对一专属派单效率低下：拒绝和超时导致顺序重试，延长乘客等待时间。非专属派单通过并行广播请求给多个司机可以缓解这种摩擦，但引入了新的设计挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将非专属派单建模为约束福利最大化问题，结合宏观均衡模型分析市场长期效应，包括匹配效率、司机竞争解决机制等理论框架。
AI.method: 结合三种方法：(1) 将NED建模为约束福利最大化的优化模型；(2) 基于Lyft专有数据的大规模离散事件模拟；(3) 简化的宏观均衡模型分析长期市场效应。
AI.findings: NED相比ED改善关键履约指标：减少匹配时间（从而减少乘客放弃）、增加完成匹配数量和平均质量。先接单优先规则最大化速度和吞吐量，而最优接单优先规则最大化每单质量。适度保守的通知启发式方法能通过避免过度锁定高价值司机来提升长期效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了从专属派单向非专属派单过渡的理论分析框架，提出了NED的优化模型和均衡分析方法，为平台派单策略设计提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网约车平台提供了从ED转向NED的实践指导，包括通知集选择策略、竞争解决规则的选择（速度vs质量权衡），以及保守通知启发式方法的具体实施建议。

title: Authority-Mediated Trade Secrecy in the AI Act: An Example of Functional Constitutionalisation of Transparency?
affiliations: Centre for IT & IP Law (CiTiP), Faculty of Law - KU Leuven and KU Leuven - Centre for IT & IP Law (CiTiP)

detail.title: Authority-Mediated Trade Secrecy in the AI Act: An Example of Functional Constitutionalisation of Transparency?

declarations.funderStatement: Leona King is funded by the Research Foundation – Flanders (FWO) [grant no. 11A0025N].

detail.abstract:
This article examines how the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) seeks to reconcile transparency obligations with the protection of trade secrets through a multi-layered, regulator-facing disclosure framework centred on Article 53. It argues that the AI Act does not merely accommodate competing interests but participates in an emerging model of authority-mediated trade secrecy that is reshaping EU data governance. Across recent legislation – including the Data Act and the European Health Data Space Regulation – trade secret protection is increasingly removed from purely private assertion and litigation, and instead assessed, operationalised, and constrained through administrative procedures and institutional oversight.

Drawing on the EU Trade Secrets Directive, the AI Act, and recent case law of the CJEU (e.g. CK v Dun & Bradstreet C-203/22), the article conceptualises authority-mediated trade secrecy as a governance model in which independent authorities are tasked with assessing confidentiality claims. The analysis shows that the AI Act establishes a form of targeted transparency that balances, rather than hierarchises, competing Charter interests, including the rights to information and good administration, and the freedoms of property and to conduct a business through differentiated audiences, purposes, and levels of detail.

The article further contends that, despite this design, the current configuration of Article 53(1)(d) and the Commission’s 2025 disclosure template risks entrenching defensive opacity by over-delegating discretion to AI providers. The article concludes that, taken together, this trend can be read as establishing a principle of functional constitutionalisation of transparency, whereby transparency obligations, while not framed as an autonomous Charter right, acquire constitutional force because they function as indispensable preconditions for the exercise of other fundamental rights. Interpreted in this way, the AI Act consolidates an ongoing evolution in EU data governance, signalling a shift towards a rebuttable presumption of transparency grounded in procedural safeguards, authority oversight, and institutional accountability.

AI.tldr: 欧盟《人工智能法案》通过第53条建立了一个多层级的、面向监管机构的披露框架，试图协调透明度义务与商业秘密保护。该法案不仅平衡了竞争利益，还参与了一种新兴的"权威中介型商业秘密"治理模式，将商业秘密保护从纯粹的私人主张转向行政程序和机构监督。尽管设计良好，但第53(1)(d)条和欧盟委员会2025年披露模板可能因过度授权给AI提供商而强化防御性不透明。这一趋势可解读为透明度功能宪法化原则的确立。
AI.research_question: 欧盟《人工智能法案》如何通过第53条协调透明度义务与商业秘密保护？这种协调机制如何体现"权威中介型商业秘密"这一新兴治理模式？
AI.motivation: 随着欧盟《人工智能法案》、《数据法案》和《欧洲健康数据空间条例》等新法规的出台，商业秘密保护正从纯粹的私人主张和诉讼转向行政程序和机构监督。需要研究这种转变如何影响透明度义务与商业秘密保护之间的平衡，以及《人工智能法案》在这一转变中的具体作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 权威中介型商业秘密治理模型：独立机构负责评估保密主张的治理模式；2. 功能宪法化理论：透明度义务虽未作为独立的宪章权利，但因作为行使其他基本权利不可或缺的前提而获得宪法效力；3. 欧盟基本权利宪章平衡：信息权、良好行政权与财产权、经营自由之间的平衡。
AI.method: 法律文本分析和案例研究：分析欧盟《商业秘密指令》、《人工智能法案》及相关法规文本；研究欧盟法院判例（如CK诉邓白氏案C-203/22）；比较分析《数据法案》和《欧洲健康数据空间条例》中的类似机制。
AI.findings: 1. 《人工智能法案》建立了面向监管机构的多层级披露框架，通过差异化受众、目的和细节层次平衡竞争利益；2. 该法案参与塑造了"权威中介型商业秘密"治理模式，将商业秘密保护纳入行政监督；3. 第53(1)(d)条和2025年披露模板存在过度授权给AI提供商的风险，可能强化防御性不透明；4. 透明度义务正通过功能宪法化获得宪法效力，成为行使其他基本权利的前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"权威中介型商业秘密"这一新的治理模型概念；2. 发展了"透明度功能宪法化"理论框架；3. 为理解欧盟数据治理的演变提供了新的理论视角；4. 揭示了透明度义务在基本权利体系中的结构性作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI提供商和监管机构实施《人工智能法案》透明度要求提供指导；2. 指出了第53(1)(d)条和披露模板需要改进的具体问题；3. 为未来欧盟数据治理立法设计提供了实践参考；4. 帮助企业理解在新治理模式下如何平衡透明度与商业秘密保护。
